plugins.readme_text:
# 我的 DSH 插件清单

此文档列举我个人在 DeepSeek Harness 上使用/维护的 out-of-tree 插件。

| 插件 | 为什么需要它 | profile 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-local-policy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-local-policy) | 它以纯 patch 捆绑（无代码）施加本地部署策略：把框架默认的 web 搜索提供方从 DeepSeek 切换为通用 HTTP 提供方，并禁用 DeepSeek 官方集成与 OTel 会话上报。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（patch 引用的 entry id 在该独立树中不存在） |
| [`dsh-logger-channels`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-logger-channels) | 它给操作者提供框架与全部插件 `ctx.logger` 输出的可见出口：向 cordis 注册命名通道（stderr/stdout/file，file 通道纯大小轮转），因为宿主只自带内存环形缓冲，没有它日志只进内存。 | ✅ web；其余长驻 profile 原理上可兼容——未验证 |
| [`@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin`](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking) | 它给 agent 提供由 OpenViking 支撑的长期记忆：跨会话读写记忆，并在共享同一 OpenViking 的 profile 之间传递上下文。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal（MCP client 可用性未验证） |
| [`dsh-timer`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-timer) | 它给 profile 提供进程内定时任务，语义对齐 systemd.timer，每次运行创建一个新 agent 会话执行任务 prompt。 | ✅ web；⚠️ headless（30s tick 调度器在一次性进程中无意义）；✅ sdk/acp（长驻进程）；❌ sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-email`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-email) | 它让 agent 能读写邮件：对 IMAP/SMTP 账号提供列目录、搜索、读取、标记、保存附件与发送/回复/转发，并支持新邮件事件触发，使 agent 能实时响应来信。 | ✅ 全部 profile（软读取、优雅降级）；⚠️ headless（IDLE 触发在一次性进程中无意义） |
| [`dsh-ntfy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-ntfy) | 它给 agent 提供推送通知出口：一次工具调用即把消息发布到 ntfy topic，使作业结果、告警与报告能送达操作者设备或任意订阅该 topic 的应用。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-webhook-dispatcher`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-webhook-dispatcher) | 它给 profile 提供入站 webhook 入口：端点路由挂在框架主 web server 上，外部投递经 method 门控、token 鉴权、请求体大小限制与每端点队列/并发约束后，派发为受控 trigger 会话，使外部系统能触发 agent。 | ✅ web；其余 profile 需组合 `dsh-host-webserver` |
| [`dsh-surfing-plugin`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-surfing-plugin) (forked) | 它为 agent 的联网能力提供后端：允许其接入基于 SearXNG 的搜索与基于 Crawl4AI 的页面抓取。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（无 base web_search） |
| [`dsh-tts`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-tts) | 它让 agent 能合成语音：允许其接入任意 OpenAI 兼容 TTS 后端。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-imagegen`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-imagegen) | 它让 agent 能生成图像：单个 `imagegen` 工具接入任意 OpenAI 兼容图像后端并渲染图像，并可检查已配置后端及其实时状态。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot) (forked) | 它给 profile 提供 QQ IM 通道：维持与 QQ 开放平台的 WS 长连接，处理 QQ 消息的收发与 bot 生命周期，使 agent 能经 QQ 与用户实时交互。 |  ✅ web；❌ headless（一次性进程 + 交互式 QR 绑定）；✅ sdk/acp/sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-qqbot-send`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot-send) | 它让 agent 能主动把文本、Markdown 或文件附件发送到任意 QQ 目标（私聊/群/频道/公会 DM）；独立调用 QQ 开放平台 REST API，因此可以在没有 qqbot 网关的 profile 中单独挂载。 |  ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal |

图例：✅ 兼容 / ⚠️ 可组成功能降级 / ❌ 不兼容 / ❓ 未验证。(forked) = 个人分叉版本。

---

注：除非另有说明，以上插件的自维护版本均使用 QWen3.8-27B groupwise-int 在 DeepSeek Harness 上通过 “Vibe Coding” 产出。软件按“原样”提供，不提供任何形式的明示或暗示的担保。

plugins.description: Every ArtCraft (storytold) crafting app as a DSH plugin — 12 Cordis plugins driving CADCraft, GridCraft, SoundCraft and 9 more headlessly, each over its own CLI and MCP server.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft × DSH **Twelve crafting applications. One agent. Zero source changes.** Every app from the [ArtCraft](https://github.com/storytold) org — CAD, spreadsheets, audio, video, photo, vector, PDF, slides, documents — exposed to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as a first-class plugin. [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![built on Cordis](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20on-Cordis-6E56CF?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20OR%20Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square)](#license) [![Plugins](https://img.shields.io/badge/plugins-12-success?style=flat-square)](#the-twelve) [![Tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-92-informational?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-bridged-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified-12%2F12-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](#verify-it-yourself) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
--- ```console $ dsh --profile web you › make me a Q3 sales spreadsheet with a chart, save it to ~/Documents ⏺ gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} 315 commands, 8 families ⏺ gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} {range?, type?, title?, at?} ⏺ gridcraft_run sample "sales", 2 commands exited 0 in 41ms ⏺ gridcraft_inspect ~/Documents/q3.xlsx 1 sheet, 1 chart, A1:H24 ✔ GridCraft wrote ~/Documents/q3.xlsx (14,208 bytes) ``` ## What this is The ArtCraft suite is twelve native Rust applications. Each one already ships a headless CLI and its own MCP server — but nothing tells an agent they exist, what they can do, or how to call them. This repository closes that gap. Each app becomes a **DSH plugin** that registers model-callable tools on `ctx.tools`, discovers the app's binary on your machine, and drives it as an external process. **No craft source is ever modified.** Every plugin lives here. The applications are dependencies, not forks. ## The twelve | | Craft | What it does | Commands | MCP tools | |:--|:--|:--|--:|--:| | 📐 | **CADCraft** | CAD and drafting (AutoCAD-style) | 305 | 11 | | 📊 | **GridCraft** | Spreadsheets (Excel-style) | 315 | 21 | | 🎚️ | **SoundCraft** | Digital audio workstation | 465 | 17 | | 🖼️ | **PhotoCraft** | Raster image editing (Photoshop-style) | 858 | 21 | | 🌄 | **LightCraft** | Photo library and raw development | 296 | 318 | | 📄 | **PdfCraft** | PDF reading and editing | 161 | 161 | | 🖋️ | **VectorCraft** | Vector art (Illustrator-style) | 743 | 32 | | 🎬 | **EffectCraft** | Motion graphics (After Effects-style) | 669 | 27 | | 🎞️ | **FilmCraft** | Non-linear video editing | 693 | 17 | | 🎨 | **DesignCraft** | Page and layout design (InDesign-style) | 446 | 25 | | 📽️ | **DeckCraft** | Presentations (PowerPoint-style) | 226 | 25 | | 📝 | **WordCraft** | Word processing (Word-style) | 460 | 16 | Command counts are read live from each binary; MCP counts are what each server declares. ## Two surfaces per craft Every plugin exposes **both**, because they answer different questions:
Generic commandsThe craft's own MCP server
Reaches the **entire application** — every menu item is a command id. ``` gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} gridcraft_run {"commands": [...], "save": "..."} gridcraft_inspect {"file": "..."} gridcraft_convert {"input": "...", "output": "..."} ``` **Modelled operations** with real JSON Schemas, served over JSON-RPC by the app itself. ``` gridcraft_mcp_tools {"search": "range"} gridcraft_mcp_call {"tool": "write_range", "arguments": {"range": "A1", "values": [["x"]]}} gridcraft_mcp_status {} ```
The MCP server is spawned once per plugin and kept warm — starting GridCraft's engine costs ~600 ms — then shut down after five idle minutes or when the plugin unloads. ## Quick start **Windows** — from a fresh clone, in PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft .\install.ps1 # or: install.cmd (if .ps1 files are blocked) ``` That finds the Node the harness already ships (no `node`, `npm` or `pnpm` on `PATH` needed), downloads every craft CLI for your platform, and installs the twelve plugins into your DSH profile. Add `-Crafts gridcraft` for one craft, `-List` for a dry run, or `-Verify` to prove it works: ```powershell .\install.ps1 -Crafts gridcraft,wordcraft -Profile desktop -Verify ``` **macOS and Linux** — the same two steps by hand: ```sh git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft # 1. the craft CLIs — macOS, Windows and Linux, no Rust toolchain needed node scripts/install-craft.mjs # …or compile them from source instead (needs Rust, ~1 min per craft): # node scripts/install-craft.mjs --from-source # 2. install the plugins into a DSH profile, then restart it node scripts/install-into-profile.mjs --profile web ``` Both platforms run the same Node scripts; `install.ps1` only adds Node discovery and PowerShell-friendly defaults. Nothing is installed machine-wide and no shell profile is modified. Or install a single craft from npm, straight into a profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft ``` Each craft is its own package: `dsh-artcraft-plugin-` for `cadcraft`, `gridcraft`, `soundcraft`, `deckcraft`, `wordcraft`, `photocraft`, `lightcraft`, `pdfcraft`, `vectorcraft`, `effectcraft`, `filmcraft` and `designcraft`. Then just ask: > *"Open the CADCraft sample floor plan and export a PNG of the kitchen."* > *"Take the demo song in SoundCraft, drop the kick 6 dB and bounce it."* > *"Render page 3 of this PDF at 300 dpi."* Full instructions, configuration and troubleshooting: **[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)**
Requirements - **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` — on Windows the harness's own bundled Node is found automatically, so you do not need it on `PATH` - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) profile - **macOS, Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04** — the installer picks the right build, and nothing else is required (no Rust, no `unzip`, no `tar`, no `npm`, no `pnpm`) Nothing else. The craft apps are **not** built from source; step 1 downloads signed release binaries.
## Verify it yourself ```sh node scripts/verify.mjs ``` Every craft must locate its binary, load its live catalog, expose the right tool set, complete an MCP handshake, and produce a non-empty artifact from a real headless run: ``` craft binary catalog tools mcp run cadcraft cadcraft-cli 0.5.0 305 (live) 8 11 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.dxf (34140 B) deckcraft deckcraft-cli 0.5.0 226 (live) 8 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.deckcraft (7471 B) designcraft designcraft-cli 0.6.0 446 (live) 6 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.pdf (2028 B) effectcraft effectcraft-cli 0.8.0 669 (live) 8 27 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.ecproj (732438 B) filmcraft filmcraft-cli 0.6.0 693 (live) 8 17 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.fcproj (3264 B) gridcraft gridcraft-cli 0.5.0 315 (live) 8 21 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.xlsx (7682 B) lightcraft lightcraft-cli 0.6.0 296 (live) 7 318 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.bin (108535 B) pdfcraft pdfcraft-cli 0.7.1 161 (live) 8 161 tools (doc_list ok) ok → out.pdf (802 B) photocraft photocraft-c

plugins.readme_text:
# DSHM 插件 · DeepSeek Harness 远程连接 简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md) [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile) · **DSHM 电脑插件** · [DSHM 中转服务](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay) **DSHM 插件**安装在电脑的官方 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中，将工作区、聊天会话、执行结果和审批同步到 [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile)。手机远程续聊与决策，电脑执行任务；无需修改或重建 DSH。 [GitHub 一条命令安装](#安装插件并配对手机) · [下载插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/tag/v0.1.85-latest.0) · [DSH 兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) · [常见问题](#常见问题)

![DSHM 插件：把电脑上的工作，连接到手机。](./docs/images/hero.png) ## 远程会话与设备管理功能 | 能力 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 会话同步 | 查看工作区与历史、创建聊天、发送消息、切换模型、处理审批。 | | 设备管理 | 五分钟有效的一次性配对链接；核对指纹、批准、拒绝与撤销。 | | 访问控制 | 开关远程连接；电脑管理权限另行授予或收回。 | | 扩展 | 通过允许的接口转发文件、工具结果与兼容插件局部界面。 | ![DeepSeek Harness 中的 DSHM 插件设置：电脑已连接，手机配对等待批准。](./docs/images/desktop-pairing.png) [图片来源](./docs/images/README.md)。真实插件页面，使用演示设备。 ## 安装插件并配对手机 [插件构建与下载](./docs/releases.md) · [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/actions/workflows/plugin-build.yml) · [发行版本](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases) **官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` 共用同一 GitHub 安装包：** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin ``` `dsh plugin` 是 DSH 官方命令。若你从 DSH 源码目录启动，使用 `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin`。仓库包含预编译产物，安装时不需要编译器、相邻后端目录或额外构建许可；正式使用建议复制市场提供的 `#完整提交号` 命令，固定到已扫描版本。[GitHub 安装与版本说明](./docs/github-install.md) 仓库默认安装包 `0.1.85-latest.0` 支持上述两个明确版本。alpha.1 仍需使用对应的 `.tgz`，不能使用默认命令。三个版本的插件包已公开发布，直接下载无需登录 GitHub： | 电脑 DSH 版本 | 直接下载 | | --- | --- | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | [rc.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.1` | [alpha.1 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.1.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.2` | [alpha.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.85-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.85-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.2.tgz) | 连接 rc.2 / alpha.2 请使用 [DSHM 0.1.0-preview.2 APK](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0-preview.2/DSHM-0.1.0-preview.2.apk)；该 APK 不连接 alpha.1。旧 preview.1 仍只连接 alpha.2。[双版本验证与手机要求](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) · [完整配对步骤](./docs/usage.md) 1. 安装匹配 DSH 版本的插件，运行 `pnpm dsh web`；提示下次启动加载时，重启 DSH。 2. 填写中转根地址、电脑名称，注册电脑并开启连接。 3. 手机领取配对链接，电脑核对指纹并批准。 4. 手机打开已有工作区，继续会话或创建新聊天。 **推荐[自建中转](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay)**；也可填[公共服务](http://118.31.20.47:18787) `http://118.31.20.47:18787`。开放注册免密，设备仍需配对与批准，无需用户账号。 公共服务使用 HTTP，传输未加密。敏感内容建议自建 HTTPS。电脑和 DSH 必须保持运行。[完整安装步骤](./docs/usage.md) ## 更换中转服务地址 点击插件设置页 **“修改服务地址”**： - **同一后端换地址：** 换域名、端口或 HTTPS，验证后保留电脑身份和授权。 - **更换后端：** 重新注册和配对；个人模式需新密钥，旧服务授权不会自动撤销。 ![DSHM 电脑插件：修改中转服务地址并选择保留设备授权或重新配对。](./docs/images/change-server.png) 取消或验证失败保留原连接，保存成功保留启停状态。手机需新链接重新配对。[详细步骤](./docs/usage.md#5-修改服务地址) ## # dsh-delivery-receipt（交付回执）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**交付回执**插件：项目收尾时按一下，把「分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、
关键截图尺寸与 sha256、密钥扫描结论」汇成一张可以拿出去给人看的页面 —— 并且把每一条声明
**硬性**分进「已验证 / 仅本地 / 未验证」三区。**没有证据的板块留空，不补话。**

## 为什么要有它

收尾汇报每次都要手写一遍：写少了漏证据，写多了越界（把"我这台机器上是这样"说成"已经交付"）。
生态里的状态类插件（`2008924/dsh-progress-viz`、`133563825as-ai/dsh-api-dashboard`）都是**给自己看的实时面板**；
名字相近的 `dsh-receipt` 系列（如 `bluechips-zhao/dsh-receipt`、`louisyeaaah/dsh-receipt`）是**会话/用量小票**（token、耗时、成本、热敏打印）。
它们都不回答"这份交付里，哪几条是别人能复现的，哪几条只在你机器上成立"。

这个插件把这件事变成一条可测试的规则：

| 区 | 判定（只看证据，不看措辞，也不看成败） |
|---|---|
| **已验证** | 证据来自本次采集且能在别处复现：命令确实跑了（退出码就是事实）、文件哈希且文件已入版本库、扫描确实扫到了文件、git 引用在本地记录的远端里 |
| **仅本地** | 只在这台机器上成立：未提交改动、未推送提交、交付物未被 git 跟踪（别人拿到仓库看不到这个哈希） |
| **未验证** | 没有证据或证据不足：命令没运行/超时、声明的文件不存在、扫描 0 个文件、以及**人写的任何一句话** |

> ⚠️ **「已验证」不等于「是好消息」**：测试失败、密钥扫描命中都是**有证据的事实**，同样进已验证区，只是带红色色调。
> 三区分的是**证据强度**，不是成败。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-delivery-receipt
```

也可以从 GitHub 直装：`dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt`。
装好后重启 DSH，对话视图里出现「交付回执」Tab。

## 配置：`delivery-receipt.json`（放在项目根）

```json
{
  "project": "my-project",
  "tests":   [{ "name": "单元测试", "command": "node --test test/*.test.mjs" }],
  "builds":  [{ "name": "构建", "command": "node scripts/build.mjs" }],
  "artifacts": ["docs/*.png"],
  "scan": { "ignore": ["docs/big-demo.html"] },
  "claims": [{ "label": "已内部评审", "value": "2026-10-12 通过" }],
  "runCommands": true
}
```

| 字段 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `tests` / `builds` | 生成回执时会**执行**并把退出码、通过数、耗时写进回执。写法可以是字符串或 `{name, command}` |
| `artifacts` | 交付物模式：精确路径或 `目录/*.png`。会记录字节数、sha256、图片尺寸、以及**是否已入版本库** |
| `scan.ignore` | 密钥扫描跳过的路径前缀 |
| `scan.allowMarker` | 逐行豁免标记，默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`。测试夹具、文档示例这类"像凭据但不是凭据"的行，在行尾写上标记即可豁免；**豁免了多少行会原样出现在回执里**，不是静默放过 |
| `claims` | 你要说的话。**永远进未验证区** —— 能附证据的东西应该写成上面那些字段 |
| `runCommands` | 默认 `true`；设 `false` 只采集不执行 |
| `cwd` | 可选：覆盖采集目录（相对路径按配置文件所在目录解析） |

## 用法

装好插件后：对话视图 →「交付回执」→ 点「生成回执」。面板会先列出**这次会执行哪些命令**，
再按三区展示结果；「打开回执页」给出自包含的 HTML（可直接存文件/发出去），「复制 Markdown」给 PR 或聊天用。

不装 DSH 也能用：

```sh
node scripts/receipt.mjs                     # 打印摘要
node scripts/receipt.mjs --out receipt.html  # 落盘自包含页面
node scripts/receipt.mjs --md                # 打印 Markdown
node scripts/receipt.mjs --no-run            # 只采集，不执行命令
```

本仓库自己的回执（dogfood，含真实的 sha256 与扫描结论）：[docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)

![回执页：三区并列，每条声明都带证据行](docs/screenshot-1.png)

> 图是**快照**：截图文件自身的 sha256 每拍一次都会变，所以图里「交付物」那一行永远比当前文件慢一代。
> 权威数据看 [docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)（它记录的是它自己那一刻的仓库状态，含生成时间与 commit）。

## HTTP 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/state` | 当前配置、将要执行的命令、上次回执摘要 |
| POST | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/generate` | 生成一次回执（body 可带 `{"cwd": "..."}`，但必须在白名单内） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.html` | 自包含回执页（未生成时是明确的"还没有"页） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.md` | 同一份内容的 Markdown |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.json` | 回执对象（未生成时 404） |

## 安全边界（重要）

- **要执行的命令只来自配置文件**（`delivery-receipt.json` 或插件配置的 `receiptConfig`），
  **永远不来自 HTTP 请求**。`test/host.test.mjs` 里有一条测试专门往请求体塞 `command` 和假的 `tests`，断言执行器一次都没被调用。
- **能采集的目录只来自插件配置**：`cwd` 与 `roots` 白名单。请求里带的 `cwd` 不在白名单内一律 403 且不采集。
- **不联网**：远端状态读本地的 `refs/remotes/origin/*`，回执里标注为「本地记录的远端状态」，不把离线缓存说成实时事实。
- **不落凭据**：密钥扫描命中只记录 `文件:行号 + 规则名`，匹配到的内容、长度、摘要都不写；所有进入页面的文本再过一次脱敏（`ghp_…`、`sk-…`、私钥块、内联 Bearer、赋值型口令），家目录归一成 `~`。仓库里有一条测试断言"密钥字符串及其前缀不出现在序列化结果里"。
- **夹具误报有出口，而且不是静默的**：测试里必然会出现"像凭据的字符串"，所以扫描支持逐行豁免标记（默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`）。豁免的行数会写进回执的扫描范围一栏 —— 你可以看到放过了 3 行，而不是被瞒着。
- **自包含**：回执页没有外链脚本、没有 CDN、没有追踪（有测试断言 `<link>`/`<script>`/外链 `src|href` 都不存在），所以它可以离线保存、当附件发出去。

## 它不做什么

- **不判断好坏**：测试失败、扫描命中照样进「已验证」，插件的职责是把事实和证据分级，不是替你做结论。
- **不替你核实远端**：不联网，也没法知道远端仓库是否 public、tag 是否推上去了 —— 这类声明会落在「仅本地」或「未验证」。
- **不补话**：某个板块没有证据就是空的，页面会写「此区无证据」而不是编一段过渡句。
- **不是安全审计**：内置正则覆盖常见凭据形态（GitHub/npm/sk-/AWS/GCP/Slack/私钥/内联 Bearer/赋值型口令 + 敏感文件名），
  跳过大文件与二进制；它降低"把凭据一起发出去"的概率，不等于完备扫描。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs   # 零依赖构建（不需要打包器），产出 lib/
node --test              # 64 个测试
```

测试分四组：`evidence`（git 解析 / 图片尺寸 / 哈希 / 扫描 / 配置）、`zones`（三区判定规则）、
`receipt`（渲染与脱敏）、`host`（用 stub ctx 驱动真实 `apply()`，含两条安全边界）。
`lib/` 是构建产物，改 `src/` 后必须重新 build。

## 本仓库自身的状态（诚实披露）

- ✅ 已验证：`node --test` 64/64 通过、`node scripts/build.mjs` 退出 0、密钥扫描 0 命中（见 [回执](docs/receipt-example.md)）。
- ⚠️ 未验证：**没有在运行中的 DSH 里安装加载过** —— host/client 半区只经过单元测试与构建校验，
  没有端到端跑过真实宿主；面板截图一栏用的是 CLI 生成的回执页，不是 DSH 面板。
- ✅ 参考与差异：工程骨架照抄同作者的 [`dsh-warden`](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden)
  （零依赖构建、`cordis.patch.yml`、host/client 双半区、README、测试结构），这是明确授权的骨架复用；
  **实现代码没有搬运任何现有插件**。上面提到的 `dsh-progress-viz` / `dsh-api-dashboard` / `dsh-receipt`
  系列只读了它们的仓库简介，用来说明本插件与它们的差异。

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention)


**关键词**：日志留存 · 日志保留 · 审计日志 · 网络日志 · 网络安全法 · 六个月 · 留存不少于六个月 · 日志合规
**Keywords**: log retention · audit log retention · network log · six months retention · China cybersecurity law
**日志留存合规** —— 检查日志是否开着、是否记了该记的、是否留够**法定的 6 个月**。

## 不装它会怎样

你的日志轮转配的是 `maxDays: 7`（日志库的常见默认值）—— 排障够用。

半年后出了事，监管问：**这半年的网络日志呢？**

《网络安全法》第二十一条要求**留存不少于六个月**。日志已经在第 8 天被轮转删掉了。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 留存期 < 180 天 |
| 🔴 高 | 日志级别被关闭（`off`/`none`/`silent`）|
| 🔴 高 | 日志里打印了口令/令牌的**值** |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到任何日志方案 |

## 排障日志 ≠ 合规日志

```
排障：maxDays: 7        够了
合规：maxDays: >= 180   法定下限，且不能被应用进程随意删
```

两者通常**需要分开**：业务日志短留存，审计日志长留存、单独存放。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-cn-log-retention --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-cn-log-retention --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-cn-log-retention --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-cn-log-retention 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/report.png)

![dsh-cn-log-retention 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/demo.png)

![dsh-cn-log-retention 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/rules.png)

## 边界

- **不做缺项判定** —— 没有轮转配置不代表日志没留 180 天（可能由部署层统一留存）。
- **只看应用层** —— 数据库审计、网络设备、操作系统日志不在范围。
- **不校验不可篡改性** —— 那需要看存储层设计。
- 与其他插件分工：[dsh-cn-mlps](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) 做等保其它项。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [**日志留存**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp-lite

**Config-only bridge from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP).**

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

It mounts the MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness and points it at the upstream Windows-MCP server over stdio. The whole integration is [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) — about 25 lines, no JavaScript, and you can read it to the end before you install it.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ mcp__windows__Snapshot / Click / Type / ...
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (ships with DeepSeek Harness)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UI Automation tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What this deliberately does not do

These are the design decisions, not a missing-feature list:

- **No Host plugin.** There is no `index.js`. Nothing of ours runs inside your harness process.
- **No web routes.** This plugin adds no HTTP endpoint, so it adds no unauthenticated attack surface and no reason to keep your web host on loopback beyond what you already chose.
- **No state file.** No `~/.dsh/...state.json`, no browser storage keys.
- **No installer that writes to your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream server *in your own terminal*, and never edits a profile patch for you.
- **No runtime dependency and no build step.** `dependencies` is empty; there is nothing to compile and no `allowBuilds` approval to grant.
- **No absolute path for your machine.** The bridge invokes `uvx` from `PATH`; a test in this repo fails the build if a machine-specific path appears in a published file.
- **No `peerDependencies`.** The row *names* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; it never imports it, and DSH resolves shipped packages from its own installation. This follows DSH's own `templates/mcp` bundle shape, which declares none. A peer range would be a hard activation gate whose SemVer prerelease rules silently reject valid hosts; `engines.dsh` declares the host range for the storefront instead.
- **No `screenshots.json`.** There is no interface to photograph. Declaring artwork for a configuration file would be decoration, not evidence; the storefront falls back to whatever it can extract.

If you want an in-app dependency installer, a default-off "Computer Use" toggle, or a doctor tool, other plugins in this ecosystem provide those. This one trades them for being small enough to audit in one screen — which matters more than usual for a plugin that hands over your keyboard, mouse and screen.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.** The upstream server is Windows-only.
- **DeepSeek Harness with the in-box MCP client bridge.** Declared range: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; the author verified this plugin on **0.2.0-rc.2** (desktop).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH.** `uvx` starts the upstream server and builds its isolated environment. If you installed uv with its official installer, this is already true.
- Optional: **a model that accepts image input**, if you want `Screenshot` to arrive as a real image. Without it the bridge degrades the image to a text diagnostic; `Snapshot` returns plain text and needs no vision at all.

## Install

From the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter one of

```text
dsh-windows-mcp-lite                                # npm package
github:sheilacraig/dsh-windows-mcp-lite             # GitHub repository
C:\path\to\a\local\checkout                         # absolute path
```

From a CLI-owned profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-windows-mcp-lite
```

The Electron desktop profile belongs to the app; install through its plugin panel there.

Then restart DSH, so the new patch layer composes at startup.

## First run is the slow one

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for the upstream server the first time, which downloads a few tens of megabytes of Python dependencies. On a slow link that is minutes, and the bridge gives up on the initial connection long before that; after the dependencies are cached, startup is quick.

Do it outside the harness instead, where there is no timeout:

```sh
npm run prewarm
```

The script runs `uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve --exclude-tools ...` — the same argv the bridge uses — speaks `initialize` + `tools/list` to it, prints the server identity, the time it took, and the exact tool list, then exits. It is the same process the bridge will start, so a successful run means the harness side has nothing left to download or discover. With the environment warm, the author's run reached `initialize` in 2.1 s.

## What the model gets

**16 tools**, named `mcp__windows__<Tool>`. Upstream 0.8.8 publishes 21; this plugin excludes five by default (see [Least privilege](#least-privilege-by-default)).

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Screenshot` | Screen capture with cursor position and window list |
| `Snapshot` | Full desktop state: accessibility tree, interactive elements, scrollable regions |
| `DisplayInventory` | Display layout, work areas, DPI |
| `Click`, `Move`, `Scroll` | Mouse input, including explicit drag |
| `Type`, `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `Wait`, `WaitFor` | Fixed delay, or poll the UI until a condition holds |
| `MultiSelect`, `MultiEdit` | Bulk selection / bulk text entry |
| `Clipboard` | Read and set clipboard content |
| `Notification` | Windows toast notifications |
| `App` | Launch an application, resize or focus a window |
| `ControlStatus` | Who owns the desktop right now — upstream cannot exclude this one |

## Verify

1. Run `npm run prewarm` once (above). It proves the server and the pinned version.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory`. It only reads display geometry — it does not click or type.
3. Then `mcp__windows__Snapshot` for the accessibility tree as text.

## Least privilege by default

`--exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape` — five upstream tools stay off, because DeepSeek Harness already owns shell, file, registry and process access under its own approval policy and sandbox. Enabling upstream's copies would add a second path to the same capabilities with none of those controls.

To change the set, override the row in your profile patch (see below). Removing `--exclude-tools` restores all 21 tools.

## Configuration

Every default lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change one, override the row in **your profile's** patch — do not edit the installed copy:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: windows-mcp-lite
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape,App"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: true
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
```

Two things about that override, both of which cost people time:

- **A patch replaces the entire `config` object; it does not deep-merge.** Every key you leave out is a key you delete. `serverName` and `transport` are required, `command` is required for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`.
- **`serverName` decides every tool name** (`mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`). Changing it renames the whole tool set and invalidates prompt-cache prefixes.

**Only one Windows-MCP bridge per profile.** Two rows using the same `serverName` conflict, and the second one fails at load. Disable any other Windows-MCP plugin in the same profile before enabling this one.

Prefer a pre-installed interpreter over `uvx`? `uv tool install windows-mcp`, then set `command: windows-mcp` with `args: [serve, --exclude-tools, ...]`. Prefer a resident HTTP server? Switch `transport` to `streamable-http` and give `url` — note that the HTTP form has no `env`, so telemetry and flash settings then belong to how you start the server.

## Security

Installing this gives an agent your mouse, keyboard, clipboard and screen, through a process that runs with your user rights. Judge it as "

# dsh-phone-inbox

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

The session's inbound phone (WeChat bridge) attachment inbox: list the attachments **this conversation** actually received, and adopt one into the workspace on demand.

![Workflow diagram for dsh-phone-inbox: install → open panel → act.](docs/assets/dsh-phone-inbox-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: install → open panel → act. The examples below use the real command surface.*


## Install & uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-phone-inbox
```

The plugin has **no runtime dependencies** (`dependencies` is empty). Its only peers are the host packages it is built against; see the `peerDependencies` block in `package.json`.

## The problem this closes

`dsh-wechat` saves inbound phone media to `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile/` — outside the session workspace — and writes the absolute path into a plain text block. Two consequences follow, and neither is visible to the user:

1. **Workspace-confined tools cannot read it.** `dsh-data-quality` rejects any path that escapes the session workspace (`path-escape`), so "I sent you a CSV, profile it" fails even though the file is right there.
2. **The file name is destroyed.** The bridge names the file `${Date.now()}-${rand4hex}-${name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_")}`, so `材料.csv` lands on disk as `__.csv`. The user cannot recognize their own file.

`dsh-phone-inbox` adds no new channel and copies nothing by default. It makes the session's own inbound list addressable, and it restores the name the bridge mangled — from the `[收到文件: <name>]` marker the bridge already writes.

## What you get

| Tool | Question it answers |
|---|---|
| `inbox_list` | "Where is the file I just sent you from my phone?" |
| `inbox_adopt` | "Put it somewhere my workspace-confined tools can read it." |

Both tools are registered by the function plugin, so they appear in the model's tool list as soon as the bundle row is mounted.

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. Mount the plugin (a bundle row in the target profile)
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
```

Then, in a session that received a phone attachment:

```text
inbox_list                                   # the paths this session received
inbox_adopt { "path": "<the path from inbox_list>" }
```

`inbox_adopt` returns `relativePath` (for example `phone-inbox/材料.csv`). Pass **that** to a workspace-confined tool such as `data_profile`; pass the original host path only to consumers that accept any absolute path.

## Compatibility

| Engine | Range |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-alpha.1` |

The host peer range is the ecosystem's canonical six-clause OR range (see `dsh-plugin-kit/data/peer-range.json`). The host evaluates `peerDependencies` at preflight and **silently disables** a plugin row whose range does not admit the running version, so a wrong range looks like "the plugin mounted and does nothing". The host also adjudicates `engines.dsh` independently; a mismatch there can disable the row even when the peer range admits the version.

### Examples

These are the plugin's real entry points; install once, then call one.

#### Detailed example

**Command**

~~~sh
inbox_adopt
~~~

**Input**

~~~json
{
  "path": "/tmp/dsh-test-phone-inbox-acceptance-5AoMHy/.dsh-wechat/tempfile/1792414010975-0a67121b-__.csv"
}
~~~

**Output**

~~~text
{
  "relativePath": "phone-inbox/材料.csv",
  "copyMethod": "node-fs"
}
~~~

*Observed from `plugins/dsh-phone-inbox/scripts/acceptance.mjs:134-147`*

#### Failure branch

**Input**

~~~text
{"path":"/tmp/dsh-phone-inbox-example/workspace/local.csv"}
~~~

**Output**

~~~text
phone-inbox could not adopt that attachment.
reason: not-in-inbox
/tmp/dsh-phone-inbox-example/workspace/local.csv is not inside the inbox directory /tmp/dsh-phone-inbox-example/inbox; this plugin only adopts files the bridge saved there
~~~

*Observed from `plugins/dsh-phone-inbox/src/provider-base.ts:443-449; plugins/dsh-phone-inbox/src/render.ts:108-115; plugins/dsh-phone-inbox/tests/integration.test.ts:359-368`*

#### Brief examples

- `inbox_adopt`

## Configuration

Every field is optional; the table lists the default. See `cordis.patch.yml` for the same values with inline comments.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` mounts no service and no tools. |
| `inboxDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile` | Directory the bridge drops inbound media into. Empty derives the bridge's own default; set it when the bridge's `storageDir` was moved. |
| `maxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries `inbox_list` returns. The MVP contract is "the session's most recent few". |
| `provider` | `session` | Which registered provider answers: `session` (this conversation's own messages) or `tempdir` (`session` plus a scan of `inboxDir`). |
| `allowTempdirScan` | `false` | Enables the directory scan at all. Off because `inboxDir` is global. |
| `tempdirScanMaxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries a scan may contribute. |
| `tempdirScanMaxAgeMs` | `3600000` | Age ceiling for a scanned file; `0` disables the filter. |
| `markers` | see below | Marker wording per media kind, as `RegExp` sources. |
| `defaultSubdir` | `phone-inbox` | Workspace subdirectory `inbox_adopt` writes into. |
| `restoreOriginalName` | `true` | Use the sender's recovered original name as the adopted file name. |
| `writeChannel` | `auto` | `auto` (fs service for text, node:fs otherwise) · `fs` (host fs service only) · `node` (bytes directly). |
| `registerAttachment` | `false` | Also register adopted bytes as a durable host attachment. Attachment objects are never garbage-collected. |

The `markers` default wording, per media kind — each value is a `RegExp` source whose **first capture group is the path**:

- `image.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.path` — `` (?:文件已保存到|文件路径):\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.name` — `` \[收到文件:\s*([^\]\r\n]+)\] ``
- `video.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``

Marker wording is a **soft contract** with the bridge: it writes the path into prose, and the prose can change between bridge releases without notice. The patterns are configuration precisely so a wording change is a config edit rather than a plugin release.

## Tools & surfaces

```ts
inbox_list({
  limit?: number,            // default: config.maxItems
  includeTempdir?: boolean,  // only honoured when allowTempdirScan is true
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, source, inboxDir, items[], attachments, deriveMessages, emptyReason?, emptyDetail?, tempdirScan, unresolvedAttachmentBlocks }`, or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

```ts
inbox_adopt({
  path: string,              // required: exactly what inbox_list reported
  name?: string,             // default: the recovered original name
  subdir?: string,           // default: config.defaultSubdir
  channel?: 'auto' | 'fs' | 'node',
  overwrite?: boolean,       // default false: a duplicate gets a -1 suffix
  register?: boolean,        // default: config.registerAttachment
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, item }` with `hostPath`, `workspacePath`, `relativePath`, `bytes`, `sha256`, `copyMethod`, `nameRestored`, `sourceLeafName`, and `attachmentId`/`attachmentHostPath` when registered; or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

The plugin also appends one system-prompt section (`phone-inbox`, order 320) so the model knows the capability exists, and subscribes to `session/event` for `user/message` observation. Neither is required for correctness: the history read is authoritative on every call.

## Permissions & data

- **Reads** `inboxDir` and the calling session's own messages. Nothing else.
- **Writes** only inside the session workspace (`path.resolve` + a separator-aware containment check), and only when `inbox_adopt` is called.
- **Refuses** a source path that is not under `inboxDir`, a `subdir` that escapes the workspace, and a name that could traverse. The `path` argument comes from the model and is never trusted.
- **Does not scan** the shared inbox directory unless `allowTempdirScan` is explicitly enabled; when it does, every entry it contributes is st

plugins.readme_text:
# Guitar Tab Maker · 吉他谱工坊

自动扒歌 + 生成「边播放边跳和弦」的吉他跟练播放器。技能目录形式，遵循 [Agent Skills](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills) 规范（`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`），**可直接被 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）、Claude Code 等兼容 harness 加载**。

## 它做什么

输入一首歌的音频（mp3/wav/m4a/flac），输出单文件 HTML 播放器：

- 原曲音频内嵌（**不转调、不损伤音质**）
- 和弦随播放进度跳动高亮，附下一个和弦预告
- 每个和弦带指法图（开放和弦 + 大横按）
- 每小节标注扫弦箭头（8 个八分音符格）
- 歌词逐行同步、段落快捷跳转、播放变速跟练

## 工作管线

| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/fetch_lrc.py` | 双通道抓带时间轴歌词（酷我 musicId 优先，网易云兜底） |
| `scripts/analyze_song.py` | librosa 扒谱：beat 追踪 + 调内白名单 HMM/Viterbi + 小节制合并 |
| `scripts/verify_song.py` | 音频-谱面一致性校验（低频频谱根音比对），防原调标错/文件错配 |
| `scripts/build_songs.py` | 按配置重建曲库；指法和弦按 `(原调根音 − capo) mod 12` 自动换算 |
| `scripts/build_player.py` | 音频 base64 注入模板，生成单文件 HTML |
| `scripts/validate_player.py` | 成品综合校验（占位符/字段/段落索引/图库覆盖） |

## 快速开始

依赖：Python 3.10+、[ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)、Node.js（仅 harness 加载需要）。

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1) 歌词
python scripts/fetch_lrc.py --title 歌名 --artist 歌手 --kuwo-id 358603096 --out lrc.json
# 2) 扒谱（原调根音与 BPM 为粗略先验，可用网络资料）
python scripts/analyze_song.py --audio song.mp3 --key-root Bb --key-mode minor --bpm 89 --lrc lrc.json --out analysis.json
# 3) 一致性校验（必跑）
python scripts/verify_song.py --audio song.mp3 --analysis analysis.json
# 4) 写配置（参考 examples/songs.example.json）后构建
python scripts/build_songs.py --config songs.json --template assets/player_template.html --out built.html
python scripts/build_player.py --template built.html --out player.html --audio 1=song.mp3
# 5) 终验
python scripts/validate_player.py player.html
```

完整 SOP、变调夹选法与踩坑检查点见 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用

把整个目录放到 dsh 的技能发现路径即可，无需转换：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`（或 `~/.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 同根）
- 项目级：`<repo>/.agents/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`

dsh 只发现发现根下的**直接**子目录（不递归），不要嵌套两层。frontmatter 支持 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable` 两个 dsh 专属开关。

## 免责声明

- 输出为**参考级谱面**：AI 听辨的切换点可能有小偏差，可在 `SONGS` 数据中改 `t` 值自行校准。
- 本仓库**不含任何歌曲音频或歌词**；请仅对自己有权使用的内容扒谱，并自行处理版权。
- MIT License。

[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Model Reasoning Levels** — the reasoning-effort control each model entry is
missing, written straight into that model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

The shipped Models page edits a model's `id`, display name, context window,
max-output tokens and input types, and deliberately edits **no** reasoning
effort: effort is a per-*model* capability while that editor is per-*provider*.
This plugin adds the missing control **inside each model entry** — directly
under the id/name line, or under the expanded context-window/input-types area —
and converts the selection into the model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `settings.models.provider-card` (keyed `llm-pi-ai`) | reaches each pi-ai provider card, discovers its model rows, and portals a per-model effort editor into every model entry — hand-declared routes included |
| Locale namespace `dsh-model-reasoning-levels` | English and Simplified Chinese copy |
| `scripts/reasoning-efforts.mjs` | validates a selection and prints the `reasoningEfforts` YAML and the settings path op it becomes |

Browser half only: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists so the Loader row can
carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`). No route, no service, no Config.

## What it looks like

```
Settings → Models → Baidu Team → Customized settings → Models
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [deepseek-v4.1-flash] [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash]       ⌄   🗑   │
│ Reasoning effort levels              Inherited              │
│ [Off] [Minimal] [Low] [Medium] [High] [XHigh] [Max]        │
│ Low wire value: low   High wire value: high                 │
│ [Inherit catalog] [Non-reasoning] [Apply]  { off: null, … } │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

![The Reasoning effort levels control appended inside a model entry on the Settings → Models page](docs/images/reasoning-levels-row.png)

*The control inside one model entry: the seven level chips, one wire-value field
per selected thinking level, **Inherit catalog** / **Non-reasoning** / **Apply**,
and the exact `reasoningEfforts` value the current selection becomes.*

## How the control reaches the row

The shipped page declares **no seat inside a model row**, and its `ModelRow` is
an internal component. The only sanctioned row-level change is shadowing the
whole `settings.section` `models` entry — a shadowed copy of the page. This plugin takes
the narrower path instead: it owns the provider-card seat, then discovers each
model row structurally.

- The row's id input carries an `aria-label` built from the shipped page's own
  `settings.models` locale namespace (`Model ID 1`, `模型 ID 1`, …). The plugin
  binds that namespace and matches the label, so discovery follows the active
  language and never depends on a hashed CSS class name.
- It appends one container per `modelEntry` and portals a React editor into it,
  so the control lives inside the model entry and disappears with the row.
- A `MutationObserver` re-runs discovery when the fold opens, a row is added or
  removed, or the page re-renders. A shipped row restructure would need the
  selector updated.

### Saving, and the page's own Apply

The editor writes through the settings transport (`settings.mutate` path ops);
the host persists the result. The shipped page keeps its **own draft** of the
model list and its own Apply writes the whole `models` array for a hand-declared
route, which can restore the `reasoningEfforts` value the card loaded at open.

To keep the editor's value authoritative, the row remembers the declaration the
user applied and, if a later settings change reverts it, writes it again — up to
three times, so a refusal is reported instead of retried forever. Applying the
effort and then using the card's Apply for another field therefore converges on
the effort value you chose.

For a catalog route the editor uses the narrow
`providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts` path, which the page's
model editor does not touch — unless the page materializes a `models` array (by
editing the model list), which the adapter refuses beside `modelOverrides`. The
row's re-apply covers that case while the card is open.

## The level vocabulary is closed and ordered

`off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` — exactly the harness's own
`THINKING_LEVELS`, in escalation order. The editor always emits the map in that
order, whatever order the chips were clicked. `off` means "do not think"; the
other six are thinking levels.

## The conversion rules (they are the adapter's)

Each chosen level becomes a key whose value is the spelling dispatch sends, so a
gateway with its own vocabulary can be renamed (`max: ultra`). The plugin
enforces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `resolveModelReasoning` rules before the
write:

| Selection | Result |
|---|---|
| `off, low, high, max` with wire values | `{ off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }` |
| `off` alone | refused — a model that cannot think uses `false` |
| nothing selected | refused — omit the field to inherit |
| a non-`off` level with no wire value | refused — it needs the value dispatch sends |
| an empty-string wire value | refused |
| a level outside the seven | refused |
| the "Non-reasoning" form | `reasoningEfforts: false` |
| the "Inherit catalog" form | the field is unset, restoring inheritance |

A declared map **replaces** the model's capability set: levels not declared are
not offered. That is why `off` must be present in the map when the user keeps
it, and why "off only" is `false` rather than `{ off: null }`.

## Where the value lands in `cordis.patch.yml`

The editor writes settings path ops; the host persists them into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. `reasoningEfforts` sits beside the fields the shipped row
already edits:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            reasoningEfforts: { off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 256000
            input: [text, image]
            name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
```

The expanded spelling is equivalent and easier to hand-edit:

```yaml
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              low: 'low'
              high: 'high'
              max: 'max'
```

A model that cannot think, and one that keeps the installed catalog capability:

```yaml
          - id: acme-plain
            reasoningEfforts: false      # no selector beyond off
          - id: acme-catalog
            contextWindow: 128000        # reasoningEfforts omitted -> inherits
```

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

**PHM evidence chain** — aggregate ledger: [phm-evidence-ledger](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/phm-evidence-ledger) (5,000,086,001 units, four layers, open metrics + SHA-256 manifest) · method parent: [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) (AgentDojo-validated) · [PHM-Audit profile](https://github.com/PHM-Audit)

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-prompt-drift] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-prompt-drift` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party prompt-surface pinning, this freezes at its last
working version with a postmortem here.

plugins.description: Interview users one frontier at a time: a grill-me skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness (MIT, independent implementation of mattpocock/skills grill-me)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-grill-me

DSH 插件：把 `mattpocock/skills` 里的 **grill-me / grilling** 技能做成能装、能跑、而且**确定性生效**的 DSH 插件，并把同一份上游里的 **grill-with-docs / domain-modeling** 一起移植进来 —— 后两个额外加了一条**文档通道**：访谈过程中答应的 ADR / 术语表只要没落盘，就不算谈完。

上游 grill-me 是一段提示词：它要求模型把计划当成一棵**设计树**来审问，一轮把整个 **frontier**（前提已落定、现在就能问的决策）一次问完，每题给出推荐答案，然后**等用户回答**；只有 frontier 为空、并且用户确认达成共识之后，才允许动手。

提示词会被模型忘记。这个插件在提示词之外加了一层**确定性的状态机**：它从会话记录（transcript）里推导当前处于第几轮、哪些问题还没答、frontier 是否为空，然后

- 在模型每一步之前注入当前 frontier 的状态指令（并且每一步只保留一份，不重复堆叠）；
- 在模型违反协议时（比如刚问完一轮就跑去调工具、装依赖、动手改文件）用一次纠偏消息把它拉回来；
- `grill-with-docs` 模式下另记一本**文档账**：模型用 `📄 ADR: <标题>` / `📄 术语: <词>` 承诺要写的文件，没写就不给「访谈完成」；
- 提供 `/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 两条命令和 `grill_status` 工具，让你随时查看面试进度。

状态机是纯函数、只读转录、无副作用；所有判断都能用会话记录复现。

## 安装（从 GitHub）

插件本体零依赖，装的是一个真正的 bundle 包（`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle`，挂载行写在自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，**不需要手改 profile 任何文件**）。

```powershell
# 把 <profile> 换成你的 profile 名（桌面版通常就是 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/huang2005-hj/dsh-plugin-grill-me/releases/download/v0.4.0/dsh-plugin-grill-me-0.4.0.tgz
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后在插件管理里确认 `dsh-plugin-grill-me` 处于启用状态。装好后 `skills` 目录里会出现 `grill-me`、`grilling`、`grill-with-docs`、`domain-modeling` 四个技能，`/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 两条命令与 `grill_status` 工具随即可用。

- 想核对拿到的东西没被改过：同一页 release 里的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 列出了两个资产的 SHA256，装之前对一下即可。
- 想连源码一起拿：同一页 release 里的 `grill-me-dsh-src-0.4.0.zip`（13 个文件，解压后 `node test/state.test.mjs` 即可复跑测试，零依赖、不需要 `npm install`）。
- 也可直接从仓库安装（拉源码）：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:huang2005-hj/dsh-plugin-grill-me`。

## 装法（本机开发用）

```powershell
# 1) 打包（插件本体零依赖，直接就是可安装目录）
cd <仓库根目录>

# 2) 用 DSH 的 plugin_manager 装进当前 profile（本地目录）
#    在 DSH 会话里让模型调用 plugin_manager：
#      action=install_bundle, target=<本地目录或 npm 包名>
```

装好后 `desktop` profile 的 `patchReload: "live"` 会让它立即生效；`skills` 目录里出现 `grill-me`、`grilling`、`grill-with-docs`、`domain-modeling` 四个技能。

## 用法

| 入口 | 谁触发 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/grill-me` | 用户 | 上游的 wrapper：只负责加载 `grilling`。**模型不会自己调用它**（`modelInvocable: false`，等价于上游的 `disable-model-invocation: true`）。 |
| `/grill-with-docs` | 用户 | 上游的 wrapper：先 `grilling` 再 `domain-modeling`，也就是「拷问 + 把定下来的东西当场写成 ADR / 术语表」。同样 `modelInvocable: false`。 |
| `/grilling`、`/domain-modeling`、`skill` 工具、触发词 | 用户 / 模型 | 两个协议本体：`grilling` 是访谈，`domain-modeling` 是文档纪律（术语表 + ADR）。 |
| `grill_status` | 模型 | 只读工具：返回当前轮次、未答问题、文档欠账、已记录到的违规。 |
| `/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 命令 | 用户 | 打印当前面试状态（后者多一行文档通道）。 |

典型过程：

```
你: /grill-me 帮我审一下「把本地缓存换成 SQLite」这个计划

模型: ❓ **Q1** - **<问题标题>**：<正文>
      ➡️ <推荐答案>
      ---
      ❓ **Q2** - **<问题标题>**：<正文>
      ➡️ <推荐答案>
      （一轮问完，停下等你回答）

你: 1 是，2 选 B，3 你看着办
（插件记为：这一轮已回答）
模型: ❓ **Q3** ...（下一轮 frontier）
...
frontier 为空 → 你说一句「确认」（`可以了`/`没问题`/`开始吧`/`确认理解，开始吧` 之类都行，光秃秃一个 `确认` 也算）→ 此时才允许动手；这句确认**认下就不会被撤回**，之后你再说别的话也不会把它顶掉
```

## 文档通道（grill-with-docs）

上游把这条链拆成两个技能：`grill-with-docs` 只是「先 `grilling`、再 `domain-modeling`」，`domain-modeling` 才是文档纪律本身。上游自己的长文里记着一个已知故障：**文件写入静默不发生** —— 访谈谈完了，答应要写的 ADR 和术语表一个字都没落盘。这个插件把那一半也变成确定性的：

- 模型在正文里用 `📄 ADR: <标题>` / `📄 术语: <词>` 声明要写的东西。**引用不算承诺**：代码块和引用块里的标记不记账。
- 声明即欠账。只有真的调了写文件类工具、且目标路径命中 `docs/adr/**` 或 `**/GLOSSARY.md`，这笔账才算还清。`GLOSSARY-MAP.md`（多上下文索引）算文档、写它不会被纠偏，但它不是术语表，顶不了任何一笔账。连「哪个标题对应哪个文件」都按**文件自己的名字**（去掉目录和 `NNNN-` 前缀）做 slug 匹配：标题完全一致优先，否则取最长的那个能被文件名包含的标题 —— 所以「Use JSON」抢不走「Use JSON for storage」的那次写入。写得对不对、值不值得写，插件**不**判断：那是 `domain-modeling` 三条判据（难回退 / 没上下文会让人困惑 / 是真实取舍）的事，机器只保证「你说要写的，最后必须写出来」。
- 欠账未清时，就算 frontier 空了、你也确认了，模型也拿不到「访谈完成、可以动手」：指令改成列出这些欠账，模型跑去做别的（纯文档写之外的动作）会被纠偏一次。同一步里既写了文档又写了代码算这笔账还清（文件在步骤结束时确实存在），不纠偏；读不出目标路径的写操作既不算还账也不判违规 —— 拿不准时宁可不纠，也不要冤枉一个已经把文档写出来的模型。
- 只有 `grill-with-docs` 模式有这本账；`/grill-me` 与 `grilling` 完全不谈文档，与上游一致。
- 上游 ADR 模板本体只有「标题 + 1–3 句」，`Status` / `Considered Options` / `Consequences` 都是可选段 —— 它也明说多数决策不配 ADR，一次访谈零 ADR 也是正常结果。

## 它到底“确定性”在哪里

- **轮次记账**：`src/state.js` 解析助手消息里的 `❓ **Qn**` 与 `➡️`，得出每一轮的问题清单。**只有带上协议自己的题头**（`❓` 或 `Qn - **标题**`）才算是「问了一轮」：普通行文里写 `Q1: … Q5: …`（季度、清单、复述刚才的问题）不算，否则模型会把自己的正文当真问题、再被指令喂回来，变成没有用户输入也会无限自转的假面试。
- **逐题记账**：一轮之后的第一条真实用户消息按题号逐题结算 —— `1 是` 记成「接受推荐」、`3 选 B` 记成「改选」、回答复述了该题自己的推荐答案（`3 no auth` 对 `➡️ No auth yet`）也算接受、**没提到的题仍然开放**，所以一轮里 Q2 没答不会被 Q1/Q3 带走。题号识别有三条通路：`Q2: …` 这种显式标签、`1 a 2 b 3 c` 这种严格递增 run，以及 `1是2两边都发3同意` 这种数字直接粘在答案上的写法（每个数字都必须真的是本轮还在开放的问题）。不做语义猜测：题号对不上本轮问题就整轮不动；而**只有**「纯肯定」（`都可以` / `yes to all three`）或本轮只剩 1 题还开放时，才会整轮一次性结清，其他没有题号的回复保持本轮开放、绝不替用户做决定。
- **确认要认账**：frontier 清空之后，`CONFIRM_RE`（`确认理解`/`全部确认`/`没问题`/`开始吧`…）算确认；**整条消息就是一个接受词**（`确认`/`同意`/`好的`/`ok`…）也算，不需要模型先写出「共享理解」那种仪式措辞（`GRILL-28`：用户打了一句光秃秃的 `确认`，插件却继续让模型等着）。更关键的是这句确认**属于说出它的那条消息**：0.3.2 每步都按「最新一条人话」重算，于是你确认完随手说一句无关的话（哪怕只是「重启了」），状态就退回 `awaiting-confirmation`，插件又开始劝模型「别动手，等确认」——正好和你的意思相反（`GRILL-30`）。0.3.3 把确认闩在它自己的 seq 上，只有在它之后**又有新一轮问题被回答**（或你给了更新的确认）时才失效；`grill_status` 会额外报出 `confirmedAtSeq`，你能看到这条确认是哪句话给的。
- **注入**：`agent/pre-step` 里若面试处于活动状态，插件追加一条 `source.kind = 'grill-me'` 的指令消息；同一步里已存在则原地替换，绝不重复堆叠。
- **纠偏**：`agent/turn-stopping` 里若检测到「问完一轮却去执行动作」，插件 `agent.steer(...)` 一条纠偏消息，强制同一轮内再走一步。纠偏预算按**违规本身**记账（`violationKey`：同一次动作、同一轮缺推荐都只纠 1 次）—— 0.2.0 按 `(agent, turn)` 记账，而每次 steer 都会开出新的 turn，于是同一条旧违规会不停把自己再喂一遍，没有用户输入也会无限自转；0.3.0 修掉了这个自转。**0.3.1 修掉了让纠偏形同虚设的那一步**（`GRILL-27`）：纠偏消息本身也是 `source.kind = 'grill-me'`，会被 `agent/pre-step` 的「原地替换」逻辑当成旧指令吞掉、换成一条全新的指令 —— 模型因此永远读不到自己刚违反了哪条规则，转录里连一条 `form = 'correction'` 的消息都不存在。现在只有 `form = 'directive'` 的插件消息会被替换，纠偏消息原样送进模型，旁边仍只有一条新指令。
- **不误伤**：普通英文里出现的 “grill / grilling” 不会激活面试，插件自己的名字也**不再**算激活词（光是提到 `grill-me` 这个插件、队友复述它的指令、转录里引用一段文档，都不该把人拖进面试）。只有**人自己写的** `/grill-me`、`/grilling`、`/grill-with-docs`、中文触发词（拷问/盘问/质询/逼问/压力测试/grill 我），或者宿主明确标记的技能调用（`skill` 工具加载 `grilling` / `grill-with-docs`）才会激活；`domain-modeling` 单独加载**不**激活访谈（它只是文档纪律，不是访谈模式）。激活后一直有效，直到 `/grill-stop`、`stop grilling`、`不用问了` 之类的收尾词。

## 文件

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/state.js` | 纯状态机：`projectEvents` / `analyze` / `renderDirective` / `renderStatus` / `describeViolation`，以及文档账（`parseDocDeclarations` / `classifyDocPath` / `isWriteTool`）。零依赖。 |
| `src/skill.js` | 四个技能的正文与描述（两个 wrapper + `grilling`、`domain-modeling` 两个协议本体）。 |
| `lib/index.js` | Cordis 插件入口：注册四个技能、`grill_status` 工具、两条命令，挂 `agent/pre-step` 与 `agent/turn-stopping`。 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch：把这个包挂进 loader 树。 |
| `test/` | 状态机对抗测试 + 冒烟测试。 |

## 设计约束（踩过的坑）

- 插件**不能** `import '@deepseek-ai/*'`：profile 的 `node_modules` 里没有这个 scope，宿主包都打包在 app.asar 内。所以消息构造用 `src/state.js` 里自带的 `makeUserMessage`（形状与宿主 `createUserMessage` 一致）。
- `agent/pre-step` 的 `{kind:'reject'}` 会让整个 turn 以 `blocked` 结束，可能把已经产生的工具结果悬空 —— 插件因此**只用 `enter` 注入，从不 reject**，纠偏交给 `turn-stopping` + `steer`。
- 技能名必须匹配 `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`，所以中文只出现在 `description` / 正文里。

## 卸载

`plugin_manager` 里 disable/remove 这个 bundle 即可；插件在 `apply` 里注册的 disposer 会随 Cordis 卸载自动回收。
