plugins.readme_text:
# 幸运方块 (dsh-lucky-block)

一个 dsh 插件，同时工作在 dsh web 与 dsh desktop。两件事：

1. **幸运方块选项** —— AI 向你提选择题时，每个问题的选项末尾会自动多出一个「幸运方块」。
   选它，就随机替你挑一个选项、或把几个选项揉成一个新方案，全随机。
   不满意？说一句「回滚」（或打 `/rollback`），立刻回到上一版本。
2. **幸运方块按钮** —— 屏幕角落一个可拖动、可锁定的我的世界幸运方块（16×16 原版方块面贴图）。
   闲着没事就戳它一下：**左键单点**零成本，抽弹窗表演 / 假蓝屏 / 今日运气 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话；
   **长按** 1.4 秒挖穿它，伴随裂纹、碎裂粒子和原版 Minecraft 挖石头声，接着它会在你的
   默认工作区自动开一个新会话，**全程不需要你做任何事**地随机写篇论文 / 扒几条新闻 / 发明个东西。
   松手时方块若离屏幕边缘够近（48px 以内）会**自动吸附贴边**。

它会说话。所有随机事件都套着一层固定的说话腔调：短句、机器口吻、偶尔损你一句。
这套腔调是纯文本的，参数在 `lib/persona.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PERSONA` 里，
可以用配置里的 `persona` 整段换成你自己写的性格。
它**从不往会话里写东西**，所以绝不会污染你的对话历史。

## 两个池：单击零成本，长按才花钱

脚本现在分成**两个互相独立的池**，触发方式不同，抽的东西也不同：

| 触发 | 代价 | 池 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **左键单点** | 零 token、零延迟、**不建会话** | 弹窗 / 蓝屏 / 抽签 / 冷知识 / 冷笑话 / 音乐 |
| **长按挖满**（1.4 秒） | 开新会话、调模型 | 论文 / 新闻 / 待办整理 |

单点是手滑也会发生的动作，所以它不该有成本；长按是明确意图，才值得花 token。
分成两个池而不是一个池加过滤，是为了让两边的权重能独立调节 —— 否则往单击池
里加十条音频，会把长按事件的命中率一起稀释掉。

### 单击池（10 个事件，权重合计 20）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10.0% | 无害弹窗表演 | 视觉 | 连弹 24 个无意义提示框（三种皮轮转：老式错误框 / Win11 通知卡 / 朴素框），再按创建顺序倒序全部关掉 |
| 10.0% | 蓝屏屏保（60 秒） | 视觉 | 全屏显示仿 Windows 蓝屏，三张脸随机一张，60 秒后自动恢复 |
| 15.0% | 抽今日运气 | 本地 | 抽一档签文：鸿运齐天 / 大吉 / 中吉 / 小吉 / 顺 / 平 / 凶。**不调 AI**，附「无科学依据，仅供参考」 |
| 20.0% | 随机冷知识闲聊 | 本地 | 从 818 条本地冷知识库里抽 1~3 条，一次说完 |
| 15.0% | 冷笑话专场 | 本地 | 从 353 条本地笑话库里抽 1~2 条 |
| 10.0% | Never Gonna Give You Up | 本地 | 放 42 秒副歌（唯一不是完整版的一首） |
| 5.0% | Who's Ready for Tomorrow | 本地 | 放完整版 112 秒 |
| 5.0% | I Really Want to Stay at Your House | 本地 | 放完整版 241 秒 |
| 5.0% | My Shot | 本地 | 放完整版 328 秒 |
| 5.0% | Satisfied | 本地 | 放完整版 330 秒 |

### 长按池（3 个事件，权重合计 8）

| 概率 | 事件 | 类型 | 会做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 37.5% | 随机选题写论文 | AI | 随机词条拼出题目（如「边缘计算 × 古籍数字化 × 的鲁棒性研究」），写 4 节正文并落盘到 `lucky-block-papers/<hash>.md` |
| 37.5% | 时事新闻速览 | AI | **联网**检索 3 条最近真实新闻，每条一句事实 + 一句点评 + 来源链接；查不到就直说，绝不编 |
| 25.0% | 随机发明一个东西 | AI | 发明一样**不存在**的东西：起名 + 解决什么问题 + 怎么工作 + 最明显的副作用，像正经产品说明 |

**单击池十个全部零 token、不建会话、零延迟** —— 点下去立刻有反应。

### 全部单击事件都能按 ESC 提前结束

单击池的十种表演，**回车同效**：按一下 ESC，屏幕上正在放的东西立刻收干净 ——
弹窗不再继续弹、蓝屏直接恢复、音乐立刻停、居中长文立刻消失。
单击池里最长的表演是 330 秒的歌，没有这个出口的话，点错一次就得等五分半。

实现上是一张**登记表**（`registerEscape`），不是「当前表演」单槽：
一次单击可能同时起好几样（蓝屏 + 方块台词、音乐 + 标题、长文 + 气泡），
单槽会让后起的挤掉先起的，先起的那样就再也关不掉了。

**没有表演在放的时候，ESC 完全不拦截** —— 直接放行给 dsh 自己用。
方块头顶那行小气泡故意不登记（它只占一角、6 秒自己消失，
为了它吞掉 ESC 会让用户 6 秒内关不掉 dsh 的任何东西）。

「抽今日运气」**一天只抽一次**：当天再点，返回的还是那一签，并在末尾注明
「今天已经抽过了，明天再来吧。」。状态记在
`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/fortune-state.json`，删掉这个文件就等于当天重抽。

「抽今日运气」的签文权重是刻意偏吉的：**吉类合计 87%**（鸿运齐天 5% / 大吉 26% /
中吉 33% / 小吉 23%），顺 8%，平 4.9%，凶只有 **0.1%**；
而且**「凶」的正文是反着写的**（「从某种角度来说，你运气还挺好 —— 今天该踩的坑都提前踩完了」），
抽到下签也能笑一下。这个插件是用来打发时间的，不是用来给人添堵的。

「顺」是后加的第五档，插在「小吉」和「平」之间：小吉是**有件小事让你高兴**，
平是**什么都没有**，顺是**没有好事、但也没有坎**。
它比平多一分安心，比小吉少一件好事，所以平从 9.9% 让位到 4.9%。

### 音频事件

**一首歌一条事件**，所以每首能单独关掉。事件 id 由文件名派生：
`never-give-you-up.ogg` → `audio-never-give-you-up`。想永久关掉某一首，
在面板里取消勾选，或在 `config.json` 的 `events` 里写 `"audio-never-give-you-up": { "enabled": false }`。

用文件名而不是曲名当 id，是因为 id 要进 config 覆盖层、还要过
`/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/` 的白名单（曲名里有中文和空格过不了）；
这样即使以后改了 `title`，覆盖配置也不会悄悄失效。

每首歌的权重默认是 **1**，不写 3：曲目数会随加歌增长，写死 3 的话加满十首
就会把冷知识/冷笑话的命中率稀释掉一半。想单独调某一首，在
`lib/audio-tracks.json` 那条里写 `"weight": 2`（包里 `never-give-you-up` 就是 2）。

`lib/audio-tracks.json` 里是曲库，往这个 json 填
`{ "file": "xxx.ogg", "title": "显示名", "weight": 2 }`、
把文件丢进 `lib/audio/`，事件就自动开始参与抽取 —— **不用改代码**。
文件名只接受 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` + `.ogg|.mp3`，防目录穿越。

曲库有两份查找位置，**用户目录优先**：先看
`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/audio-tracks.json`，没有再退回随包的
`lib/audio-tracks.json`。第三方想扩展曲库时不用改插件包本体（插件升级会覆盖回去）。

包里带了五首，**除了 Never Gonna Give You Up 是副歌，其余四首都是完整版**：

| 曲目 | 时长 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Never Gonna Give You Up | 42 秒 | 副歌（唯一一首切过的） |
| Who's Ready for Tomorrow | 112 秒 | 完整版，去掉结尾 4 秒静音 |
| I Really Want to Stay at Your House | 241 秒 | 完整版，去掉结尾 6 秒静音 |
| My Shot | 328 秒 | 完整版 |
| Satisfied | 330 秒 | 完整版，去掉开头 26 秒黑胶底噪 |

这五首都能按 ESC 立刻停（见上一节），所以完整版不会变成「点一下就得等五分半」。

切法写在 [`lib/audio/README.md`](<lib/audio/README.md>)。

### 骰子会话里你只会看到一行字

开新会话的那 3 个事件，**用户消息只有一行**（`🎲 随机事件：时事新闻速览`），
人格设定和任务正文走的是**系统提示**，不会糊在你眼前。

这样做纯粹是为了观感 —— 之前用户消息里塞着几百字的指令墙，点进会话第一眼就是它。
需要说明的是，宿主没有「发一条不显示的消息」这种能力（`PromptContentPart` 只有
text / image / file 三种，没有任何可见性字段），所以这里不是把消息藏起来，
而是**根本不把它发成消息**。

清单可用 `node tools/list-events.mjs` 随时重新生成 —— 它直接从 `lib/index.js`
的 `buildEvents()` 里解析并按池分组，不会和代码漂移。

## 设置面板（右键方块 → 设置…）

| 开关 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长按挖掘音效 | 循环挖掘声 + 碎裂声。关掉就完全静音 |

面板分三块：

**方块外观** —— 大小（24~128 像素）、图案（幸运方块 / 命令方块 / TNT / 南瓜 /
自定义图片）、圆角、描边宽度与颜色、投影、背景。改动**立即生效并落盘**，
不用点保存。图片只接受 `data:image/` 或 `http(s)://` 开头的地址——
`blob:` 在这个缓存域里用不了、`file:` 会被 CSP 拦下来，两种都会让图片裂开。
「恢复默认」走的和手动改是同一套校验，所以恢复回来的一定是能用的值。

**随机事件** —— 每条事件一个复选框加一个权重输入框。**关掉一条事件时权重会同时写 0**，
两个字段说同一件事，不会出现「权重还在但事件没了」的假象。权重上限 25
（「每条事件最多占四分之一」的量级，再大就没有意义了）。

**扩展接口** —— 只读显示 `persona` 与 `prompts` 这两段配置的当前值。
刻意不做成编辑器：JSON 精度要求高，直接粘贴整段更稳；
而且这里显示的是宿主回传的当前值，上一段写坏了重新打开看到的还是那段坏内容，
不会被悄悄换成默认值。

改事件权重/开关**需要重启 dsh 才生效**：事件池在插件加载时就建好了。
刻意不做热重载 —— 每个事件都带着自己的 prompt 与 prepare 逻辑，
热替换等于在运行期换掉一整套行为定义。

### 自定义事件（扩展点）

往 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-lucky-block/custom-events.json` 写一个数组，
就能加自己的事件。形状和内置事件一致：

```json
[
  { "id": "my-quote", "title": "随机一句书摘", "weight": 2,
    "trigger": "click", "kind": "local",
    "lines": ["第一句", "第二句"] },
  { "id": "my-summary", "title": "让 AI 总结点什么", "weight": 3,
    "trigger": "hold", "kind": "agent",
    "prompt": "随便挑一个话题，写三百字。" }
]
```

`kind: 'local'` + `lines` 从里面随机挑一行当正文（**零 token**）；
`kind: 'agent'` + `prompt` 把 prompt 当任务发进新会话（走 AI）。

**任何一条不合格就整份忽略**，原因显示在设置面板底部 ——
半份生效会让「我加的事件怎么没动静」变成一个只能靠读日志排查的问题。
没有这个文件是完全正常的状态（面板会写「0 条」）。

自定义事件的 id **不能和内置事件重名**：重名时内置赢，
第三方文件无法覆盖内置行为。原因是内置事件的 prompt 与 prepare 都在代码里写死，
一个只带 id/weight 的 JSON 造不出真的行为。

面板里还列着事件清单，每条事件标着它属于**单击**还是**长按** ——
照着这张表就知道点一下会发生什么、要不要花 token。

冷知识和冷笑话现在**固定走本地库**，不再有「调不调 AI」的开关：
它们本来就在单击池里，单击不该有成本，给一个勾选框只会让人以为这里能省钱。

| 本地库 | 条数 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 冷笑话 + 点评 | 353 条 + 30 条 | `lib/jokes-data.json` |
| 冷知识 | 818 条（人体 133 / 动物 139 / 科学 121 / 日常 111 / 历史 111 / 地理 103 / 语言 100） | `lib/trivia-data.json` |
| 曲库 | 3 首（42 / 37 / 54 秒） | `lib/audio-tracks.json` + `lib/audio/` |

冷知识库里分主题存的 `topic` **只用于统计，永远不显示给用户** —— 显示主题等于
把「这是一条从哪抽的」直接摊开。笑话的 `form` 字段同理。

两个库的**完整内容**可以在 [`lib/语料库总览.md`](<lib/语料库总览.md>) 里逐条翻阅；
那份文件由 `node tools/build-corpus-overview.mjs` 从运行库生成，改动语料后重跑即可
（`--check` 用于回归时校验它没过期）。

写进配置也会被忽略并记一条警告。

配置里 `events` 字段是事件的权重/开关覆盖层（读-改-写，不整份覆盖 ——
`model` / `persona` 也在同一个文件里）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "events": {
    "trivia": { "weight": 8 },
    "paper": { "enabled": false },
    "joke": { "weight": 0 }
  }
}
```

只认两个字段，都是可选的：写哪个改哪个，没写的保持原样。
`weight` 会夹到 [0, 25]，**0 等价于关掉**。
用户侧配置里的事件 id 只接受小写字母/数字/横杠（挡 `__proto__` 之类的怪东西），
大写、下划线、点号一律忽略。

设置写在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json`，是**手写与界面共用的同一个文件**
（界面保存走读-改-写，不会抹掉你手写的 `model` / `persona`）：

```json
{
  "sound": true,
  "model": { "provider": "workbuddy", "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash", "reasoningEffort": "low" }
}
```

`localOnly` 已经没有了 —— 冷知识/冷笑话现在无条件走本地库，见上面「设置面板」一节。
老配置里留着这个字段不会报错，只是被忽略。

## 安装（本地开发）

```bash
# 方式一：直接指向本目录（plugin-manager 支持本地 spec）
#   在插件市场里「安装」填本目录的绝对路径

# 方式二：npm 打包后按包装
npm pack
```

装完后**不需要**动 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`：宿主侧条目由本包
`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动插入，profile 的 patch 里再加一条同 id 的
`- insert:` 反而会造成组装冲突、让插件加载不上（实测踩过）。

只要确认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有
`"dsh-lucky-block"`（插件市场安装会自动加；手动装则加这一行）。

`"patchReload": "live"`（profile 自带）让 `cordis.patch.yml` 热生效；但**改动
`bundles` 列表必须重启 dsh**才生效。

> ⚠️ **改 `lib/` 下的任何 JS 都必须重启 dsh。** 宿主侧插件代码没有热重载 ——
> 正在跑的进程内存里持有旧模块，代码改了行为不会变。这个坑骗过一整轮排查：
> 源码里已经搜不到某段字符串，会话里却还在出现它，最后才发现是进程跑的是旧代码。
> 客户端那半（`lib/client.js`）刷新页面即可，但桌面端要重启宿主才会重新收集注入行。

## 可选配置：给骰子会话单独指定模型

**默认不启用**，骰子会话直接沿用你的默认模型。想让随机事件跑便宜/快的模型时，
在 `%DSH_HOME%\plugins\dsh-lucky-block\config.json` 写（这个字段只能手写，设置面板里没有）：

```json
{
  "model": {
    "provider": "workbuddy",
    "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "reasoningEffort": "low"
  }
}
```

`reasoningEffort` 可省略。`provider` / `model` 必须**精确匹配**可用目录里的名字
（目录拿不到时会跳过切换、不影响掷骰子），不确定就先用 `/dice` 命令观察日志。

> ⚠️ **为什么默认关着**：宿主只提供会话级 `sessionController.selectModel`，而它
> 成功后会把这次选择**异步写成 profile 的全局默认模型**。也就是说开启本配置后，
> 第一次掷骰子会顺带把你的

# dsh-agent-quant-cn

国内市场量化系统的**工具面**：把 CTP 模拟盘的操作暴露成会话内可直接调用的 DSH 工具。 它自己不实现任何策略或连接逻辑——那些在 `projects/self/agent-quant/`（Python 数值层 + JSON CLI）。 本插件只做「工具面 → 取凭据 → CLI → Python」这一层薄转发。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-quant-cn": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-agent-quant-cn name: dsh-agent-quant-cn ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`quant_ctp_status` → 应返回模拟盘交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 ## 能力（工具） | 工具 | 作用 | 底层 | |---|---|---| | `quant_ctp_status` | CTP 模拟盘体检：交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 | `ctp_cli.py ctp_status` | | `quant_ctp_account` | 资金与持仓明细（不做连接体检） | `ctp_cli.py ctp_account` | **故意不提供 `ctp_quote`（行情）**：`mdapi` 在该 CLI 内会段错误（0xC0000005，见任务板 `t-d6ac0958`）。 状态回包里如实披露 `market_data.status = KNOWN_BLOCKER`，不把它包装成一个看起来能用的工具。 行情数据请走回测侧（akshare）。 ## 配置 | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 只认显式 `false`——未配置视为启用 | | `ctpPython` | `E:\alice\.dsh\venvs\ctp-win\Scripts\python.exe` | **必须**是 Windows 侧 venv | | `ctpCliPath` | `E:\alice\projects\self\agent-quant\scripts\ctp_cli.py` | JSON CLI | | `ctpUser` | `20661` | openctp 公开测试账号（**非密**） | | `ctpBroker` | `9999` | openctp TTS 柜台 | | `vaultScript` | `E:\alice\projects\self\alice-identity\scripts\vault.ps1` | 取值脚本（DPAPI） | | `vaultSite` | `openctp-7x24` | vault 条目名 | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次调用超时 | ⚠ **路径是锚点不是真源**（AGENTS.md §5.16）：换机、换 venv 位置时改配置，不要改代码。 ## 运行环境 - **CTP 必须跑 Windows venv**（`ctp-win`：Python 3.12 + `openctp-ctp` 6.7.11，已 `openctp-channels switch tts`）。 CTP 预编译库在本机 WSL 上 import 即崩，且 openctp 用的是 TTS 柜台——直接用官方 CTP 库连会报 4097。 - **凭据零落盘**：口令只在「vault 取 → 注入子进程 env → 用完即弃」这条线上存在。 不进配置、不进日志、不进工具返回；错误消息里**只带 stderr，绝不带 stdout**（stdout 是明文）。 取不到时**响亮失败**（空 ≠ 拿到）——空口令冒充成功会让下游以看不出原因的登录失败告终。 ## 生效判据 挂载后在会话里直调 `quant_ctp_status`，应返回真实读数： `ok=true` / `loggedIn=true` / `settled=true`，且 `accounts` 含非空资金字段。 | 症状 | 先看哪里 | |---|---| | `vault 退出码 2` | vault 文件不存在 | | `vault 退出码 3` | DPAPI 解密失败（换用户/换机器即如此） | | `vault 返回空值` | 条目存在但没有 `password` 字段 | | `无法启动解释器` | `ctpPython` 路径腐化 | | `CLI 退出码 6` | 凭据未注入到 CLI（env 变量名对不上） | | `login 3` | 柜台拒绝——用户名或口令不对 | ## 回退 改 `E:\alice\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`：把该插件行的 `disabled` 置 `true`（配置改动约 2 秒热重载，无需重启）。 ## 边界（不可协商） - **只连模拟盘，不碰真钱**。真实下单必须主人逐次授权，且**不走本插件**。 - 不做策略、不做回测、不下单——这些能力在 Python 层，本插件不复制它们。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn && npm test ``` **22 条用例**（跑一次得到）。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.readme_text:
# 产物中心 · Artifact Center

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件：**agent 每次产出重要文件都会登记进一个跨会话的产物中心**，
> 左侧边栏提供面板，按分类 / 后缀 / 关键词即时筛选。

每个对话都在产出文件——报告 PDF、Excel 数据表、PPT、脚本、JSON——但它们散落在各会话的工作目录里，换个对话就找不到了。
本插件把「值得留下的产物」集中到一处：

- **agent 侧**：4 个工具。产出文件时调用 `artifact_save` 登记，默认**复制一份**到统一目录，原目录被清理也不丢。
- **用户侧**：左侧边栏「产物中心」面板。分类 chip + 后缀 chip + 关键词搜索，可复制路径、在文件夹中显示、删除。
- **跨会话**：索引与副本都在 `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`，所有对话共用同一份。

```
┌ 左侧边栏 ────────┐
│ 对话             │
│ 自动化任务       │
│ 产物中心   ← 面板行 │──┐
│ 插件管理         │  │
└──────────────────┘  │
                      ▼
┌ 产物中心 ───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 分类  [全部] [pdf 3] [excel 2] [code 5] …     刷新│
│ 后缀  [.pdf 3] [.xlsx 2] [.py 4] [.json 1]      │
│ 搜索标题 / 文件名 / 路径 / 备注 / 标签            │
│ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ 季度报告.pdf      PDF  2.0 MB  复制路径 显示 删除 │
│ train.py          代码 4.1 KB  …                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center

# 本地开发：link 到源码目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/artifact-center
```

也可以在插件市场（dshmarket）里搜索 `artifact-center` 一键安装。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主的插件模块走 ESM 缓存，改完源码或新装插件都需要重启才加载新代码）；
重启后左侧边栏出现「产物中心」，对 agent 说话时 `artifact_save` 等工具即可用。

## agent 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_save` | `path`（必填）、`title`、`note`、`tags[]`、`mode`（`copy` 默认 / `link`） | 登记一个产物。`copy` 会把文件复制进统一目录；`link` 只记路径不动文件 |
| `artifact_list` | `ext`、`category`、`keyword` | 列出/筛选产物，三个过滤条件可组合 |
| `artifact_stats` | — | 按分类、按后缀的计数 |
| `artifact_remove` | `id`（必填） | 删除条目。`copy` 产物连副本一起删；`link` 产物只删条目，**永不碰原文件** |

工具的返回值是结构化 JSON；`artifact_save` 的 `path` 不存在或不是文件时返回 `{ok:false,message}`，不会抛异常打断对话。

## 面板

左侧边栏「产物中心」，与工具读写同一份索引：

- **分类 chip**：`pdf` / `excel` / `ppt` / `word` / `image` / `code` / `data` / `archive` / `other`，带计数，计数为 0 且未选中的不显示。
- **后缀 chip**：按真实后缀分组（`.pdf`、`.py`、`.json`…），按数量降序。
- **搜索框**：服务端匹配标题、文件名、路径、备注、标签（输入 220ms 防抖）。
- **每行操作**：复制路径 · 在文件夹中显示（Windows `explorer /select`、macOS `open`、Linux `xdg-open`）· 删除（二次确认）。

## 数据与配置

```
~/.dsh/artifact-center/
├── index.json   # 索引：id / 原标题 / 原路径 / 存储路径 / mode / 分类 / 后缀 / 大小 / 备注 / 标签 / 所属会话 / 时间
└── files/       # copy 模式的副本
```

索引写入是串行队列（不会两个 tool 调用互相覆盖）。默认根目录是 `~/.dsh/artifact-center`，
可用插件配置 `rootDir` 覆盖：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（用户覆盖层）
- id: artifact-center
  config:
    rootDir: D:/artifacts
```

## HTTP 路由（面板的数据通道）

面板通过宿主 `webServer` 的同源路由取数据，不需要额外服务：

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/artifact-center/api/state` | GET | `?ext=&category=&keyword=` → `{ok, items, stats, rootDir, categories}` |
| `/artifact-center/api/remove` | POST | `{id}` → 删除条目 |
| `/artifact-center/api/reveal` | POST | `{id}` → 在文件管理器里定位；只接受索引里的 id，路径由服务端解析 |

三条路由都带**同源栅栏**：带跨站 `Origin` 的请求直接 403；写操作必须 `content-type: application/json`
（跨站表单这类「简单请求」不触发预检，声明 JSON 则会预检，而预检打到本路由必然 405/415）；
非浏览器调用（curl / node，没有 Origin）照常可用。`reveal` 不接受任意路径参数，所以无法被用来打开任意文件。

没有 `webServer` 的形态（纯 CLI）下，面板这段不激活，4 个工具照常工作。

## 目录结构

```
artifact-center/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 注册进 profile 的 patch 行
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：4 个工具 + 3 条同源路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：侧边栏面板行 + 面板页（window.__ModuleLoader__ 形态）
├── lib/
│   ├── defineTool.js     # 作者侧工具 DSL → 宿主 JSON Schema（零依赖，必须带）
│   └── store.js          # 索引与副本的存储层（串行写、分类规则）
└── test/
    └── local-smoke.mjs   # 离线自检：81 项断言，不需要 DSH 就能跑
```

`lib/defineTool.js` 不是可选的装饰：宿主真正加载的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，
但在 profile 里以 `link:` 安装的插件**不能 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（它们只在 app.asar 内，Node 解析不到），
所以插件必须自带一份等价实现。作者的 `parameters` 用 `required: true` 这种 DSL 写法，`output.schema: {type:'json'}` 表示无约束 JSON。

## 开发与自检

```sh
node test/local-smoke.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要启动 DSH：伪造 `ctx` / `req` / `res` 后覆盖工具行为（复制落盘、link 不复制、删除 link 不动原文件、
筛选与统计）、三条路由（含同源/方法/content-type 栅栏）、`client.js` 的装载与渲染（用 stub React 渲染空态、
有数据、筛选无命中、错误态），以及**工具 schema 必须通过宿主 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`** 这条回归护栏
（作者侧 `type:'json'` 若被原样透传，宿主 `register()` 会同步抛错，进而中断整个 `apply()`——本插件踩过这个坑）。

## 兼容性

- 面板需要 Web GUI（宿主 `webServer` 同源路由 + `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 插槽）。
- 纯 CLI 形态下工具可用，面板不显示。
- 已在本机 DSH 桌面版（Electron，Web GUI `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）上实测：面板渲染、筛选、删除、
  在文件夹中显示，以及 4 个工具均正常。

## License

MIT

---

# Artifact Center (English)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) plugin that gives every conversation a **shared artifact center**.

Agents produce files all the time — reports, spreadsheets, slides, scripts, JSON — and they end up scattered across
per-session working directories, effectively lost the moment the conversation changes. This plugin registers the
artifacts worth keeping, in one place:

- **Agent tools** — `artifact_save` (copies the file into a shared directory by default, or just records the path with
  `mode:"link"`), `artifact_list` (filter by `ext` / `category` / `keyword`), `artifact_stats`, `artifact_remove`.
- **Sidebar panel** — category chips with counts, extension chips with counts, keyword search, copy path,
  reveal in file manager, delete with confirmation.
- **Cross-session** — index and copies live in `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`, shared by every conversation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The panel talks to the host over three same-origin routes under `/artifact-center/api/`
(`state`, `remove`, `reveal`); cross-origin requests are rejected, writes require `application/json`, and `reveal`
resolves paths server-side from the index so it cannot be used to open arbitrary files.

Run `node test/local-smoke.mjs` for the dependency-free self-check (81 assertions covering the tools, the routes,
the browser bundle and the tool-schema contract).

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: Resume input budget for DeepSeek Harness: compact a restored session's history before its first request when the projection is over the ceiling.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-resume-budget

恢复一个长会话时，在第一个请求发出**之前**检查预计输入；超过阈值就先压缩一次，再发请求。

> English: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts a configurable input ceiling on the first request of a restored session. When the projected prompt is at or above `thresholdTokens` (default `100000`), it compacts the history through the harness's official overflow path before that request is assembled. The check runs once per session per process, is skipped for sessions created in this process, and never fails a turn. It adds no storage, no background work, and no model calls of its own. MIT licensed, Node.js >= 22.

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell） | ✅ | 插件本身是纯 JS。仓库脚本全部有 `.mjs` 版本：`node scripts/check.mjs` / `node scripts/dev-link.mjs`。Windows 上 `dsh` 是 `dsh.cmd` 垫片，`check.mjs` 已经处理（用一条带引号的命令行经 shell 启动，绕开 Node 对 `.cmd` 的 EINVAL 和不搜 PATHEXT 导致的 ENOENT）。**不要用 `bash scripts/check.sh`**：Git `core.autocrlf=true` 会把它检出成 CRLF，bash 会报 `set: pipefail: invalid option name`。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ | `node scripts/check.mjs`，或原有的 `bash scripts/check.sh`。`~` 展开、PATH 查找都走 POSIX 一路。 |
| Linux | ✅ | 同 macOS；这是 `scripts/*.sh` 最初针对的环境。没有平台相关的原生依赖。 |

实际验证环境：Windows 11 22H2 + Node 24.19.0（`engines` 下限是 22）。macOS/Linux 走的是同一套 `node:path`/`node:os`/`node:fs` API，但仓库没有 CI 矩阵，这两条是兼容性承诺而非实测记录。

Node 版本：`package.json` 的 `engines` 要求 **`node >= 22`**（脚本只用了 `node:` 内置模块，无第三方依赖）。

DSH 版本：本包**没有** `engines.dsh`，四个 peer 依赖都写成 `"*"` 且全部 optional：

```json
"peerDependencies": {
  "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter": "*",
  "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "*"
}
```

所以 `dsh plugin add` 不会因为版本号拒绝安装；真正的门槛是 API 是否存在：插件需要宿主提供 `agent/pre-step` 事件、`ctx.tokenMeter.measure()`、`ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded()`。本仓库在 **dsh 0.2.1-rc.2** 上实测（`dsh --version`）。harness 若缺少 `compaction` 或 `tokenMeter` 服务，插件会挂载不上而不是报错——见[排错](#排错)。

## 安装

1. 确认工具链（两个平台一样）：

   ```bash
   node --version    # 需要 v22 或更高
   dsh --version
   ```

2. 装进你要用的 profile（`web` 是最常见的；profile 不存在时 `dsh plugin` 会初始化它）：

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget
   ```

   这条命令把包装进 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`，并把它加进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。首次安装需要能访问 GitHub（pnpm 拉取 `github:` 依赖）。

3. **重启宿主进程**（完全退出再启动）。插件是在宿主启动时被 import 的，装完不会热加载：

   ```bash
   dsh web
   ```

4. 按下一节验证，或直接恢复一个历史很长的会话看效果。

**安装命令唯一的系统差异是 `DSH_HOME` 的写法**，`dsh plugin add` 本身完全一样：

| 平台 | 默认 `DSH_HOME` | profile 目录 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows（PowerShell） | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`（`$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh`） | `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web` |
| macOS（zsh） | `~/.dsh` | `~/.dsh/profiles/web` |
| Linux | `~/.dsh`（或 `$XDG` 习惯下的自定义值） | `~/.dsh/profiles/web` |

设置了 `DSH_HOME` 的话以它为准，`check.mjs` 也读同一个变量。

## 验证

在**仓库 checkout 里**运行（用仓库里的这一份；脚本本身不依赖 `lib/`）：

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs
```

装好插件后不想 clone 的话，profile 里安装的副本也有同一份脚本：

```powershell
# PowerShell
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-resume-budget\scripts\check.mjs"
```

```zsh
# zsh
node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-resume-budget/scripts/check.mjs
```

它做两件事，和 `scripts/check.sh` 完全一致：

1. 在 `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` 的组合树里找 `id: resume-budget`；
2. 找 `thresholdTokens: <期望值>`。

默认 profile 是 `web`，默认期望阈值是 `100000`（即 bundle 自带的默认值）。安装正常时应看到：

```text
$ node scripts/check.mjs
ok:   resume-budget is in the composed tree
ok:   thresholdTokens is 100000
```

如果你在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里改过阈值，把期望值作为第二个参数传进去，否则第二条会变成 `WARN`：

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
# ok:   resume-budget is in the composed tree
# ok:   thresholdTokens is 150000
```

两个参数的含义：

| 参数 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 第 1 个：profile | `web` | 要检查哪个 profile 的组合树，必须与 `dsh plugin --profile` 用的名字一致。 |
| 第 2 个：expected-threshold | `100000` | **只用于比对，不会修改任何配置**。它回答“组合树里的阈值是不是我以为的那个数”。 |

输出约定：`ok:` 表示通过；`FAIL:` 写到 stderr 且**退出码 1**（行缺失、profile 不存在、`dsh` 起不来）；`WARN:` 写到 stderr 但**退出码仍是 0**（只是阈值对不上，组合树里可能仍然是可用配置）。常见错误：

```text
FAIL: no such profile: C:\Users\you\.dsh\profiles\nope
WARN: thresholdTokens 100000 not found in the composed tree
```

`DSH_HOME` 不在默认位置时：

```powershell
# PowerShell
$env:DSH_HOME = 'D:\dsh-home'; node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
```

```zsh
# zsh
DSH_HOME=~/dsh-home node scripts/check.mjs web 150000
```

macOS / Linux 也可以用原来的 `bash scripts/check.sh web 150000`，两者输出一致。

## 配置

只有一个配置键，定义在 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config`（schemastery）：

| 键 | 类型 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thresholdTokens` | number，整数，最小 0 | `100000`（`DEFAULT_RESUME_INPUT_TOKENS`） | 恢复会话第一个请求的**预计输入**达到这个数就先压缩。`0` 表示整个策略关闭。 |

几处边界行为：`0` 关闭检查；预计输入小于阈值不压缩，**等于阈值会触发**（`>=`）。`lib/decision.js` 的 `normaliseThreshold()` 对 `undefined`、`null`、负数、`NaN`、`Infinity` 一律回退到默认 100000 而不是 0；但走 YAML 配置时，`Config` 的 `min(0)` 和 `step(1)` 会让负数、小数在校验阶段就被拒绝。

改阈值要改 profile 的用户层 patch，不是改这个仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml`（那是 bundle 的默认值，重装会被覆盖）。在你的 profile patch 里加一段按 `id` 覆盖的配置：

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: resume-budget
  config:
    thresholdTokens: 150000
```

- `id` 必须正好是 `resume-budget`（`lib/index.js` 里 `export const name = "resume-budget"`）。写错了宿主启动时只会打印 `patch: entry "..." not found` 然后继续，组合树里仍是 100000——这是最容易“以为改了其实没改”的地方。
- 改完保存：profile 的 `patchReload` 为 `live` 时宿主会热加载 patch；否则重启宿主。
- 想临时关掉整条策略，把值设成 `0`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-resume-budget
```

它会移除依赖、`dsh.profile.bundles` 里的对应项和该 profile `node_modules` 里的副本。然后**重启宿主**，插件不再被 import。

不会自动消失的东西：

- **你自己在 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里加的 `- id: resume-budget` 覆盖块**（如果你加过）。pnpm 不管这个文件；留着它每次启动都会打印 `patch: entry "resume-budget" not found` 的警告，手动删掉即可。
- 已经写进会话的压缩检查点。压缩是把历史遮罩/摘要后落盘的，卸载插件不会把旧历史恢复回来。
- profile 目录里的 `*.bak-*` 备份和 pnpm 缓存，按需自行清理。

## 排错

| 症状 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，恢复会话却没有任何变化 | 插件只在宿主**启动**时被 import；`add` 只改了 profile 的依赖和组合树，对已经跑着的进程无效 | 完全退出宿主再启动（Web 界面刷新页面不算）。启动后用 `node scripts/check.mjs` 确认行确实在组合树里。 |
| 改了 `lib/*.js`，行为没变 | 已加载的 ESM 模块不会重新求值（模块缓存），`patchReload` 只重载配置 patch，不改代码 | 重启宿主。注意安装方式：`dsh plugin add /abs/path` 是 `link:`，重启就能吃到本地改动；`github:` 安装的是 pnpm 复制到 profile 里的副本，改本仓库不会影响它，需要重新 `add`/更新依赖。 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或失败（`ETIMEDOUT`、`ECONNRESET`、`ERR_PNPM_FETCH_*`、证书错误） | `github:` 规格是交给 pnpm 的，pnpm 需要直连 github.com / codeload 拉 tarball | 给 pnpm/环境配代理（`HTTPS_PROXY`、`HTTP_PROXY` 或 `.npmrc` 的 `proxy`/`https-proxy`）后重试。内网机器可先 `git clone`，再 `dsh plugin --profile web add <本地绝对路径>` 做本地 link 安装；随后跑 `node scripts/dev-link.mjs` 让它能解析 harness 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。 |
| 阈值像是不触发（恢复大会话也没压缩） | 检查只针对**本进程内恢复或 fork 来的会话**，且每个会话只判一次；新建会话、子代理、历史很短的会话永远不会触发。`measure()` 是启发式估算，可能比你估的低。插件不弹 UI 提示，所以“没看到反应”不等于“没生效” | 先 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 或 `node scripts/check.mjs web <你的阈值>` 确认组合树里的值（patch 的 id 写错会静默保留 100000）。再临时把 `thresholdTokens` 设成 `1` 并重启，恢复一个旧会话：成功压缩后会话里会多出压缩后端写回的检查点（`dsh-compaction-basic` 的 `<compacted-summary>` 块）；若历史太短、后端返回 `null`，则什么也不会发生，这是设计。看到检查点就说明“闸门开了”，看完把阈值改回去。也可以只验证决策分支：`node -e "import('./lib/decision.js').then(({shouldCompactOnResume}) => console.log(shouldCompactOnResume({pending:true,estimatedInputTokens:150000},{thresholdTokens:100000})))"`。 |
| 与 harness 版本不匹配：`dsh` 启动报错，或 `dsh plugin add` 打印 `Plugin … is incompatible with dsh …` | 本包 peers 是 `*`，但宿主 API 可能缺失/改签名（`agent/pre-step`、`ctx.tokenMeter.measure`、`ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded`）。插件 `inject: ["compaction", "tokenMeter"]`，服务缺一个就挂载不上，通常是静默不生效 | `dsh --version` 对照；升级到 0.2.x（实测 0.2.1-rc.2，含上述两个服务和 `context-overflow` 触发分支）。harness 的兼容性检查不通过时，按提示升级插件；确要试跑可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 授予精确版本豁免。 |
| `node scripts/check.mjs` 报 `FAIL: no such profile: …` | `DSH_HOME` 或 profile 名不对 | Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，macOS/Linux 是 `~/.dsh`；profile 名必须与安装时用的一致。必要时显式设 `DSH_HOME`。 |
| `WARN: thresholdTokens … not found` 但退出码是 0 | 你在 patch 里改了阈值，却没把新值作为第二个参数传给 `check.mjs`；或 patch 的 `id` 拼错导致覆盖没生效 | `node scripts/check.mjs web <你的值>`；同时看宿主启动日志里有没有 `patch: entry "…" not found`。 |
| Windows 下 `bash scripts/check.sh` 报 `set: pipefail: invalid option name` | Git（`core.autocrlf=true`）把 `.sh` 检出成 CRLF，bash 不认这种行尾 | 用 `node scripts/check.mjs`；或 `git config core.autocrlf false` 后重新检出仓库。 |
| 在自定义 profile（没挂压缩后端或 token meter）里完全不生效 | 插件的 `inject: ["compaction", "tokenMeter"]` 永远等不到服务，宿主不会报错 | 换到带 `dsh-compaction-basic` 的 profile

plugins.description: 把腾讯 ima 知识库接进 DeepSeek Harness：在侧边栏浏览知识库与文件，并让 AI agent 自动检索、读取库内资料。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ima

[![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/ikevss/dsh-ima/)
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/ikevss/dsh-ima)

> 把腾讯 [ima](https://ima.qq.com) 的知识库接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：侧边栏浏览知识库，**agent 能自动检索并读取库内文件**。

[English](#english) · 简体中文

---

## 它解决什么问题

你在 ima 里攒了很多资料（文档、笔记、网页、录音转写…），但对话里的 agent 看不见——每次都要手动复制粘贴。

装上这个插件后：

- **侧边栏多一个「知识库 ima」**：左目录、右文件地浏览，点击直接预览
- **agent 自动知道有这个知识库**：每轮对话开头会把库清单注入上下文，模型知道「这儿有资料可查」
- **按正文内容搜索**：不记得文件叫什么名？问「我的资料里提到过 X 吗」，agent 自己去搜

## 功能一览

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 绑定 | 一键绑定：自动打开浏览器让你登录 ima，其余全自动，不需要复制粘贴 |
| 浏览 | 全部 / 共享 / 个人 三类筛选，多层文件夹 + 面包屑 |
| 预览 | PDF、Word、Excel、PPT、图片、音视频、Markdown、XMind 等在面板内直接看 |
| 文件图标 | macOS 风格 SVG 图标：访达同款蓝色文件夹 + 各类型渐变色块（PDF 红 / Word 蓝 / Excel 绿 / 播客 粉…）；左侧知识库统一用单色 macOS 文件夹 |
| 左侧分组 | 与 ima 一致的「个人知识库 / 共享知识库」折叠分组，可一键去 ima 新建 |
| 更新时间 | 文件行预留了最后更新时间列；ima 官方接口暂未提供该字段，开放后自动显示 |
| 笔记排版 | ima 的笔记接口只返回一段**展平过的纯文本**（段落边界在服务端就丢了）；插件按标点、序号、「发言人 + 时间戳」等锚点尽力还原段落，会议记录能恢复成一句一条的发言列表，并保留「原文」按钮随时对照 |
| 网页类 | 网页、微信文章点击直接在新窗口打开原文 |
| 引用到对话 | 文件一键交给 agent 读取 |
| Agent 工具 | 5 个工具，含**按正文内容搜索** |
| 上下文注入 | 模型每轮自动看到知识库清单，主动去查 |

## 环境与版本适配

| 项目 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.0-rc.1** | 开发与测试所用的版本；0.2.x 其他小版本理论兼容，未逐一验证 |
| Node.js | ≥ 18（推荐 ≥ 22） | 宿主半要求；绑定自动化用到 Node 内置 WebSocket，22 起零依赖 |
| 浏览器 | Chrome 或 Edge | 仅「一键绑定」需要；都没有会自动降级为手动填写方式 |
| 操作系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux | 宿主半为纯 Node 实现，无原生模块依赖 |
| ima 账号 | 能登录 [ima.qq.com](https://ima.qq.com) 即可 | 订阅类知识库 ima 不开放读取（产品策略，见「已知边界」） |

> DSH 的插件接口在 0.2.x 阶段仍在演进。升级 DSH 后如果插件异常，欢迎[提 issue](https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/issues)，附上 DSH 版本号即可。

## 安装

### 前置条件

- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness（下文以 `~/.dsh` 为其 home 目录）
- Node.js ≥ 18

### 方式一：一行命令（推荐）

把 `web` 换成你要装的 profile 名即可（桌面端用 `desktop`）。

**从预构建包安装** —— 最快，不需要 git，也不需要本地构建：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/releases/latest/download/dsh-ima.tgz
```

**从源码安装**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima.git
```

装完**重启 DSH**（Web 端也可以只重启服务后刷新页面）。

> ⚠️ **不要写成 `github:ikevss/dsh-ima`。** npm 会把 `github:` 这种简写解析成 **SSH** 地址（`ssh://git@github.com/...`），没配过 SSH key 的机器会直接报
> `Permission denied (publickey)` 装不上。要让人人都能装，必须用上面的 `git+https://` 形式或 tarball 链接。

> 💡 预构建 tarball 里已经包含编译好的 `lib/client.js`，所以安装时不会触发构建；从源码装也一样，`lib/` 是随仓库提交的。

### 方式二：手动安装（改 profile 配置）

适合想改代码、或者网络环境装不了包的情况。

**1. clone 到插件目录**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima
```

**2. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`** —— 加依赖和 bundle：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-ima": "file:../../plugins/dsh-ima"   // ← 新增
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ...原有内容...
        "dsh-ima"                               // ← 新增
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**3. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`** —— 文件末尾加一段：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ima
      name: dsh-ima
```

**4. 把插件文件拷进 profile 的 node_modules**（不要用 `pnpm add`，容易搞坏 profile 的依赖解析）：

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/{package.json,cordis.patch.yml} ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima/
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/lib/*.js ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ima/lib/
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

### 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）

把上面的 `web` 全部换成 `desktop` 即可：

```bash
# 一行命令方式
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/ikevss/dsh-ima/releases/latest/download/dsh-ima.tgz
```

手动方式同样三步，只是 profile 目录换成 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`：

```bash
# 1. 改 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json（加 dependencies + bundles，同上）
# 2. 改 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml（加 insert 段，同上）
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/{package.json,cordis.patch.yml} ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima/
cp ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima/lib/*.js ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-ima/lib/
# 3. 重启桌面端
```

> ⚠️ desktop profile 由桌面端独占管理，命令行 `dsh --profile desktop` 会拒绝启动——这是正常的。

## 它访问什么（权限说明）

装之前你大概想知道它碰了什么。全部如实列出：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **访问的域名** | 只有 `https://ima.qq.com`（腾讯 ima 官方 OpenAPI）。预览/下载文件时用的是 ima 接口返回的腾讯云 COS 签名直链 |
| **读取的本地文件** | `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ima/credentials.json`（插件自己的凭证）；取不到时回退读 `~/.config/ima/{client_id,api_key}`（ima 官方技能的标准位置）。除这两个位置外不读任何本地文件 |
| **写入的本地文件** | 只在 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ima/` 下写凭证与绑定用的浏览器 profile；**不碰 `~/.config/ima/`**（那是 ima 自己技能的资产，解绑只用标记文件） |
| **启动的进程** | 仅「一键绑定」时会拉起你本机的 Chrome / Edge，带 `--remote-debugging-port=9333`（只监听 `127.0.0.1`），用完即关 |
| **本机 HTTP 路由** | `/api/ima/*`，由 DSH 的 webServer 提供，与 DSH 面板同源。之所以要这层中转，是因为 ima 的接口不返回 CORS 头，浏览器不能直连 |
| **安装期脚本** | **没有**。`package.json` 里没有 `postinstall`/`prepare`，装的时候不会执行任何脚本 |
| **遥测 / 上报** | **没有**。不收集、不上传任何数据到第三方；除了上面那个域名不连任何服务器 |

> 想自己核对：`grep -rn "https://" lib/index.js lib/ima-client.js`，宿主半只有 `ima.qq.com` 一个外部地址。

## 绑定 ima 账号

1. 打开侧边栏「知识库 ima」→ 点「一键绑定 ima 账号」
2. 会自动弹出一个浏览器窗口，已打开 ima 授权页
3. **登录**（唯一需要你做的事）
4. 自动完成绑定，面板刷出知识库

> **备用方式**（没有 Chrome/Edge 时）：点「都试过了还是不行？」，打开 ima 授权页 → 点第 1 步的**「一键复制」**→ 回到插件，会自动识别。
> 注意：API Key **不在页面上显示**，藏在「一键复制」复制出来的那段文字里。

## Agent 工具

插件注册 5 个工具，模型按需调用：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `ima_search_files` | **按正文内容搜索文件**（最常用）——不知道文件叫什么、想找"哪些资料提到过 X"时用 |
| `ima_list_knowledge_bases` | 列出全部知识库 |
| `ima_search_knowledge_bases` | 按关键词搜知识库（匹配库名/描述） |
| `ima_list_kb_files` | 列出某个库里的文件和文件夹 |
| `ima_read_file` | 读取文件正文（文本直接返回，二进制返回下载直链） |

### 上下文注入

插件在每轮对话的第一步，会把知识库清单注入模型上下文（10 分钟内不重复注入）：

```
[ima 知识库] 用户已连接 ima 知识库，下面这些库可以直接搜：
· 我的笔记（个人）
· 项目文档（共享）
...
· 找"哪份资料提到过 X" → ima_search_files
· 想浏览某个库里有啥 → ima_list_kb_files
· 读全文 → ima_read_file
```

所以模型会**主动去查**，而不是说"我看不到你的资料"。

## 架构

```
dsh-ima/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        宿主半：agent 工具 + 上下文注入 + /api/ima/* 路由
│   ├── ima-client.js   ima OpenAPI 客户端
│   ├── ima-browser.js  浏览器自动化取凭证（CDP，零依赖）
│   └── client.js       浏览器半产物（由 build/ 生成，已随仓库提供）
├── build/
│   ├── client.src.js   界面逻辑源码
│   ├── viewer.src.js   预览引擎配置
│   └── build.mjs       构建脚本（esbuild）
└── cordis.patch.yml    bundle patch
```

**两半设计**：宿主半跑在 Node 里（工具、HTTP 路由），浏览器半跑在 DSH 页面里（侧边栏面板、预览）。两者通过同源的 `/api/ima/*` 通信。

> 为什么要有 HTTP 路由？因为 ima 的接口**不返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`**，浏览器直连会被 CORS 拦死。只能由宿主半代理。

## 开发

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ima
npm install          # 构建依赖（约 400MB，仅开发时需要）
npm run build        # 重新生成 lib/client.js
npm test             # ima-client 冒烟测试
```

改 `build/client.src.js` → `npm run build` → 把 `lib/client.js` 拷进各 profile 的 node_modules → 刷新页面。
改 `lib/index.js` 等宿主半 → 拷进 profile → **重启 DSH**。

> `lib/client.js` 是构建产物，已随仓库提供，**普通用户不需要构建**，clone 下来即可使用。

## 预览能力

内置 [open-file-viewer](https://github.com/xushanpei/open-file-viewer)（MIT）做纯前端渲染：

| 类型 | 预览方式 |
|---|---|
| PDF | 浏览器原生 |
| Word / Excel / PPT | docx-preview / xlsx 纯前端渲染 |
| 图片 | 直接渲染 |
| 音视频 | 内置播放器 |
| Markdown / 文本 / 思维导图 | 内置渲染 |

> 小技巧：ima 的文件标题常常**没有扩展名**（例如播客标题就是一段描述）。插件会从文件真实地址里取扩展名补上再交给预览引擎，否则会误报"不支持预览"。

## 已知边界

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 订阅知识库 | ima 产品策略不开放读取（错误码 220030），默认不显示 |
| 文件更新时间 | ima OpenAPI 目前不返回任何时间字段（实测 2026-10-16，已探测多个候选接口），插件已预留显示通道，ima 开放后无需更新插件 |
| 笔记段落结构 | ima 笔记接口 `note/v1/get_doc_content` 只返回一个已展平的纯文本字段：`data` 顶层只有 `content` 一个键，`format` / `with_blocks` / `rich` 等参数全部被忽略（返回字节一致），另探 8 个结构化候选接口全部 404。**原始段落结构在 ima 服务端就丢失了，插件无法无损还原**，只能按可见

plugins.readme_text:
# CADCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![CADCraft Use — precise 2D drafting](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draw, inspect, render, and save 2D CAD geometry through CADCraft's own command engine, with entity counts and a reopened DXF checked before delivery.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-12-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`cadcraft` lets an agent drive CADCraft's existing command registry instead of inventing a second CAD engine: start a drawing, run native commands, inspect entities, render the sheet, and save a DXF that reopens with the expected geometry. It packages twelve skills, a portable manifest, and one embedded editor server.

This is a development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, the current build is still pending public release, and GUI acceptance, desktop UI control, and external CAD compatibility remain separate open gates.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `cadcraft` |
| Display name | CADCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.4` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | CADCraft 0.3.0 command registry; editor build bundled, CLI external |
| Marketplace | `cadcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded end-to-end evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Headless file tasks and the `cadcraft-cli` skill need an installed `cadcraft-cli` on the host. The plugin does not install it. Build or install it from the upstream CADCraft project, then check `cadcraft-cli --version` and `cadcraft-cli commands` in the host environment.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or a verified editor cache. `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` uses bundled assets.
- `CADCRAFT_CLI` selects a binary only for `scripts/launch.py`; it does not change the editor entry in `mcp.json`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add cadcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

This candidate is still marked as pending public release, with `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`. To test the exact build, use the repository-local marketplace `cadcraft-marketplace`, pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.4`. Restart the host, open a new task, and ask for one small drawing before a full sheet.

## Quick start

1. Open the editor with an absolute workspace: “Open CADCraft for this folder and list the available commands.”
2. Query the live command registry before drawing. Do not treat a skill example as the complete schema; parameters and enabled state come from the installed version.
3. Run one bounded command, for example a circle at `[10,10]` with radius `4`, then inspect the drawing and confirm the expected entity count.
4. Save to a **new absolute** `.dxf` path, reopen that exact file, and inspect again. Agree on any overwrite before saving over an existing file.

```text
Draw: Create a 120 × 80 mm plate with four 6 mm holes on a 20 mm inset.
Inspect: List circles, lines, layers, and the handle of each new entity.
Bolt circle: Place six holes on a 60 mm pitch-circle diameter starting at 0°.
Export: Save the sheet to a new DXF, reopen it, and verify entity counts.
```

Direct runtime checks for the external CLI and the optional launcher:

```bash
cadcraft-cli --version
cadcraft-cli commands
python3 scripts/launch.py --doctor
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Draw and inspect parts | `cadcraft-use`, `cadcraft-mcp` | Entity types, counts, handles, layers, and key coordinates |
| Parametric hole patterns | `cadcraft-bolt-circle` | Polar array from a real handle, hole count and pitch circle checked |
| Room plans | `cadcraft-floor-plan` | Room outline, openings, and wall geometry at stated dimensions |
| Dimensions and layers | `cadcraft-dimension-part`, `cadcraft-layer-cleanup` | Part dimensions, cleaned layers, linetypes, duplicates |
| Sheet output | `cadcraft-sheet-export` | Frame, paper, scale, and print output |
| Revision comparison | `cadcraft-compare-revisions` | Geometry and annotation differences between two drawings |
| Trace a reference | `cadcraft-trace-reference` | Two-axis calibration and a dimensioned vector outline |
| Scripted scenarios | `cadcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes with real methods, parameters, and reopen checks |
| Visual editing | `cadcraft-editor` | Same-session UI plus a saved drawing file |

## Skills

### Entry and runtime

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-use` | Choose the CLI or MCP path and define what a verified drawing means |
| `cadcraft-cli` | Run headless file tasks with the installed `cadcraft-cli` |
| `cadcraft-mcp` | Drive interactive, JSON, query, and render tools over MCP, including failure checks |

### Drawing scenarios

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-bolt-circle` | Build an equal-angle bolt pattern from a real handle and polar array |
| `cadcraft-floor-plan` | Draw rooms, doors, and windows at given dimensions |
| `cadcraft-dimension-part` | Dimension a mechanical part profile, holes, and sizes |
| `cadcraft-layer-cleanup` | Clean layers, linetypes, and duplicate lines in a complex drawing |
| `cadcraft-sheet-export` | Produce a sheet with frame, paper, scale, and print output |
| `cadcraft-compare-revisions` | Compare geometry and annotations between two drawing versions |
| `cadcraft-trace-reference` | Rebuild a dimensioned outline from confirmed reference control points |

### Playbooks and editor

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cadcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight scenarios covering plates, flanges, door openings, grids, routing, hole rows, notches, and title frames |
| `cadcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `cadcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the bundled engine's command catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Default native design panel, registered as a conversation-side entrypoint; pass the absolute task `workspace` |
| `open_browser_editor` | Explicit browser fallback for the same session; normal editor opening does not require this tool |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready to accept commands |

The bundled catalog in `ui/catalog.lock.json` exposes `command_line`, `script`, `execute`, `list_commands`, `inspect_drawing`, `query_entities`, `render`, `new_drawing`, `open`, and `save`, plus UI tools when a desktop session is attached. `render` produces an image of drawing content, not a screenshot of an application window; `screenshot`, `ui_inspect`, and `ui_click` require a desktop control connection.

The default entry declares a thread entrypoint and a separate design surface. Tool metadata, resource metadata, and UI initialization all request `fullscreen`, which desktop hosts present as a separate conversation panel. `open_editor` does not return a browser

plugins.description: Build and audit editable spreadsheets with live formulas, tables, and charts.
plugins.readme_text:
# GridCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![GridCraft Use — editable workbooks from a coding agent](assets/official-logo.png)

> Build and audit a real spreadsheet from your agent host — cells, formulas, tables and charts stay editable instead of arriving as a screenshot.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/gridcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-11-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-29-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`gridcraft` connects an agent host to the GridCraft workbook engine, so a request ends with an editable workbook whose formulas still recalculate. The plugin owns spreadsheet skills, a same-session editor bridge and package pinning; it does not re-implement the engine, the formula evaluator or the file format.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `gridcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.3` |
| Status | Development preview; all-host acceptance still open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Host requirements | Plugin or stdio MCP host; MCP Apps or a built-in browser for the panel |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`; the bundled stdio MCP server runs on it.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, so no Rust toolchain, `npm install` or Python runtime is required.
- A host that supports plugins or stdio MCP. Embedded panels additionally require MCP Apps or a built-in browser.
- No separate spreadsheet application is needed; the workbook engine is bundled.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add gridcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask GridCraft to open a workbook for your workspace.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. In a development checkout you must build the editor assets first; cloning the source is not an installed runtime.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[new_workbook]
    E --> F[set_cell / write_range]
    F --> G[evaluate_formula]
    G --> H[inspect_workbook / save_workbook]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Create a workbook with `new_workbook`, or open an existing file with `open_workbook`.
3. Read the available commands first with `list_commands`, then use `execute_command` for anything the direct tools do not cover.
4. Write values with `set_cell` or `write_range`, and confirm calculations with `evaluate_formula` — never assume a formula recalculated.
5. Save with `save_workbook`, reopen, and check that formulas and formats survived.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Clean a messy table | `gridcraft-clean-table` | Deduplicated, gap-checked, format-normalised sheet |
| Sales summary | `gridcraft-sales-summary` | Totals by period, product or region with live formulas |
| Budget versus actual | `gridcraft-budget-tracker` | Budget, actual and variance columns that recalculate |
| Reconcile two tables | `gridcraft-reconcile-data` | Matched, unmatched and exception rows |
| Formula audit | `gridcraft-formula-audit` | Broken references, hardcoded values and missing ranges listed |
| Business dashboard | `gridcraft-dashboard` | Metric cells, charts and filters on one sheet |
| Shift timesheet | `gridcraft-shift-timesheet` | Cross-midnight hours and break handling |
| Fixed-rate payment schedule | `gridcraft-fixed-payment` | Principal, rate and term turned into monthly rows |
| Month calendar | `gridcraft-month-calendar` | Weekday-accurate grid including leap years |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `gridcraft-editor` | Open the editor in the host and keep agent edits on the same page |
| `gridcraft-clean-table` | Handle duplicates, missing values and inconsistent formats |
| `gridcraft-sales-summary` | Aggregate sales by time, product or region |
| `gridcraft-budget-tracker` | Manage budget, actual and variance |
| `gridcraft-reconcile-data` | Compare orders, statements or stock between two tables |
| `gridcraft-formula-audit` | Find broken references, hardcoded numbers and range gaps |
| `gridcraft-dashboard` | Metrics, charts and filters on one sheet |
| `gridcraft-shift-timesheet` | Cross-midnight shifts, break hours, missing and invalid rows |
| `gridcraft-fixed-payment` | Fixed nominal annual rate and equal monthly payments |
| `gridcraft-month-calendar` | Month grid with Monday start, weekend columns and leap years |
| `gridcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Recipes for quotes, replenishment, weighted scoring, expense review, duplicate keys and task tables |

Skills come from the independent `gridcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `gridcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 29 tools: 24 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands`, `list_functions` | Live command IDs, parameters, and supported spreadsheet functions |
| Command gateway | `execute_command` | Run any registered engine command with JSON params |
| Workbook | `new_workbook`, `open_workbook`, `save_workbook`, `inspect_workbook` | Create, open, save and summarise a workbook |
| Cells and ranges | `set_cell`, `get_cell`, `read_range`, `write_range` | Read and write individual cells or rectangular ranges |
| Calculation | `evaluate_formula` | Evaluate a formula expression without changing any cell |
| Structure | `create_table`, `sort_range`, `filter`, `format_range` | Tables, ordering, filtering and cell formatting |
| Charts | `insert_chart` | Insert a chart bound to a range |
| Interaction | `select`, `screenshot` | Select a range; `screenshot` saves a window PNG (desktop app) |
| History | `undo`, `redo` | Step back and forward one change |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Host MCP config | Workspace root for hosts that cannot pass it in a tool call |

Verified archives are cached under

plugins.description: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-diet

A global DeepSeek Harness plugin that removes tokens from tool output **before**
that output can enter a model request — without removing anything the model may
need, and without changing what the model is able to do.

```
tests/t0.py::case PASSED
tests/t1.py::case PASSED
…
[... 12235 of 12416 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 4 diagnostic lines
 retained, middle elided ...]
______________________ test_charge_card_rejects_expired _______________________
src/payments/charge.py:118: in charge_card
E   CardExpiredError: card expired 2024-01-31
FAILED tests/test_payments.py::test_charge_card_rejects_expired
[…]
…899 tests collected…
(Trimmed 12235 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/session-…/bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path.)
```

## The problem it solves

Every tool result becomes part of the conversation the moment it is logged, and
from then on the model re-reads it on every step of the session. The shipped
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` only trims **once a compaction trigger
qualifies**, and rewriting a result that late invalidates the prompt-cache prefix
that was already established — so trimming late costs extra as well as saving.

`dsh-context-diet` runs at `tools/post-execute`, the last waterfall before the
registry freezes a result into a `tool/result` event. A rewrite there belongs to
the call it came from: there is no cache prefix to invalidate, no second copy to
reconcile, and no durable edit to replay.

## What it removes

### 1. Lossless normalization (on by default)

Reduces output to what a terminal would actually display. A terminal shows no
glyph for an escape sequence, so removing one cannot change meaning.

| Transform | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape sequences | `\e[31merror\e[0m` | `error` |
| OSC hyperlinks and titles | `\e]8;;http://x\a link` | `link` |
| Carriage-return overlays | `10%\r50%\r100%` | `100%` |
| Backspace erasure | `ab\bc` | `ac` |
| Trailing whitespace | `a   \n` | `a\n` |
| Blank-line padding | `a\n\n\n\n\nb` | `a\n\nb` |

### 2. Annotated compaction (on by default)

A run of at least `repeatThreshold` (8) byte-identical consecutive lines that is
also at least `repeatMinRunChars` (1000) characters long becomes one line naming
the exact repeat count:

```
npm warn deprecated inflight@1.0.6: This module is not supported…  [x400 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

The run is collapsed **only when the annotation is strictly shorter than the run
it replaces**, so this pass can never enlarge a result. The count is preserved, so
the run is exactly reconstructible from the annotation and nothing is dropped
silently — which is why this pass needs no recovery file.

### 3. Recoverable, structure-aware trimming (on by default above 32,000 characters)

A result still larger than `maxInlineChars` is replaced by:

1. its head (`headChars`),
2. an omission marker stating exactly how much was dropped,
3. **the diagnostically significant lines from the omitted middle** — errors,
   failures, exceptions, assertions, stack frames, diff hunks and headers, and
   `file:line:col` references (`significantChars`), and
4. its tail (`tailChars`),

followed by a notice naming a spill file that holds the complete normalized text,
with the backend's own retrieval guidance.

Blind head/tail cutting discards the middle unconditionally. Keeping the
diagnostic lines makes the same budget **strictly more informative**, not less —
measured on a 900-test `pytest -v` run, every one of `CardExpiredError`,
`charge.py:118`, `test_charge_card_rejects_expired`, and `1 failed, 899 passed`
survives with this plugin and is lost by a head/tail cut of the same size.

## Why quality is not affected

- **Nothing is dropped without a record.** Every removal is either a
  control character a terminal never displays, or something that is counted,
  annotated, and written verbatim to a spill file the notice tells the model how
  to read.
- **`read` is exempt by default.** File-content output is line-addressed: blank-line
  or trailing-whitespace rewriting would corrupt content a model may quote back
  at an editor. This matches the shipped `dsh-spill-policy`, which exempts `read`
  for the same reason.
- **The default budget is conservative.** No result under 32,000 characters —
  roughly 8,000 tokens — is touched at all, except by the lossless passes.
- **It cannot alter capability.** It registers no tools, removes none, changes no
  prompts, and changes no model or reasoning settings. Tool schemas, the system
  prompt, and the tool catalog are byte-identical to a run without it, so the
  prompt cache behaves exactly as before.
- **It never makes a model call and never adds a request.**
- **It fails open.** Any unexpected shape, missing service, or thrown error
  returns the incoming result untouched and logs a warning. `verify.mjs` covers
  each of those paths.

## Measured effect

On a synthetic but realistic bash-heavy corpus (900-test `pytest -v`, `npm install`
with 400 repeated deprecation warnings, 2,400-line `cargo build`, a `curl`
progress bar, and a 3,000-entry `find`), with shipped defaults:

| Result | Before | Model sees | Removed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `pytest -v`, buried failure | 48,002 | 12,555 | 74% |
| `npm install`, 400 repeats | 33,711 | 236 | 99% |
| `cargo build`, buried error | 158,997 | 20,218 | 87% |
| `curl` progress bar | 4,572 | 61 | 99% |
| `find` over a large tree | 130,890 | 12,218 | 91% |
| **Total** | **376,172** | **45,288** | **88%** |

The lossless tier alone accounts for 15% of that; the rest is annotated
compaction and recoverable trimming. Character counts are not billed tokens —
the figures are indicative, and `/diet` reports the real numbers for the session
you are in.

### Verified against a running Harness

Both passes were exercised live, through the real `tools/post-execute` waterfall
of a running `dsh web` profile, using the real `dsh-spill-local` backend:

```text
$ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING"; done
SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING  [x30 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

```text
$ awk '… 570 lines with an error at line 285 …'
download asset 0000 of 0570 ================================================
…
[... 31890 of 43967 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 1 diagnostic lines retained, middle elided ...]

src/engine/pipeline.rs:204:7 - error TS2345: UNIQUE_BURIED_DIAGNOSTIC_MARKER

[...]
…
download asset 0569 of 0570 ================================================

(Trimmed 31890 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/c1cbcd405966-bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path to search within it.)
```

The 43,967-character result reached the model as 12,077 characters (72% smaller),
the diagnostic line that a head/tail cut would have dropped was retained, and the
recovery file was verified to hold all 571 lines of the original output.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-context-diet
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-context-diet → on**.
   An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.

The bundle inserts one global Host row, so it applies to every session in the
profile — not to a single session. It needs no credentials and no other plugin;
the `tools/post-execute` seam is part of `dsh-tools`, and the spill backend comes
from `dsh-spill-local`, both of which the shipped compositions provide. Without a
spill backend the plugin still normalizes and compacts, and simply declines to
trim, because trimming without a recovery file would lose information.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; omitting it keeps the shipped default. Override any of
them in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is applied after bundle
layers and therefore survives plugin upgrades:

```yaml
- id: context-diet
  name: 'dsh-context-diet'
  config:
    maxInlineChars: 64000     # 0 keeps only the lossless and annotated passes
    exemptTools: ['read', 'read_image']
    repeatTh

plugins.description: 抓虾 Office 插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 生成、文本提取与 OOXML 检查校验。独立运行，无需 Python 或抓虾后端。
plugins.readme_text:
# 抓虾 Office 插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 文档

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

`dsh-crawshrimp-office` 是一个独立的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Office 文档插件，面向本地、可复核的小型 Word 和 PowerPoint 工作流。它可以生成真实的 `.docx` 和 `.pptx` 文件，将有界 Markdown 转换为 DOCX，读取 Word 与逐页 PowerPoint 文本，检查 OOXML ZIP 结构，并按预期文本或数量校验文档。

它适合生成会议纪要、周报、简短方案、简单演示文稿和本地文档质量检查。文件留在配置的工作区内，不调用抓虾 API、共享 connector、模型服务或外部网络。

## 快速开始

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4`。当前发布标签是 `v0.2.0`，通过 DSH 官方插件加载器从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile demo add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office#v0.2.0
```

安装后，可以直接让 DSH 完成本地任务，例如：“用 `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` 把这份周报保存为 `reports/weekly.docx`，再用 `crawshrimp_office_validate` 检查它是否包含‘本周总结’。”也可以直接调用工具；示例参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)。

插件默认将 `./crawshrimp-office-output` 作为工作区。启动 profile 前可以指定专用目录：

```bash
export CRAWSHRIMP_OFFICE_WORKSPACE="$HOME/crawshrimp-office-output"
```

`-w` 让 DSH CLI 在 profile workspace 中添加插件。安装器会读取 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并自动加载 `cordis.patch.yml`；需要手动加载 patch 的宿主可以使用 [`examples/cordis.patch.yml`](./examples/cordis.patch.yml)。如果宿主需要直接嵌入插件，请加载完整模块命名空间，让 Cordis 同时注册 `apply` 和工具 schema：

```js
import * as office from 'dsh-crawshrimp-office'

await ctx.plugin(office, { workspaceDir: './crawshrimp-office-output' })
```

## 能力与工具

插件实际注册以下 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 | 审批 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_create` | 用标题、段落和简单字符串表格生成 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_read` | 从现有 DOCX 提取有上限的纯文本。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_create` | 生成标题页以及标题/项目符号页组成的 PPTX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_inspect` | 查看 DOCX/PPTX 的 OOXML ZIP 结构、条目元数据和数量。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` | 将有上限的 Markdown 标题、段落、列表和简单表格转换为 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_read` | 读取 PPTX 每一页的有上限纯文本，不解码媒体。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_validate` | 校验 DOCX/PPTX 必需部件及可选的预期文本、表格数或幻灯片数。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |

所有文件名都必须是工作区内的相对路径。插件会解析真实路径，拒绝目录穿越和逃逸到工作区外的符号链接，不覆盖已有输出，并先写临时文件，再以不可覆盖的原子方式落盘。

## 使用示例

生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/brief.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "paragraphs": ["A short, reviewable summary."],
  "tables": [{
    "headers": ["Metric", "Value"],
    "rows": [["Orders", "12"]]
  }]
}
```

用 Markdown 生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/weekly.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "markdown": "# Weekly brief\n\n- Orders: 12\n- Returns: 1\n\n| Metric | Value |\n| --- | --- |\n| Conversion | 4.2% |"
}
```

生成 PPTX：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/launch-plan.pptx",
  "title": "Launch plan",
  "slides": [{
    "heading": "Milestones",
    "bullets": ["Design", "Review"]
  }]
}
```

更多参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)、[`examples/slides-read.json`](./examples/slides-read.json) 和 [`examples/validate.json`](./examples/validate.json)。

Markdown 转换支持标题、段落、有序/无序列表、引用、作为纯文本保留的围栏代码和简单管道表格。行内强调和链接会展平为文本。HTML 会被剥离并返回 warning；图片和媒体语法会保留 alt 文本并返回 warning。插件不会抓取或嵌入外部媒体，也不会执行 HTML；不支持的 Markdown 会在安全范围内保留为纯文本。

`crawshrimp_office_slides_read` 返回 `slideCount` 和每页有上限的文本，只读取 OOXML 文本节点。`crawshrimp_office_validate` 在预期文本或数量不满足时返回 `valid: false`；损坏 ZIP、缺失 OOXML 必需部件、无效 XML 及 DTD/entity 声明会真实返回工具错误。

## 权限与上限

写调用使用宿主的 DSH 原生权限信号。会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有的完全权限授予允许写入，无需重复弹出逐次审批；`ask`、受限模式，或审批/沙箱服务缺失、读取异常时，仍走原生审批路径，只有收到 `allowed-once` 才执行。插件没有单独绕过原生审批的配置项。

默认限制单个输入文件 16 MiB、单个生成文件 16 MiB、Markdown 输入 512 KiB、文本提取 128 KiB；段落、表格、幻灯片、项目符号、Markdown block 和 ZIP 条目也有数量上限。可以通过插件配置中的 `workspaceDir`、`maxInputBytes`、`maxOutputBytes`、`maxTextBytes`、`maxMarkdownBytes` 在限定范围内调整。

## 实际边界

实现范围是 OOXML 包的生成、读取和结构校验。插件不转 PDF/PNG，不运行 LibreOffice，也不执行视觉审查。生成成功结果会返回 `visualReview: "not_rendered"`；只有在另行完成渲染并经过人工或模型检查后，才能描述为视觉已验证。`office_run`、Office COM、宏、公式、图表、媒体解码和任意 Python 执行不属于本包。

示例和测试只使用本地临时文件，不调用模型、商家账号或外部网络服务。该包不编辑已有 Office 文档的任意复杂排版，也不渲染图表或重新计算公式。

## 与其他功能包的关系

当前维护三个可独立安装的功能包：[Browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 负责网页操作、登录态和页面脚本，[Data](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data) 负责记录与表格，Office 负责文档。PDF、标签、模板和渲染归 Office 路线图，0.2.0 尚未实现。

0.2.0 新增 Markdown 转 DOCX、PPTX 逐页文本读取、结构/内容校验，并对齐 DSH 原生完全权限映射。

plugins.description: A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Office

**Tiny coworkers. Real work.** Watch your DeepSeek Harness agents work in a living pixel office.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · MIT · Zero runtime dependencies · No extra API key

![Animated Agent Office preview — simulated events](docs/demo.gif)

Your agents leave their desks to use tools, queue up when they need approval, and take a breather when a turn finishes. Click a coworker to inspect their activity. Everything in live mode comes from Harness session events.

## Try the office in 10 seconds

Clone this repository and run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office.git
cd dsh-agent-office
node src/demo.mjs
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319**. No install, build step, model, or API key required. Demo mode uses **simulated events** and is visibly labeled. This command previews the UI; it does not connect to a running Harness.

## Connect your actual agents

Requires Node **22.19+** and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-alpha.4**. This first release deliberately declares only the DSH version whose API was checked. New DSH releases need compatibility verification before widening `engines.dsh`.

From a directory containing the downloaded `dsh-agent-office` folder:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile office add ./dsh-agent-office
dsh --profile office web
```
