If the CLI is not globally installed, replace `dsh` with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.4`. Configure your model in the Harness profile as usual. Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319** alongside the Harness UI and start a task. The office logs its URL to the terminal when loaded.

To install into an existing profile, substitute its name for `office`. A server restart is needed after installation. Stop the standalone demo before enabling the plugin: both default to port 4319. The first release is a separate browser dashboard, not an embedded Harness sidebar or an operating-system desktop overlay.

### Source checkout / overlay

Generate an overlay with the absolute module path:

```sh
node scripts/make-patch.mjs > office.local.patch.yml
dsh --profile office web --patch ./office.local.patch.yml
```

The generated YAML uses an absolute path because DSH resolves plugin module paths from the profile. The overlay command works without installing the bundle.

## What's inside

- Original procedural pixel art: focus desks, tool lab, approval corner, sofas, plants, and animated coworkers. No downloaded assets or font services.
- Real event projection for main sessions and subagent sessions. Parent links represent **session lineage**, not inferred conversations.
- Independent pending-tool and approval tracking; parallel requests do not prematurely clear a waiting status.
- Distinct completion, error, blocked, paused, and idle states. “Done” means a turn completed, not that the project passed acceptance tests.
- Clickable roster, activity feed, per-session steps/tool calls/reported tokens, and PNG scene export.
- English / 简体中文, midnight / daylight themes, focus view, mobile layout, and reduced-motion support.
- Reconnecting event stream with an explicit stale-state indicator.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the agent loop.

![Desktop preview — simulated events](docs/screenshot.png)

## Configuration

Edit the installed bundle row through your profile overlay:

```yaml
- id: agent-office
  config:
    port: 4320
    maxAgents: 48
    maxEvents: 120
```

| Setting     | Default | Range      | Purpose                                               |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `port`      | 4319    | 1024–65535 | Loopback-only office server                           |
| `maxAgents` | 48      | 1–200      | Tracked sessions; inactive sessions are evicted first |
| `maxEvents` | 120     | 10–500     | In-memory activity history                            |

Up to **12 coworkers are drawn at once**; all tracked sessions remain selectable in the roster. Selecting another session brings it onto the floor. If the tracking cap is full of active sessions, new sessions are ignored until a slot becomes available. Counters cover retained sessions since plugin startup, not lifetime totals. UI feed shows the latest six events.

The port is fixed rather than silently changed. If occupied, the plugin logs an actionable error and leaves Harness running. Change it in your configuration and restart.

## Data and permissions

The office observes `session/event` and `session/disposed` at the profile root. It does not register tools, intercept execution, approve operations, or send data to a third party. Approval happens in the original Harness conversation.

Only session IDs, parent IDs, generated names, the last folder name of the working directory, tool names, lifecycle statuses, timestamps, and reported token counts enter the office projection. Prompts, assistant text, reasoning, tool arguments/results, full paths, and approval explanations are excluded. Displayed text is inserted as text, not HTML.

The HTTP server binds exclusively to `127.0.0.1`, checks Host and Origin, has no write endpoints, and closes on plugin unload. Any process or user with access to this machine's loopback can read the displayed metadata. This version is intended for a trusted local machine, not remote hosting. Do not expose its port publicly.

State is in memory. Existing idle conversations and pre-load history are not imported; a session appears on its next observed event. A restart clears the office. A detached session remains as a paused/terminal entry until eviction. Tasks run in a different Harness process are not visible.

## Development and verification

```sh
node --test
node --check public/app.js
```

Eight dependency-free tests cover concurrent tools/approvals, terminal reasons, bounded history, sensitive-data exclusion, token accounting, HTTP/SSE, host/origin protection, port conflicts, and cleanup. Published Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.2** and DSH SessionStore **0.2.1-alpha.4** were separately used to check real session append → plugin → HTTP state and unload cleanup. A full model-backed DSH end-to-end run has not yet been performed.

Browser checks cover desktop/mobile layouts, SSE updates, selection, both languages, themes, focus, and PNG export. See [verification notes](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Share the little office

The preview GIF and screenshots in `docs/` are ready for a GitHub README or release post. They are labeled demonstrations. Source: [xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office](https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office). This plugin has not been published to npm.

Suggested repository description: **A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.**

Suggested GitHub topics: `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`, `ai-agents`, `pixel-art`, `agent-observability`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Independent community plugin; not an official DeepSeek product.

plugins.description: Independent OpenCode Go connection plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# OpenCode Go · 2

这是独立的 DeepSeek Harness 模型插件，只注册 `opencode-go-second`。
第一套 `opencode-go` 和其他供应商继续由原生适配器管理。

## 安装

适用于 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2`，需要 Node.js `>=22.19.0`。
DSH 官方包通过 peer dependencies 复用宿主，模型 SDK 使用 `pi-ai 1.1.0`。
插件兼容范围通过新版 `engines.dsh` 声明。仍使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 时请保留插件 `v0.2.2`。

桌面端通过 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-go-second
```

市场会通过 npm 检查已发布的新版，出现更新提示后点击更新即可。后续发布 npm 新版
不需要逐次修改市场收录条目。开发目录的 `link:` 安装不参与 npm 自动检查更新。

Web 端将 `--profile desktop` 改为 `--profile web`。也可以从源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yfwu2020/dsh-opencode-go-second
```

安装后重启 DSH，在设置 → 模型 → OpenCode Go · 2 → 管理中配置 **OpenCode Go**
API 密钥，点击“获取可用模型”，选择后保存。模型是否能实际调用由账号权限、额度
和上游服务状态决定，目录查询成功不代表逐个模型已通过推理测试。

本插件新增独立的 `opencode-go-second` 连接，不替换原生适配器或其他供应商配置。
默认使用密钥引用 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`；如果已在别处使用相同引用，请先为新连接
选择独立引用，避免更新密钥时影响使用同一引用的其他连接。

### 本地开发

克隆仓库后运行 `npm ci` 和 `npm test`。需要联调时，将 DSH profile 的
`package.json` 依赖指向 `link:<项目的绝对路径>`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中添加
`dsh-opencode-go-second`，并合并本仓库 `cordis.patch.yml` 中的条目；不要覆盖已有
profile 文件。DSH profile 通常位于 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`。

`migration.mjs` 仅供处理本项目特定的旧覆盖方案，不随发布包交付。
普通安装不需要运行它；维护旧方案前应备份并核对原配置。

## 使用与隔离

设置 → 模型中显示“OpenCode Go · 2”。密钥沿用 DSH 密钥库里的
`OPENCODE_API_KEY` 引用，插件不保存或打印密钥。内置 38 个备用模型；可手动刷新当前账号可用的模型。
点卡片右侧“管理”可查看和搜索模型、选择启用模型、获取可用模型。
有改动时显示“保存模型”和“撤销修改”；替换密钥需要单独点“更新密钥”。
收起面板保留未保存的修改。原生编辑入口仅在此插件卡片中隐藏，第一套不受影响。
各模型按资料使用 Chat Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 接口；
新加入的 Google 模型使用 Google Generative AI 接口。
会话标识取自 DSH 当前聊天，User-Agent 复用 DSH 的请求标识。
两个连接之间没有密钥轮换、自动降级或路由覆盖。

迁移时第二套内部名称由 `opencode` 变为 `opencode-go-second`，避免与原生 Zen
设置目录冲突。当前全局默认模型会迁移到新名称，模型和推理等级保持原值。
聊天记录不修改；若某个旧聊天单独保存了旧连接选择，需要重新选择“第二套”。
不同适配器之间的历史按 DSH 官方规则转换为通用历史，原生专用回放信息可能
不再被复用，但文本、工具调用与结果仍保留。

## 实现

依赖官方发布的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 和
`@earendil-works/pi-ai@1.1.0`，复用公开的 `PiAiAdapter` 以及原生 Go provider。
没有复制核心适配器源码、替换原生包或导入 app.asar 内的绝对路径。
`package-lock.json` 固定依赖版本；升级 DSH 后仍需检查公开接口的兼容性。

模型元数据合并了当时的原生 Go/Zen 目录与 models.dev 的 Go 资料。
可用 ID 来自第二套认证的 `/zen/go/v1/models` 查询，不使用未认证的公共列表。
两个旧别名 `deepseek-flash`、`omen-alpha` 沿用已存在的能力配置，能力上限未经
额外实测。DSH 支持的输入为文本和图片；不会声称支持音视频/PDF 原始输入。

## 更新模型目录

只在点击设置面板中的“获取可用模型”时查询列表；启动、定时任务和密钥更新均不会触发刷新。
手动刷新会用第二套已保存的密钥（或尚未保存的草稿密钥）查询 Go 列表，
仅将该密钥发送给 `opencode.ai`。遇到未知模型时自动补齐接入资料，资料来自
[models.dev](https://models.dev/api.json) 的 `opencode-go` 目录；这个请求不携带 API 密钥。
接口地址固定在 OpenCode 官方域名，忽略外部资料中的自定义地址。支持 Chat
Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 和 Google Generative AI 四种协议。

刷新后可选择启用的模型，点击“保存模型”才修改配置。网络失败、缺少资料或遇到尚未
支持的协议时保留原配置，不按名字猜测接口。已有模型的接口与能力定义保持稳定；
变更这些定义仍需要升级插件。

验证过的公开模型资料保存在系统用户缓存目录的 `dsh-opencode-go-second/catalog.json`，
不写入项目或 Git 仓库，不保存密钥。重启时可从本地资料恢复；缓存丢失或损坏时，
先提供已有资料的模型，点击“获取可用模型”可恢复其余模型。
空模型列表恢复插件默认目录；移除供应商配置会停用该连接。

接口依据：[OpenCode Go 官方端点说明](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/#endpoints)。

## 验证

运行 `npm test` 验证实际官方适配器/SDK 对 38 个模型的接口选择、密钥与会话
隔离、流式解析、错误结果、设置注册、模型发现和第一套迁移保持不变。
还覆盖启动时不发起查询、不创建刷新计时器、手动发现不自动保存，以及缓存、
Gemini 思考等级、认证、工具回放，以及传输不响应取消时的流空闲超时。
测试替换网络传输，不产生模型调用费用；通过并不代表 38 个模型都完成了真实推理。
实际可用性受账号权限、额度、地区和服务端状态影响。

## 回退

部署前在 desktop profile 的 `backups` 目录保留原 `package.json`、
`cordis.patch.yml` 和旧覆盖包链接地址。本机部署记录、备份和日志不进入仓库。
回退时关闭 DSH，恢复这两份备份并恢复旧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 链接，
再重启 DSH，即回到迁移前的第二套方案。若迁移后又编辑过其他设置，先保留
当前配置，再只恢复第二套对应条目，避免覆盖后续修改。

## 仓库中的敏感信息处理

仓库不包含真实 API 密钥、密码、个人路径、账号标识、日志或部署备份。
配置中的 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` 等名称是密钥引用，不是密钥值。测试使用虚构
凭据和示例会话标识。依赖目录和本地环境文件由 `.gitignore` 排除。

## 发布新版本

本仓库的 `.github/workflows/publish.yml` 使用 npm Trusted Publisher（OIDC）。
绑定 GitHub 用户 `yfwu2020`、仓库 `dsh-opencode-go-second`、工作流文件名
`publish.yml`，环境名称留空，并允许 `npm publish`；不需要配置 npm 发布密钥。

先同步修改 `package.json` 和 `package-lock.json` 的版本号，提交并推送到 GitHub，
然后为该提交创建同版本的正式 Release（例如版本 `0.3.2` 对应标签 `v0.3.2`）。
工作流检查版本号、安装固定依赖并运行测试，通过后自动发布到 npm 的 `latest`。
普通代码推送和预发布 Release 不会触发正式发布。工作流也可手动指定已有标签重试；
已成功发布的 npm 版本不能重复发布，应检查上次结果后再决定是否重试。

plugins.description: Trae LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: reads the credential an already signed-in Trae desktop/CLI wrote, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, and seeds one editable provider entry on the models page. Never writes Trae data.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pylon-trae

> A **Trae LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
> Repository: <https://github.com/rumilhz/dsh-pylon-trae>
> Package name: `dsh-pylon-trae` (this is the first plugin under the `dsh-pylon-` prefix).

---

## English

### What it is

This plugin adds a **Trae** provider to DeepSeek Harness. After installing it and
restarting DSH, `Settings → Models` gains one **editable** `Trae` provider whose
model list is read from the Trae installation already signed in on this machine
(Trae desktop app, or the Trae CLI).

It does **not** depend on, import, or patch `dsh-connect-trae`.

### How it works

1. It reads the credential file that the Trae desktop app or the Trae CLI already
   wrote, and decrypts it locally with its own implementation.
2. It pulls the live model directory for the signed-in edition (CN or
   international) and decodes the streaming responses.
3. It serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/healthz`, `/v1/models`,
   `/v1/chat/completions`) from a **fixed loopback port**. `/v1/models` advertises the
   **conversation models only**: the directory also answers with Trae's own IDE workflow
   components (`title_generation`, `fast_apply`, the `custom_model_*` placeholders, the
   `*_advisor` / `search_agent_*` aliases), and this plugin tells them apart by **fields**
   rather than by a hand-written denylist. On the live CN directory that is
   **47 chat + 32 internal = 79**, and `/healthz` names the parts
   (`models` / `chat` / `internal` / `total`).
4. It seeds one provider entry into the `llm-pi-ai` namespace, which is the
   namespace the Models page renders an editor for — so you can add, remove and
   test models from the UI.

**Trae's own data is read-only.** The plugin never writes to Trae's files; there
is an assertion in the code that refuses to.

### Hard prerequisites — all four

| # | Requirement | If it is missing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Trae is signed in on this machine** (desktop app is easiest; the CLI counts too) | The plugin starts but exposes no models and reports "no usable credential" |
| 2 | **Port 7864 is free** (CN build; 7865 for the international build) | The loopback service cannot start, which means there is no channel at all |
| 3 | **`dsh-connect-trae` is not mounted in the profile** | Two Trae providers fight over the same route id (`trae` / `trae-global`) |
| 4 | **Windows** | The macOS / Linux code paths exist but are **untested on real hardware** |

> Installing does **not** start or restart DSH. Quit DSH completely and reopen it.
> Reloading the window is not enough.

### Install

Three routes are documented in [`发布.md`](发布.md). In short:

- **From this repository (GitHub source).** The install target is a pnpm GitHub
  spec, `github:rumilhz/dsh-pylon-trae`. Any DSH version that can add a plugin
  from a GitHub source can install it this way.
- **From the plugin market.** ⛔ **Not searchable yet.** An entry has been / will
  be submitted to the curated `awesome-dsh-plugin` catalog, but the market only
  offers sources inside that catalog, so this route works **only after that pull
  request is merged**. See [`发布.md`](发布.md).
- **From a prebuilt tarball.** `node tools/pack.mjs` produces
  `dist/dsh-pylon-trae-<version>.tgz` plus a `.sha256` and a `.manifest.txt`
  checksum pair; `node install.mjs --from <tgz>` installs it offline.

Node **≥ 22.6** can run the `.ts` sources directly (type stripping), so there is
no build step.

---

## 中文

### 这是什么

**DSH 的 Trae 供应商插件**（自研实现；不依赖、不引用、不打补丁于 `dsh-connect-trae`）。

目标形态：在「设置 → 模型」里出现一条**可编辑**、含 Trae 全量模型、能自己筛的供应商。

- 包名 `dsh-pylon-trae`，仓库名 `dsh-pylon-trae`。
- 状态/数据目录只有一个：`$DSH_HOME\.dsh-pylon-trae\`（token、`state.json`、备份、`boot.log` 都在里面）。
  旧 `.dsh-trae\` 首次启动时会自动**复制**迁移，原目录保留给用户自己清理。

> **四硬前提**见上面英文小节的表格（Trae 已登录 · 7864 空闲 · profile 里没有 `dsh-connect-trae` · Windows）。
> 装完必须**完全退出 DSH 再打开**，刷新页面不算。

### 状态（截至 2026-10-16；M1~M6 六行是 2026-10-14 深夜的口径，最后一行是 2026-10-16 这一轮加的）

> **M1~M6 是什么**：不是版本号，是**施工顺序**（M = milestone）。
> 每一步都刻意做成"做完就能单独验证"的一小段，且**顺序保证越早可用**：
> M1 只读不碰配置 → M2 让链路能说话 → M3 才把它接进「设置 → 模型」→ M4 之后就都是加功能。
> **状态口径**：✅ = 本机实测通过 · ⏳ = 没做完，或做完但**还没验收**。

| 里程碑 | 一句话：这一步在干什么 | 做完你会看到什么 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| M0 | 先把别人的插件读透、把行号钉死、选路线 | 一份带行号的现状与选路文档 | ✅ |
| M1 | 只读：找到 Trae 的凭据并解开、把线上模型清单拉下来 | 一条命令打出「读到几个账号、线上有多少模型」 | ✅ 本机 CN 79 个模型（4 个接口全 200） |
| M2 | 让本插件自己的服务能"代替 Trae 说话"（固定端口 + 协议 + 流式解码） | 打自己的端口，能收到带工具调用的流式回复 | ✅ 文本/thinking/usage/`tool_calls` 全通 |
| M3 | 把这条供应商**写进「设置 → 模型」**（workbuddy 那种可编辑条目） | 模型页出现 Trae 一行，能勾选模型、保存、重启不丢 | ✅ **真冷启动通过**（79 模型写入；二次启动 no-op） |
| M4 | 服务端：插件自带端点 + 宿主路由 + 不开 UI 的 CLI | 没有浏览器也能读账号/目录/用量/签到/测试 | ✅ 端点两条前缀都在；`/models/reload`（只读重拉）与 `/models/refresh`（只增不删写配置）已分开 |
| 卡片 | 浏览器半边：设置卡片（账号/目录/「刷新目录」/「重建清单」/用量/签到/测试） | 设置 → 插件里出现 dsh-pylon-trae 卡片，按钮点得动 | ⏳ **代码已落地**；两个离线闸门全绿。仍差真人重启后点一次 |
| M5 | 功能对齐（用量积分 / 输入框读数 / 每日签到 / 一键测试 / 图片 / 推理档位） | 上游有的那些功能逐项出现 | ⏳ **已做**：推理档位映射、用量/签到/测试端点与卡片按钮。**未做**：输入框积分读数 + 账号浮层。**图片输入刻意不做**：协议层不翻译 `image_url`，于是目录也不宣告 `image`（理由写在 `src/protocol.ts` 顶部） |
| M6 | 收尾：把上游 `dsh-connect-trae` 从 profile 移除 | 选择器里只剩本插件那一条 Trae | ⏳ |
| 过滤 | 目录里 Trae 自己的流程组件**不再算模型**（2026-10-16 本轮） | 模型页只会出现 47 个对话模型；卡片目录行显示「对话模型 47 个（另有 32 个内部组件已隐藏）」，旁边多一个「移除内部组件（N 个）」按钮 | ✅ 判据 + `tools/test-catalog.ts`（56 断言）+ 卡片按钮 + 清理路由都已落地；**清掉已经写进去的旧条目仍需真人点那一次** |

**验证全部跑在临时 profile 上**：`<工作区>\_trae-coldstart\home`（独立 `DSH_HOME`，里面**只**装本插件）。
把插件装进真 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/*`）是**部署动作**。

### 目录里的「内部组件」过滤（2026-10-16）

**问题**：写进「设置 → 模型」的 79 条里混着 Trae IDE 自己的流程组件 —— `title_generation`（起标题）、
`input_optimization`（优化输入）、`fast_apply`（快速套用）、`search_agent_qwen_fast`（搜索）、
`custom_model_gpt-6`（占位槽）、`glm-5.2_advisor_doubao`（顾问模式）…… 它们都是**真的可调用的
`config_name`**（所以确实能调通），但**不是对话模型**，出现在模型选择器里就是垃圾项。

**判据：字段判定，不是手写黑名单**（`src/catalog.ts` 的 `classifyDirectoryEntry`）

| 规则 | 判据 | CN 实测命中 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 用途 | `usage !== 'chat_completion'` ⇒ internal。`usage` 是目录里**唯一**声明用途的字段 | **23**：`summary` · `fast_apply` · `fast_apply_new` · `title_generation` · `input_optimization` 各 1，加 `custom_model_*` 18 |
| ② 别名槽 | 该 id 的**全部** listing 行里，没有一行的 `model_detail_list[0].model_name` 含它自己的 `config_name` ⇒ internal | **9** |
| 合并 | **任一** listing 行说它是自己的模型就算 chat（**OR**，不是 first-wins） | 合计 **32 internal / 47 chat** |

实测的 `usage` 分布（CN，2026-10-16，169 行 / 79 个不重复 `config_name`）：
`chat_completion` 56 · `custom_model` 18 · `summary` · `fast_apply` · `fast_apply_new` ·
`title_generation` · `input_optimization` 各 1（= 79）。

**为什么必须是 OR，而不是"保留第一行"**：`solo_work_remote` 是**第一个**被问的 function，它对
`DeepSeek-V4-Flash` / `DeepSeek-V4-Pro` / `Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code` 返回的是**陈旧 wire**
（`deepseek_v4_flash__dev` 等）；first-wins 会让**同一份目录**从 47 掉到 44 —— **3 个真模型被静默丢掉**。
改成 OR 之后连拉两次稳定 **47 chat + 32 internal = 79**：判据成了目录的属性，与网关先答哪一行无关。

**上游 `dsh-connect-trae@3.4.0` 没有做等价的事**：`collectModels`（`:2604-2640`）全收；它只有两个与用途
**无关**的过滤（`sanitizeCatalog` `:283-290`、`dropDeadModels` `:5303`）。它的注释自称 internals
不会浮出，靠的是「以 Remote 用户面目录为骨架」这一条**结构性**假设；我们试过那条路（拿它的 32 个名字
与我们的 79 个求交）**只剩 30 个**，连 `glm-4.6` · `glm-4.7` · `kimi-k2` · `minimax-m2` ·
`minimax-m2.1` · `qwen3-coder` 这些真模型一起丢 ⇒ **弃用**，改为留在本仓库字段上的判据
（离线可复现，不需要第二次网关调用）。

**被判为 internal 的 32 个 id（CN，2026-10-16，完整名单）**

```
title_generation · input_optimization · summary · fast_apply · fast_apply_new
custom_model_1M · custom_model_1M_text · custom_model_200k · custom_model_200k_text
custom_model_claude · custom_model_deepseek_chat · custom_model_deepseek_reasoner
custom_model_deepseek_v4 · custom_model_doubao_1M · custom_model_doubao_256k
custom_model_gemini · custom_model_gpt-5 · custom_model_gpt-6 · custom_model_kimi
custom_model_no-fc · custom_model_placeholder · custom_model_vercel · custom_model_vercel_gemini
browser_use_subagent · explore_sub_agent_v2 · file_search_agent · search_agent_qwen_fast
search_agent_qwen_fast-0710 · glm-5.1_advisor · glm-5.2_advisor_default · glm-5.2_advisor_doubao
seed-code-pro-0430
```

（同一份 32 条逐字冻结在 `tools/test-catalog.ts` 的 `INTERNAL_ROSTER`：判据或名单一变，那个**先红**。）

**边界**：缺 `usage` 或缺 `model_name` 的畸形行**一律判 internal**（绝不误判为 chat）。方向是刻意的 ——
隐藏一个真模型的代价是"用户少看到一个选项"，而放进一个流程组件正是这次要修的问题；而且被隐藏的 id 会经
`SeedOutcome.skippedInternal`、`GET /models/all`、`boot.log` 三处报出来，所以可发现、可撤回

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: your own OpenAI-compatible image relay as the image2_generate tool, with inline media previews.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-image2-tool ![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin?display_name=tag&sort=semver&label=release) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image2-tool?label=npm) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-image2-tool?label=downloads) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1-4B5563) ![Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6) **Language**: [中文](README.md) · English **社区插件标签**：`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis` · `bundle` · `text-to-image` · `image-to-image` · `image-generation` · `ai-image` · `image-relay` · `openai-compatible` · `inline-media` · `web-ui` · `tool` 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加上「一句话生成图片」和「拿参考图改图」的能力：接你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，生成的图**直接内联显示在对话里**。 ![dsh-image2-tool 横幅](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.jpg) --- ## 亮点 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一行安装 | 官方通用方式 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`，重启后工具表出现 `image2_generate` | | 自己的中转站 | 文生图走 `POST /images/generations`，图生图走 `POST /images/edits`，同时支持 `b64_json` 与图片 URL 两种返回 | | 参考图引导 | 给 `image` 传一张本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP，角色一致性、画风与配色远比纯文字描述稳 | | 图形化配置 | 侧边栏 Plugins 页内置设置行（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 字段），也可直接写 `cordis.patch.yml` | | 视觉自检 | 生成后用原生 `read_image` 复核真实文件，不把「接口成功」当成「视觉合格」 | | 内联预览 | 自动带上 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)，图片直接渲染在回复下方，无需点开卡片 | | 克制默认 | `autoGenerateAssets` 默认 `false`，普通开发任务不会悄悄花掉生图额度；输出被限制在会话目录内 | ## 使用示例 下面两张图来自一次真实会话：让 Agent「生成一张 GPT 化龙指导器的形象」，它自己挑参考图、比对版本、迭代出成品。 **对话里长这样** —— 生成过程、参考图、版本对比都在回复里，图片由内联预览直接渲染，不用点开任何卡片（长图，可点开看全）： **最终结果** —— 该会话产出的成品（864 × 1152）： > 复现方式：装好插件后直接对 Agent 说「生成一张 XXX 的图」即可。`autoGenerateAssets` 保持默认 `false` 时，只有你明确要求才会生图。 ## 参考图引导（图生图） 只要调用里带上 `image`，插件就改走 `POST /images/edits`： ```jsonc { "prompt": "保持这个角色设定，改成少女比例，正常七头身，不要 Q 版", "image": "imagegen-output/reference.jpg", // 相对会话目录或绝对路径 "aspectRatio": "3:4", "filename": "result.jpg" } ``` | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `prompt` | 必填。要生成或要改什么 | | `image` | 可选。本地参考图路径（PNG/JPEG/WebP，≤ 20 MB）。给了就走图生图，不给就是文生图 | | `filename` | 可选。输出文件名，不含目录 | | `size` | 可选。形如 `1024x1024`。只认 `aspect_ratio` 的中转站会忽略它 | | `aspectRatio` | 可选。形如 `3:4`、`16:9`，以 `aspect_ratio` 字段发出。中转站忽略 `size` 时用它控制构图 | 细节： - 参考图按**魔术字节**判定真实类型，不信任扩展名；文件不存在、不是普通文件、超过 20 MB、或不是受支持的图片格式，都在**发出请求之前**就报错，不浪费额度。 - 上传用 `multipart/form-data`，`Content-Type` 与 boundary 交给 `FormData` 处理。 - 中转站若不接受 `response_format`，把 `responseFormat` 设为空字符串即可不发该字段。 ## 安装 ### 官方通用方式（推荐） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool ``` 把 `` 换成你常用的 profile 名（例如 `web`、`default`）。装完**重启 DSH**，工具表里就会出现 `image2_generate`。 ### 其它等价方式 ```powershell # 从 GitHub Release 下载的 tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-image2-tool-0.4.1.tgz # 直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile add github:544244857/dsh-image2-plugin # 本地源码目录（开发调试） dsh plugin --profile add ./plugins/deepseek-harness-image2 ``` 需要新建一个独立 profile 时： ```powershell dsh --profile image2-demo --from-default-profile web --dump-config ``` ## 配置 两种方式等价、可互换，**二选一**即可。 **① 图形界面**：侧边栏 → Plugins → `dsh-image2-tool` → `image2` 行，逐项填写（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 密钥字段），保存即写回当前 profile 的 Cordis patch。 **② 配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - id: image2 name: dsh-image2-tool config: baseUrl: https://your-image-relay.example.com/v1 model: grok-imagine-image-2.0 apiKeyEnv: IMAGE2_API_KEY autoGenerateAssets: false outputDir: imagegen-output timeoutMs: 180000 responseFormat: b64_json ``` | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | 中转站地址（OpenAI 兼容，含 `/v1`） | | `model` | 模型名，**必须**是该中转站 `/v1/models` 里真实存在的名字，否则调用返回 404 | | `apiKeyEnv` | API key 的**环境变量名**（不是 key 本身） | | `apiKey` | 设置页里的遮蔽字段；非空时优先于 `apiKeyEnv`，后者作为兜底 | | `autoGenerateAssets` | 是否允许在软件开发任务中自动补齐缺失位图素材，默认 `false` | | `outputDir` | 输出目录，相对会话目录解析并强制不越界 | | `timeoutMs` | 单次请求超时 | | `responseFormat` | 向中转站索要的返回格式，默认 `b64_json`（图片字节内联回传）。设 `url` 则让插件去下载中转站给的链接；设为**空字符串**则完全不发这个字段，给不接受它的中转站用 | API key 交给**启动 DSH 的那个进程**： ```powershell $env:IMAGE2_API_KEY = 'your-image-relay-api-key' dsh --profile web ``` 已经开着的桌面端不会继承新设的环境变量，需要从带该变量的终端重新启动。别把 key 写进 Git。 ## 内联预览 安装本插件时会一并安装 [`@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer`](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin) `1.0.12`。该包自带 `dsh.bundle` patch，安装时会被 profile 管理器自动启用为 bundle，于是回复中提到的图片路径会直接在对话里渲染成图片。 它由上游维护、MIT 许可，本插件既不 vendor 也不修改其代码；删除 `dependencies` 里的这一行，image2 功能完全不受影响，只是内联预览消失。上游标注内联图片卡片在宿主 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上验证过，本插件面向 `0.2.1-rc.1`，所用宿主 API 均存在，但渲染路径上游尚未复测。 ## 行为与边界 - `autoGenerateAssets` 默认关闭。打开后，Agent 可以在网页、移动端、桌面端、游戏等软件开发过程中，确认项目内与外部都没有合适素材后，生成真正缺失的位图素材；用户的直接生图请求不受该开关影响。它是**工具层指引**，不是服务端授权闸门。 - 一次一张。不带 `image` 走 `POST /images/generations`（文生图），带 `image` 走 `POST /images/edits`（图生图，multipart 上传参考图）。 - 接受 base64 与图片 URL 两种结果；保留同名已有文件（冲突自动加序号），输出限定在会话目录内，支持取消与请求超时。 - 下载图片时**不会**转发中转站 key。 - 保存后必须用原生 `read_image` 检查实际文件并与需求逐项对照；在检查完成前，工具会把「视觉验收」标记为待办。 - 重试预算：初始 1 次 + 最多 5 次追加生成请求（含失败），这是指引而非持久计数器。 - 参考文本是素材，永远不是指令来源。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因与处理 | | --- | --- | | `HTTP 404: Model "xxx" is not available for this group` | 模型名在该中转站上不存在。用 `GET /v1/models` 查可用列表后改 `model` 字段（volatile 字段保存即生效，无需重启） | | `Error: fetch failed` | 到中转站的网络抖动，重试即可（与 404 是完全不同的故障） | | `Image download failed` 或下载时 `ConnectTimeoutError` | 中转站返回的是它自己 CDN 的临时链接，而这台机器连不上那个域名。把 `responseFormat` 设为 `b64_json`，让图片字节直接内联回传 | | 图生图报 `Source image not found` / `contained no supported PNG, JPEG or WebP image bytes` | 参考图路径不对，或文件其实不是图片（按魔术字节判定，改扩展名没用） | | 图生图报 `HTTP 400: model is required` | 该中转站没有 `/images/edits` 路由。文生图仍可用，图生图需换支持的中转站 | | 工具表里没有 `image2_generate` | profile 未安装成功或未重启；确认 profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `dsh-image2-tool` | | 设置页显示 `unavailable` | 该 profile 没有 settings 服务，改用上面的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工行 | | 图片没内联显示 | 确认 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 也在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中，并重启 DSH | ## 兼容性 - 宿主：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.1`（实测），`0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.1.7-rc.2` 亦声明兼容 - Node.js `>= 22.15`（图生图依赖全局 `FormData` / `Blob`） - 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 共享宿主的 Cordis / Schemastery / tool runtime；不要在插件目录里放不兼容的物理副本（会出现两份实例） ## 工作方式 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户: 生成 / 改一张图] --> A[Agent] A -->|image2_generate| T[dsh-image2-tool] T -->|无 image: POST /images/generations| R[你的图片中转站] T -->|有 image: POST /images/edits| R R -->|b64_json 或 url| T T --> F[会话目录 / outputDir] F --> V[read_image 视觉自检] V --> P[内联预览渲染在回复下方] ``` - 工具面：`image2_generate`（宿主工具注册表） - 客户端面：`lib/client.js` 向 Plugins 页注入 `image2` 配置行 - bundle 面：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行 `id: image2` - 测试：`test/smoke.js` 用本地假中转站覆盖两条通道，不需要网络与额度 ## 许可 MIT © 2026 544244857。依赖 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)（MIT，版权归其作者）。 --- English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md).

plugins.description: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mac-notify

监听 DSH 事件（任务完成、会话暂停、子agent结束、workflow完成），通过 SSH 在 Mac 上显示 terminal-notifier 悬浮气泡通知

由 dsh-super-injector dev_scaffold_plugin 生成。

## 构建与注入

```bash
(prebuilt - no build step required)
# 注入器环境内：dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

## Configuration

- DSH_MAC_NOTIFY_SSH - SSH target of the Mac that shows notifications, e.g. user@mac.local. Required; notifications are skipped when unset. Key-based auth must work non-interactively (BatchMode).

## Mac-side listener

The plugin posts notifications over SSH to a small HTTP listener on the Mac (127.0.0.1:18923). Run the bundled example on the Mac:

    node examples/mac-notifier-listener.mjs

It requires terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier). Port and notifier binary are configurable via NOTIFY_PORT / NOTIFIER_BIN. For permanence, wrap it in a LaunchAgent.

# dsh-experience-policy

**一句话**：把「**状态 → 动作 → 回报**」的历史经验，转成对当前候选动作的**数值加权**——零梯度的 test-time 策略优化。 **为什么值得用**：很多选择场景（走哪条搜索通道、用哪个工具、选哪个参数）历史上已经积累了大量「在什么状态下选什么、结果怎样」的记录，但**没人把它们变成下一次选择的依据**。本插件提供一个纯决策层：输入当前状态与历史经验，输出**候选动作的数值加权**——让「上次这个状态选 A 效果好」变成这次排序里 A 的加分。⚠ 它是**加权器不是决策者**：最终选哪个仍归调用方。 ## 能力 **工具面：无**（纯行为插件）。行为侧是一个纯决策层（`src/policy.ts`），由调用方喂入状态与经验，返回候选动作的加权。 > ⚠ 与 `mechanism-fit-validation` 技能的关系：本插件是该技能 §3「纯函数层先行」的产物——决策逻辑无 IO、无随机（同输入必同输出），可离线单测。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-experience-policy": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-experience-policy" ``` **2) 挂组合**（若你的调用方需要它作为 service 消费）： ```yaml - id: experience-policy name: dsh-experience-policy ``` **3) 30 秒验证**： ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-experience-policy && npm test ``` （⚠ 本插件的测试文件是 `.ts`，`test` script 直接跑 TS —— 见「测试」节。） ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | （见源码 `Config`） | — | 本插件**无必填项**；缺省即按纯决策层工作（经验数据由调用方持有并喂入） | ## 落盘与自证 **本插件无持久产物**——它是纯决策层，不写文件、不落侧车。经验数据由调用方自己持有与喂入。 ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：调用方拿到加权结果即可验证（纯函数：同输入必同输出）。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 无状态，停用即完全静默。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-experience-policy && npm test # = node --test tests/*.test.ts ``` ⚠ **注意跑法**：本插件的测试是 **`.ts`** 文件（`tests/policy.test.ts`），`test` script 直接跑 TS。⇒ 用 `node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` **跑不到任何用例**（会报 `tests 0`）——这不是「没测试」，是**跑法不对**。 ## 设计要点 - **纯决策层**：无 IO、无随机，同输入必同输出 ⇒ 可离线单测、可复算。 - **零梯度**：不做训练、不更新权重文件——每次调用现算。 - **加权而非决策**：输出是**候选动作的相对权重**，选择权归调用方（本插件不替主体做决定）。 - **不自动采集**：经验由调用方显式提供——插件不偷偷记录会话内容。 ## 相关文档 - ⚠ **本插件暂无 `semantic.md`**（未建语义文档）——契约以上面「设计要点」与源码为准；补文档是待办。 - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **认知层**） - 相关技能：`mechanism-fit-validation`（机制适配性验证 · 本插件是其「纯函数层先行」的产物） - 论文锚：JitRL（test-time policy optimization，零梯度） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

# dsh-wallpaper

把整个 DSH 网页铺上壁纸，并在同一个面板里显示**本次会话**的 token 用量。

- 背景：一张全页面壁纸（内置一张默认图，可上传替换、可调暗度 / 模糊 / 填充方式）
- 面板：侧边栏底部「壁纸」按钮打开（与设置/团队同尺寸、同节奏的文字按钮），右下角浮层；含壁纸选择、上传、删除、滑块、恢复默认
- 配色：四套深蓝色调（深蓝 / 墨蓝 / 午夜青 / 石墨），面板内可选；面板卡片、按钮、图标随配色变化，栏目（编辑栏、会话列表、菜单、悬停态）由重新着色的主题色阶一起变蓝 —— **壁纸本身不染色**
- 用量：`本次会话` 口径 —— 输入（未命中/命中缓存）、输出、推理、合计 token、步数，以及高峰/非高峰时段划分

## 安装（web profile）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"/home/atlaslinux/Wallpaper Plugin/dsh-wallpaper"
```

或者手工两步：

1. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加
   `"dsh-wallpaper": "link:/home/atlaslinux/Wallpaper Plugin/dsh-wallpaper"`，
   并把 `dsh-wallpaper` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组；
2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 下执行 `pnpm install`，然后重启 `dsh web`。

之后壁纸面板随网页一起加载；卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-wallpaper`。

## 它读什么、写什么

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v3.jsonl.zstd` | **只读**。用量数字来自会话日志里 `assistant/message` 事件携带的 `TokenUsage`，模型来自 `request/header` / `request/context` |
| `~/.dsh/wallpaper/config.json` | 显示配置（当前壁纸、暗度、模糊、填充、开关） |
| `~/.dsh/wallpaper/wallpapers/` | 你上传的壁纸文件 |

插件**不写**任何会话日志，也不改动 DSH 其它数据；状态放在 `~/.dsh/wallpaper/`，所以重装/升级插件不会丢你的选择。
（`DSH_WALLPAPER_HOME` 可覆盖该目录，测试脚本用它。）

## HTTP 接口

都在 `/dsh-wallpaper` 前缀下，只监听本机：

| 方法 | 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/dsh-wallpaper/api/state` | 配置 + 壁纸列表 + 实时用量 |
| GET | `/dsh-wallpaper/api/events` | SSE：用量/配置变化推送 |
| POST | `/dsh-wallpaper/api/config` | 局部更新配置（越界值会被夹紧） |
| POST | `/dsh-wallpaper/api/upload` | `{name, dataUrl}` 上传图片（png/jpg/webp/gif，≤约 9 MB） |
| POST | `/dsh-wallpaper/api/delete` | 删除某张用户壁纸（内置图拒绝删除） |
| GET | `/dsh-wallpaper/wallpaper/<id>` | 取壁纸文件（`default` 或 `user/<文件名>`） |

宿主侧另外提供 `ctx.wallpaper` 服务面，别的插件可以直接读用量：`config()` / `saveConfig()` /
`wallpapers()` / `sessionUsage()`。

## 配色

面板里「配色」一栏有四套深蓝色调，选了立即生效并持久化（`~/.dsh/wallpaper/config.json` 的 `scheme`）。

**换的是栏目本身，不是整页染色**：真正决定编辑栏、会话列表、菜单、悬停态颜色的，是主题里的
`--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-*` 这一条中性色阶（构建里现在是**近黑的灰**）。四套配色各自把这条色阶
**重新着色**，于是所有引用它的表面一起变蓝：

| 栏目 | 别名 | 引自色阶 |
|---|---|---|
| 编辑栏 / 卡片 / 主面板 | `alias-bg-layer-1` | `bluish-875`（暗）/ `bluish-00`（浅） |
| 菜单 / 弹层 | `alias-bg-layer-2` | `bluish-850` |
| 嵌套表面 | `alias-bg-layer-3` | `bluish-800` |
| 会话列表整列 | `specific-sidebar-fill` | `bluish-900` |
| 会话行悬停 / 选中 | `specific-sidebar-nav-item-hover` / `-active` | `bluish-850` / `bluish-750` |
| 插件/模块表面 | `alias-bg-module-platform` | `bluish-800` |

| id | 名称 | 色相 / 饱和度上限 | 暗色下的编辑栏 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deep-blue` | 深蓝（默认） | 220° / 0.62 | `#101d38` |
| `ink-blue` | 墨蓝 | 226° / 0.68 | `#0e183a` |
| `midnight-cyan` | 午夜青 | 196° / 0.55 | `#122c36` |
| `mono` | 石墨（不偏蓝的退路） | 220° / 0.14 | `#1f2228` |

**色阶的明度不改，只换色相**：色阶的序号就是明度（`bluish-50` 最浅、`bluish-1000` 最深），主题用
`body` 给浅色模式、`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 给深色模式绑定别名。所以插件保持构建里那条明度曲线、
只替换色相与饱和度 —— 浅色模式仍然和以前一样浅（只是偏蓝），深色模式的表面变成同一深度的蓝，
对比度和文字色阶都不用重做。反过来（把深色放到浅色端）会让浅色主题变成深蓝页面，`tools/ui-recolour-test.mjs` 专门守这条。

**壁纸本身不染色**：之前那版在画面上叠了一层 `mix-blend-mode: multiply` 的蓝色，已按你的要求撤掉。

纯白（`bluish-00`）不参与重新着色 —— 它是浅色模式的页面底色；最深的一档（`bluish-1000`）参与，
因为那正是深色模式的底色。

## 为什么没有金额

**这个插件不估算消费，也刻意不显示任何金额。** 曾经有过一版：内置一份 DeepSeek 官方价目表，按模型和
高峰/低谷分别计价，显示「预估消费 ¥x.xxxx」。它被**移除**了，原因不是算错，而是这类估算不可能可靠：

| 不可控因素 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| 官方随时调价 | 内置副本一过期就系统性偏差，而且偏差是静默的 |
| 法定节假日 | 官方节假日按低谷计价，本地没有任何权威日历可查 |
| 计费时刻口径 | 供应商按**请求**时刻判定高峰/低谷，日志只有**事件**时刻 |
| 缓存与重试的重叠 | 重试、失败请求、被中断的流在日志里的模样与账单口径未必一致 |

结论：与其给一个带免责声明的数字，不如只显示**日志真正记录了的东西** —— token 计数，以及高峰/非高峰
的时段划分（它能解释「为什么账单和 token 数不成正比」，而不假装自己是账单）。

## 验证

```bash
node tools/client-syntax-check.mjs  # 浏览器半契约 56 项（含点击穿透、配色覆盖）
node tools/host-smoke.mjs           # 宿主接口端到端 36 项（真实 HTTP + 真实壁纸字节）
node tools/ui-recolour-test.mjs     # 配色：读已安装主题的别名绑定，验证四套 × 深浅模式
node tools/usage-fold-test.mjs 4    # 用量折叠 与 会话日志原样重算逐字段比对（--disk 走磁盘路径）
node tools/crash-test.mjs           # 崩溃面：8 类恶意客户端，16 项
```

`usage-fold-test.mjs` 用一份**独立的**实现重新折叠真实会话日志，要求与插件逐字段一致 —— 这是「面板上的数字不是编的」的证据。
`crash-test.mjs` 在子进程里用 8 类恶意客户端打真实插件，把「未处理拒绝 / 未捕获异常」变成退出码。

## 仓库结构

```
README.md               # 本文件：功能、配色、验证方式
INSTALL.md              # 安装 / 卸载 / 回退步骤（可直接复制）
dsh-wallpaper/          # 插件本体 —— 把这一层挂进 profile
  package.json          #   dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
  cordis.patch.yml      #   一行 insert，把自己挂进 profile
  lib/index.js          #   宿主半：路由 / 存储 / 用量折叠
  lib/client.js         #   浏览器半：壁纸层 + 配色 + 面板 + 页脚按钮 + 用量条
  assets/default-wallpaper.jpg   # 内置默认壁纸
tools/                  # 五个验证脚本（见上）
docs/                   # 决策日志、崩溃面审查、验证清单、回退点说明
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/this/repo/dsh-wallpaper
```

装完重启 `dsh web`。卸载与回退见 [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)。

## 本轮验证读数

| 验证 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 浏览器半契约 | `node tools/client-syntax-check.mjs` | **56 项**全过（含「面板层必须保持点击穿透」这条 —— 它防的是一次真实事故：注册在 `shell.overlay` 时被宿主规则 `pointer-events: auto` 变成全屏挡板，把工作区选择器等控件点死） |
| 宿主接口（真实 HTTP） | `node tools/host-smoke.mjs` | 36 项全过 |
| 配色专项（四套 × 深/浅） | `node tools/ui-recolour-test.mjs` | 全过，含 WCAG 对比度；并把「宿主确实会给 overlay 子元素开 pointer-events」这条**从已安装的 DSH 包里读出来**做锚点 |
| 用量折叠（内存 / 磁盘） | `node tools/usage-fold-test.mjs [--disk]` | 与真实会话日志逐字段一致 |
| 崩溃面（8 类恶意客户端） | `node tools/crash-test.mjs` | 16 项全过，无崩溃向量 |

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 手机上的个人助理，远程使用电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness —— DSH 插件 + Expo 手机应用，扫码绑定、口语化回复、文件收发、远程开关机
plugins.readme_text:
# Open Whale 🐳

把手机变成你这台电脑上的 DSH 的**个人助理**。

电脑上装 `dsh-openwhale` 插件，手机上装 Open Whale 应用，扫一次二维码，之后打开应用就能像跟助理聊天一样远程调用电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness —— 它用口语化的人话回复你，产出文件会直接出现在聊天里，还能远程关机和（在满足条件时）远程开机。

```
┌──────────────┐   扫码绑定（一次性）   ┌───────────────────┐
│  Open Whale  │ ◀───────────────────── │  电脑上的插件      │
│   手机应用    │                        │  dsh-openwhale    │
│              │   WebSocket 长连接      │                  │
│  多个助理     │ ◀────────────────────▶ │  DSH 会话（每台手机一个）
│  聊天/文件    │   聊天 · 流式回复 · 文件  │  口语化语气注入     │
└──────────────┘                        └───────────────────┘
        ▲                                        │
        └──────── 互联网 / 局域网 ────────────────┘
```

---

## 它解决什么

| 需求 | 实现方式 |
|---|---|
| 手机以聊天形式远程调用电脑上的 DSH | 电脑端插件为每台手机建一个**专属 DSH 会话**，手机消息经 WebSocket 送达，回复流式推回 |
| 回复像个人助理，不像程序 | 在**该会话自己的作用域**里注入一段「口语化个人助理」system prompt；桌面上的会话不受影响 |
| 回复里有文件时也要拿到文件 | 助手产出的文件被登记，手机按分片拉取（另有一次性 HTTP 下载兜底），聊天里渲染成可点开的文件卡片 |
| 第一次绑定要扫电脑展示的二维码 | 插件展示二维码（浏览器页 / `/openwhale` 命令 / PNG / SVG），二维码里是**一次性、10 分钟有效**的绑定密钥 |
| 之后打开应用无需再次绑定 | 手机保存自己的 Ed25519 私钥；重连时用该私钥签名完成认证，不再需要二维码 |
| 一台电脑只能绑一台手机 | 电脑端强制：已绑定时，任何第二台设备（哪怕拿着有效二维码）都会被拒绝 |
| 一台手机可绑多台电脑，显示为不同助理，备注可改 | 手机端保存助理列表；备注本地可改，并会同步给电脑端 |
| 电脑关机时可远程开机 | **受物理限制**，见 [远程开关机](#远程开关机)；插件提供唤醒代理能力与前置条件检查清单 |
| 可远程关机 | 电脑在线时可用，带可取消的宽限窗口 |

---

## 目录结构

```
open-whale/
├── packages/
│   ├── protocol/          协议契约（唯一权威源），含 21 项单测
│   ├── plugin/            DSH 电脑端插件（纯 ESM、零运行时依赖）
│   │   ├── src/
│   │   │   ├── index.mjs        cordis 插件入口：装配各部件、命令、路由
│   │   │   ├── dsh-bridge.mjs   手机 ↔ DSH 会话桥（建会话、发消息、收事件、收文件）
│   │   │   ├── gateway.mjs      HTTP + WebSocket 服务、鉴权、帧路由、文件分片
│   │   │   ├── ws.mjs           自实现 RFC6455 服务端（帧编解码、握手、分片）
│   │   │   ├── qr.mjs           自实现 QR 编码器（v1-40、4 级纠错、8 种掩码、PNG/SVG/终端）
│   │   │   ├── state.mjs        电脑身份、配对窗口、已绑定手机（原子写 + 0600）
│   │   │   ├── pairer.mjs       二维码载荷与可用性判断
│   │   │   ├── voice.mjs        个人助理语气 prompt section
│   │   │   ├── power.mjs        关机/重启/取消（可取消宽限窗口）+ WOL 魔术包
│   │   │   ├── tunnel.mjs       cloudflared 快速隧道生命周期（可选）
│   │   │   ├── wol-proxy.mjs    局域网唤醒代发（可选）
│   │   │   ├── protocol.mjs     ← 由 packages/protocol 生成的自包含副本
│   │   └── test/               12 个测试文件
│   └── mobile/            Open Whale 手机应用（Expo / React Native / TS）
├── docs/
│   ├── install.md         安装与配置
│   ├── security.md        安全模型与威胁分析
│   ├── mobile-build.md    手机端本地出包（Android APK）
│   └── remote-power.md    远程开关机的真实边界
└── scripts/run-tests.mjs  一次跑完所有包的测试
```

---

## 下载这一版

去 [Releases](https://github.com/T1gerD/open-whale/releases/latest) 下载两个文件（每个版本都带 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 可校验）：

| 文件 | 装到哪 | 怎么装 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-openwhale-1.0.7.tgz` | 电脑 | `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add ./dsh-openwhale-1.0.7.tgz`，然后重启 DSH |
| `open-whale-1.0.7.apk` | 安卓手机 | 允许「安装未知来源应用」后点击安装；扫码绑定电脑 |

APK 由 GitHub Actions 在发布时构建（本仓库作者的环境里没有 JDK 与 Android SDK），用 debug keystore 签名，**适合个人自用安装**；要出正式签名的包见 [docs/mobile-build.md](docs/mobile-build.md)。

插件包同样可以自己打：

```bash
node scripts/build-plugin-package.mjs     # → release/dsh-openwhale-1.0.7.tgz
```

---

## 快速开始

### 1. 电脑端：装插件

从 Release 的 tarball 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-openwhale-1.0.7.tgz
```

或者从源码目录安装（开发时更方便，改动只需重启 DSH）：

```bash
cd open-whale
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./packages/plugin
```

（把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的 profile 名。）装完重启 DSH。详细步骤与排错见 [docs/install.md](docs/install.md)。

### 2. 电脑端：拿到绑定二维码

任选一种：

- **浏览器**：打开 `http://127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>/openwhale`，页面上直接显示二维码；
- **命令**：在 DSH 里执行 `/openwhale`，终端里会打印二维码；
- **图片**：`/openwhale/qr.png` 或 `/openwhale/qr.svg`。

二维码有效期 10 分钟，**只能用一次**，绑定成功后立即失效。

### 3. 手机端：扫码绑定

安装 Open Whale 应用（见 [docs/mobile-build.md](docs/mobile-build.md) 自行出包），打开后点「添加助理」→ 扫描二维码。绑定成功后，这台电脑就出现在你的助理列表里。

### 4. 之后

直接打开应用即可，不需要再扫码。想改助理备注：助理详情页 → 重命名。

出问题时第一个该看的地方：`$DSH_HOME/openwhale/openwhale.log`（插件自己的日志）。

---

## 远程连接怎么走

| 场景 | 方案 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 手机与电脑在同一 Wi-Fi | **局域网直连**（默认开启） | 插件监听 `0.0.0.0:8787`，二维码里带上 `http://192.168.x.y:8787` |
| 两边都在互联网上 | **公网隧道**（`tunnelMode: quick`） | 用 cloudflared 快速隧道把本地端口映射到 `https://xxx.trycloudflare.com`。**注意**：快速隧道官方定位是"测试用"，无可用性保证、域名每次重启会变、部分地区不稳定；长期使用建议自建反向隧道或改用组网（Tailscale 之类） |
| 想完全不暴露端口 | 你自建的中继 + 电脑主动出站 | 协议按「中继不可信」设计：鉴权与身份验证都在应用层完成，换中继不需要改协议 |

云隧道不可用时，局域网方案不受影响 —— 这条路径是刻意保证的（插件对可选部件全部容错）。

---

## 远程开关机

**关机 / 重启**：电脑在线时可用，默认 30 秒宽限窗口，期间手机或电脑都能取消。电脑端可一键禁用（禁用后仍允许取消）。

**开机**：这里有个绕不过去的物理事实 —— 电脑关机后，它自己就什么都没在跑了，**任何跑在它上面的软件都不可能唤醒它**。真正可行的路径只有三条：

1. 有一台**常开的设备**在同一局域网里替你发魔术包（插件内置了这个「唤醒代理」能力，配置 `wol.targets` 即可）；
2. 手机与目标电脑在**同一局域网**时，手机自己发广播；
3. 完全断电的场景只能用带外手段（智能插座 + 主板「来电自启」）。

并且需要在目标电脑上：BIOS 打开 Wake on Magic Packet、**关闭 Windows 快速启动**（否则普通关机是混合关机，网卡不会被 arm）、网线连接。详见 [docs/remote-power.md](docs/remote-power.md)。

---

## 安全

- 二维码里是**一次性**、10 分钟有效的绑定密钥，不是长期凭据；绑定成功即失效，截图外发无长期价值。
- 绑定后，认证靠手机侧 Ed25519 私钥签名（私钥只存在手机的安全存储里，从不上传）。
- 二维码同时携带电脑公钥，手机可据此验证 `hello/ack` 的签名，因此**冒名顶替的隧道**可以被识别。
- 重放的握手会被随机数防重放表拒绝。
- 手机只能读取**本次对话中产出**的文件，不能请求电脑上任意路径。
- 详见 [docs/security.md](docs/security.md)（含威胁分析与已知限制）。

---

## 测试

本项目**不依赖任何第三方运行时库**（QR 编码器、WebSocket、协议、状态层、电源层全部自实现），因此测试可以直接跑，无需安装依赖：

```bash
cd open-whale
node scripts/run-tests.mjs          # 全部 24 个测试文件、382 项测试
node scripts/run-tests.mjs qr       # 只跑文件名含 "qr" 的
```

> 测试运行器的实现不平凡，原因写在 `scripts/run-tests.mjs` 顶部的注释里：在这个沙箱环境中
> `node --test`、`node:test` 的 `run()` 流、以及 `process.exitCode` 都不可靠，所以运行器让每个
> 测试文件在自己的子进程里运行、把输出重定向到文件描述符（不用管道），再依据子进程自己打印的
> node:test 摘要判定成败。**缺失摘要一律算失败**——这是刻意的：早期版本曾把一个真实失败的套件
> 报成绿色，现在用「故意失败的探针」验证过它确实会报红。

测试覆盖（含手机端）：

| 包 | 文件数 | 覆盖内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/protocol` | 1 | 帧词汇不冲突、配对载荷边界、时序安全比较、指纹格式化 |
| `packages/plugin` | 13 | QR 编码（含**独立解码器**验证）、RFC6455 帧/握手/分片/异常、状态与防重放、HTTP+WS 网关（真实 socket）、DSH 会话桥（含语气注入与自动批准接线）、入口与模型选择回退、电源、隧道、唤醒代理、协议副本一致性、**端到端** |
| `packages/mobile` | 11 | 配对、endpoint 轮换、消息 reducer（乱序/重复 delta）、离线队列、退避、base64、帧契约 |

其中 `packages/plugin/test/qr-decode.test.mjs` 会**重新实现解码侧**（定位格式信息、还原掩码、按标准走位读取码元、校验 RS 全零 syndrome、还原原文），用来证明生成的二维码真的能被扫描，而不是只对结构打勾。

真实的装机验证（需要本机有 DSH）：

```bash
# 隔离环境，不动你正在用的 DSH_HOME
set DSH_HOME=<某个空目录>
dsh rescue --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile rescue add <本仓库>/packages/plugin
dsh --profile rescue --no-open
# 另开一个终端
node _recon/verify-real-install.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

该脚本会走完：读 health → 取二维码 → 按手机的方式校验 → 建真实 WebSocket → 用真实 Ed25519 密钥完成绑定 → 用二维码里的公钥验证电脑签名 → 发一条消息并等待回复或明确错误。

---

## 已知限制

- **远程开机受物理条件限制**（见上），插件只能提供能力与检查清单，不能变魔术。
- **快速隧道不适合长期使用**：无 uptime 保证、域名会变、部分地区不稳定。长期使用请自建隧道或组网。
- 手机端 UI 与 Expo 原生模块调用**尚未在真机上跑过**（本仓库的开发环境没有 Android SDK）；纯逻辑层有 88 项单测覆盖。出包步骤见 [docs/mobile-build.md](docs/mobile-build.md)。
- 手机端**尚未实现**：Wake-on-LAN 原生模块（目前只做引导）、后台保活、手机 → 电脑的大文件分块上传。
- 自动批准工具调用默认**关闭**（走 DSH 原有审批策略）；开启后手机发来的请求会跳过审批，请自行权衡。

---

## 设计取舍（为什么这样做）

- **零依赖**：插件要靠一次复制就装进 profile，任何依赖树或构建步骤都会变成装机失败点。QR、WebSocket、协议全部自带。
- **协议自包含**：`packages/protocol` 是唯一权威源，插件内 `src/protocol.mjs` 是生成副本，由 `test/protocol-copy.test.mjs` 保证不漂移。原因：DSH 装插件是**复制**包内容，任何 `../../` 相对导入在装机后都会解析失败（这个坑已在真实装机中踩到并修掉）。
- **音色只作用于手机会话**：用 agent 作用域的 prompt section，而不是全局设置 —— 否则会把桌面会话的技术语气也一起改掉。
- **与会话隔离**：每台手机一个专属会话（`ow-<hash>`），不污染你桌面上正在进行的对话。
- **未知帧一律忽略**：手机端和电脑端可以独立升级，不会因为对端多了一种帧就崩。

plugins.description: Skill cockpit for DSH: one page in the app-level nav listing every skill this machine exposes, why a skill is invisible, and a one-file toggle. (early / work in progress)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-cockpit

> **Status: early / work in progress.** This repository is being published ahead of its first
> release to reserve the name. The plugin already works end-to-end on the author's machine
> (4/4 self-test suites · 124 assertions) but the public docs, screenshots, and packaging are
> still being finished. Expect the surface below to change.

A **skill cockpit for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)** (DeepSeek Harness): one page in the
app-level navigation that shows every skill the machine actually exposes, says **why** a skill is
missing, and lets you toggle a single skill without editing anything but its entry-file name.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## What it does

- **One page in the application-level nav.** It takes the official `sidebar.panellist` seat with
  `order: 5` — between the shipped **Plugins** row (0) and the shipped **Schedule** row (10) — plus
  the whole page in the layout's `main` keyed slot. Both seats are registered through the
  framework's `slots` service, the same extension point the shipped pages use.
- **All six skill-root kinds, not just one.** DSH resolves skills from `project-dsh`,
  `project-agents`, `custom`, `user-dsh`, `user-agents`, and `bundled`. Scanning only
  `~/.dsh/skills` under-reports what a session can actually see.
- **It answers "why is this skill not there?"** A malformed frontmatter block makes the runtime
  drop a skill silently. The cockpit reports the concrete reason (`dropped:no-frontmatter`,
  `dropped:unclosed`, `dropped:bad-yaml`, `dropped:missing-fields`, `dropped:bad-name`), plus a
  missing root, a shadowed entry, or an explicit error — instead of showing nothing.
- **Toggling = renaming the entry file only.** Enable/disable flips `SKILL.md` ⇄
  `SKILL.md.disabled`. There is no sidecar state file, so there is exactly one source of truth:
  the filename. **Project-level skill roots are always read-only.**
- **No `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency at all.** The host half declares `inject = []` and the
  client half declares only `slots`, so the plugin is not subject to DSH's compatibility-exemption
  gate and does not touch the credentials surface.

## Install (from source, for now)

Not on npm yet. Until the first release, clone this repository and mount the working tree into a
profile with a local link:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaorui-wu/dsh-skill-cockpit.git
```

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-skill-cockpit": "link:/path/to/dsh-skill-cockpit" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "dsh-skill-cockpit"] } }
}
```

Then restart DSH. The entry appears in the left navigation as **Skills**.

## Development

```bash
node test/run-all.mjs      # 4 suites: data layer · toggle loop · host routes · client
```

Pure ESM JavaScript, no build step — `lib/*.js` runs as-is.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | host half: local HTTP routes (`/__dsh-skill-panel/*`) |
| `lib/client.js` | client half: the whole UI (classic script, `React.createElement`) |
| `lib/roots.js` · `lib/scan.js` · `lib/frontmatter.js` | six-root enumeration, scan, YAML frontmatter |
| `lib/toggle.js` | the only writer: 8 guards, entry-file rename only |
| `lib/undeclared.js` | "referenced but not installed" index |
| `test/` | self-tests (no framework) |

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# LifeClaw MCP

LifeClaw lets an AI agent make phone calls on your behalf and bring the answer back. Its hosted MCP server also lets the agent manage your saved contacts:

- `call_me` calls your verified receiving number when you ask for a phone update or an urgent alert needs your attention.
- `call_person` relays a message you confirmed to a specified person.
- `call_business` calls a business for an inquiry or booking and returns the result.
- `list_contacts`, `save_contact`, `update_contact`, and `delete_contact` manage the address book shared with your LifeClaw account. Adding, editing, or deleting a contact requires your confirmation. `call_contact` can then call a saved person after you confirm the recipient and message.

## Connect

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| MCP transport | Streamable HTTP |
| Endpoint | `https://api-v2.lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp` |
| Authentication | LifeClaw OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer lc_...` |
| Setup and tool documentation | [lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp](https://lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp) |

Claude Code and Codex can open LifeClaw's browser authorization flow without a manually created API token:

```bash
# Claude Code: install for your user (all projects), then run /mcp and authorize in your browser
claude mcp add --scope user --transport http lifeclaw https://api-v2.lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp

# Codex: the login command opens the browser authorization flow
codex mcp add lifeclaw --url https://api-v2.lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp
codex mcp login lifeclaw
```

Manage these connections in [LifeClaw Settings → Connections → Connected apps](https://lifeclaw.agentese.ai/chat?settings=tokens). OAuth access tokens refresh automatically; the connection's renewal window is 30 days.

For clients using a manual Bearer token, create one in [LifeClaw Settings → Connections → API tokens](https://lifeclaw.agentese.ai/chat?settings=tokens). Configure your MCP client to send it in the `Authorization` header. Keep the token in your client's secret or environment settings; do not commit it to a repository. Client-specific configuration syntax may differ.

For DeepSeek Harness, this repository also includes a [configuration bundle](integrations/deepseek-harness/README.md) that connects its built-in MCP client to LifeClaw. Install it from GitHub with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Manta-Network/lifeclaw` after setting `LIFECLAW_API_TOKEN` in your environment.

## Things to try

- **Urgent alert:** “If the production outage is still active and I haven't acknowledged the alert after 10 minutes, call me.”
- **Requested update:** “When the long-running job finishes, call me with a short summary.”
- **Business inquiry:** “Call the restaurant and ask whether they have a quiet table for four tonight. Tell me what they say.”
- **Booking:** “Find a nearby dentist, check availability by phone for Friday afternoon, and book a slot after I confirm the details.”
- **Change a booking:** “Call the restaurant to move my confirmed reservation to 7:30 pm and tell me whether they agree.”
- **Call family:** “Call my saved contact Mom and tell her I'll be home late. Show me the number ending and exact message before you dial.”
- **Address book:** “Help me save my mom's number as Mom after I confirm it.”

The 10-minute example needs a running client workflow that waits, checks whether the alert is still active and unacknowledged, then asks LifeClaw to call. LifeClaw handles the phone call; the client handles the timer and alert checks.

Calls may consume credits and require phone setup. Verify your receiving number before using `call_me`. Confirm the recipient, number, and exact message before using `call_person`. See the [MCP documentation](https://lifeclaw.agentese.ai/mcp) for limits and usage examples.

Support: [LifeClaw Telegram](https://t.me/agenteseAI). The public configuration files in this repository are licensed under [MIT](LICENSE).

# dsh-pomodoro-timer

A Pomodoro timer for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI: a **sidebar page** with focus / short-break / long-break cycles, plus a **countdown pill** beside the composer.

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Repository: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer> · Issues: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer/issues> · Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pomodoro-timer>

## Features

- **Sidebar page** — clock icon in the left panel list opens a full page with a progress ring, controls, and statistics.
- **Composer pill** — a compact countdown next to the message box; click it to jump to the page. It keeps running while you work in chat.
- **Cycle control** — focus 25 / short break 5 / long break 15 minutes by default, a long break every 4 pomodoros, and an optional auto-start for the next phase.
- **Controls** — start, pause, resume, reset the current phase, skip to the next phase.
- **Statistics** — the pomodoro number in the current round and how many you finished today; the counter rolls over at midnight.
- **Chime** — three short tones when a phase ends naturally (can be turned off; the page needs one interaction before the browser allows audio).
- **Survives a reload** — the running deadline is stored in `localStorage`, so refreshing the page resumes the same countdown.
- **Light and dark themes** — every colour is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token; the plugin imports no Harness client package, so it does not break when those internals change.
- **Bilingual** — Simplified Chinese and English, following the GUI language.

## Requirements

| Component | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` (Web/Desktop profiles); the plugin uses only the public client `slots` and `locale` services, and declares no DSH peer dependency |
| DSH profile | a Web surface (`web`, or the Desktop app); headless profiles have no UI |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (only for the optional local check) |

## Install

```powershell
# plain dsh web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

In the Desktop app, install `dsh-pomodoro-timer` from the plugin market page, or from **Settings → Plugins**. Restart Harness (or reload the page) afterwards, then look for the clock icon in the sidebar panel list.

## Usage

| Control | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Start / Pause | Start or pause the current phase |
| Reset | Restore the current phase to its full length and pause |
| Skip | Move to the next phase without crediting a pomodoro |
| Settings | Focus length, short break, long break, pomodoros per long break, auto-start, chime |

Changing a duration while a phase is paused resizes it immediately; while it is running, the change applies from the next phase.

State lives under the `dsh.plugin.pomodoro-timer.v1` key in `localStorage`.

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

## Development

No build step: `client.js` is the published browser bundle. The package ships a self-contained offline check.

```powershell
npm run check     # node --check on both halves + the offline bundle test
# pnpm run check works too. On a machine that only has DSH's bundled runtime, put
# the workspace shims on PATH first:  $env:PATH = "<workspace>\bin;$env:PATH"
```

`test/client.test.mjs` loads the browser bundle with a module-loader stub and a fake client context and exercises registration ids, the phase machine, persistence, and component rendering. It proves logic, not looks — visual verification needs the running GUI.

### Layout

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | manifest: bundle patch, client declaration, export map, icon, file allowlist |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the Host row that puts the browser bundle in the module graph |
| `index.js` | Host half — intentionally a no-op |
| `client.js` | the timer store, the sidebar page, the composer pill, and both dictionaries |
| `locale/*.json` | plugin-card title and description |
| `icon.svg` | plugin-card artwork |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | offline check |

## Notes

- The plugin reads and writes nothing but its own `localStorage` key. It has no host-side service, no tool, and no network access.
- It registers into `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, and `conversation.composer.dock`; it never replaces the app root and never appends to `document.body`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle
