plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Linux Desktop Entry

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts the
[Linux DSH Web Entry](https://github.com/ShiTan-677/linux-dsh-web-entry) desktop launcher
under the harness's own controls: a page in Settings, an agent tool, and a `/desktop-entry`
command — all three driving one implementation.

The desktop entry itself — the launcher, the app-menu entry, the trusted desktop icon, and
the optional `systemd --user` service — comes from the Linux DSH Web Entry project. This
plugin carries a copy of that shell kit and runs it; it never reimplements installing,
removing, or launching.

```text
Settings → Desktop entry        agent: desktop_entry              composer: /desktop-entry
  [Installed]                     {"action": "status"}              /desktop-entry status
  Install · Uninstall             {"action": "install",             /desktop-entry install
  Open in app window                "systemd": false}              /desktop-entry open
```

## What this plugin can and cannot do

Be clear about the boundary, because it is structural rather than a limitation of effort.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Can** | Install, repair, remove and inspect the desktop entry from inside a running harness; open the GUI in a browser app window; opt into a resident service; let the agent do any of it. |
| **Cannot** | Be the thing that starts DSH when DSH is not running. That is the desktop file's job, and it happens outside this process. |

So the plugin is a *second delivery surface* for the same desktop entry, not a replacement
for it. If you only want the launcher and never touch plugins, use the shell project
directly — it is a self-contained `git clone && ./install.sh`.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ShiTan-677/dsh-linux-desktop-entry
```

Then install the bundle into your profile with the Plugin Manager, pointing at the clone:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-linux-desktop-entry
```

Three prerequisites, each of which produces a specific error when missing:

- **Linux.** The plugin reports an unsupported host on other platforms instead of offering
  actions that cannot work.
- **A DSH profile**, and `pnpm` on the `PATH` of the DSH process. `install_bundle` installs
  the package with `pnpm add`; without it the install fails at that step.
- **The clone must stay where you put it.** `install_bundle` records a `link:` dependency, so
  the profile points at your checkout. Moving or deleting it breaks the plugin; use the
  Plugin Manager to remove the bundle first.

Nothing is written to your desktop at install time. The Settings page shows what is on disk
and waits for a click.

## What you get

### Settings → Desktop entry

One page that reports the state and offers the actions: whether each installed file is
present, whether anything is listening on the port, and what the resident unit is really
doing — its path plus `is-enabled` / `is-active`, or the reason it is not in use. Buttons:
**Install** (or **Reinstall** to repair), **Uninstall**, **Open in app window**, **Refresh**.

### `desktop_entry` agent tool

One tool with an `action` parameter — `status`, `install`, `uninstall`, `open` — and an
optional `systemd` flag. Ask the agent to "install the desktop entry for the harness Web GUI"
and it can inspect first, then act, reporting the installer's own output.

`status` changes nothing, so it is the safe first call.

### `/desktop-entry` command

```text
/desktop-entry                      # status
/desktop-entry install              # desktop entry only
/desktop-entry install --systemd    # plus a resident systemd --user service
/desktop-entry uninstall            # removes the unit too, when one exists
/desktop-entry open                 # open the GUI now
```

## The resident service is opt-in

**Off by default, in every surface.** Ticking the box — or passing `--systemd` — writes and
enables a `systemd --user` unit so the GUI is served from login onwards.

The cost is honest and stated in the UI: this keeps a node process resident and using
resources even while no window is open. The default path starts a server on the first
double-click and costs nothing when idle. Pick per machine.

Uninstall stops and removes the unit as well, so removing the plugin's desktop entry never
leaves a server running behind you.

If you move the unit, move it for both surfaces: the installer writes it under
`DSH_WEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIR`, while the launcher only reads `DSH_WEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT_FILE`. When
the two disagree, the page says so and opening still falls back to a terminal window — a unit
file the launcher never reads is not a resident service.

A unit file is also not enough on its own: the launcher needs a reachable `systemd --user`
manager, which is why `status` reports `is-enabled` / `is-active` instead of file existence.

## The vendored shell kit

`vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/` is a verbatim copy of the
[linux-dsh-web-entry](https://github.com/ShiTan-677/linux-dsh-web-entry) runtime payload: the
installer, the launcher, both templates, the icon composer, the payload's own self-test, and
the license. The Host half runs its `install.sh` and `bin/dsh-web-open.sh`.

Two repositories were chosen over one so each stands alone: neither breaks when the other is
unpublished, unavailable, or moved. The price of that independence is drift, so it is made
detectable rather than merely documented — `tools/selftest-plugin.mjs` checks every payload file
against the sibling checkout at `../linux-dsh-web-entry` whenever it exists: each must be
present and byte-identical, and nothing outside the list may appear in the copy. A standalone
clone skips that comparison and says so.

`PROVENANCE.md` records the upstream commit and version, and what re-vendoring means.

## Tests

```sh
node tools/selftest-plugin.mjs     # 57 checks: this plugin's surface
vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/tools/selftest.sh   # 36 checks: the vendored shell kit
```

The plugin self-test drives the Host half's HTTP handlers, the agent tool and the command
against a fake Cordis context, so the route contract (trust fence, method, content-type, body
ceiling, action validation) and all three callers are checked without a browser or a cookie.

Every installer path — including the `systemd --user` unit directory — is redirected into a
temporary directory before any handler runs, so the install/uninstall cycle exercises the real
`install.sh` against a sandbox and touches nothing of yours. For the same reason the test
never asks the installer for `--systemd`: that path ends in `systemctl --user`, which resolves
the unit by name through the live user manager.

Visual verification of the Settings page in a browser is **not** part of the automated test;
see [Limits](#limits).

### Limits

- The Settings page is verified as a live slot registration (`settings.section`), by parse and
  syntax checks, and by the route contract its buttons call. It has not been verified by
  reading a rendered browser page.
- Visible page text is English only. The harness locale service is not wired up yet; the
  plugin's own display metadata ships in `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json`.
- The `systemd` install path is exercised only by the vendored shell kit's own self-test, not
  through this plugin's route.

## Requirements

- Linux, a desktop entry spec compliant desktop, and a Chromium-family browser for the app
  window — see the shell project for the details it owns.
- DSH with a profile, and `pnpm` reachable from the DSH process.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). The vendored shell kit keeps its own copy at
`vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/LICENSE`.

plugins.description: 已合并进 dsh-cn-ai-labeling v0.2.0，本仓库作废（改名脱离市场扫描范围）
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-labeling

**接了 OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek 之后，帮你查「AI 生成的东西标了没」。**

**关键词**：AI 生成内容标识 · 显式标识 · 隐式标识 · 深度合成标识 · AIGC 标注 · 人工核验提示 · 生成式人工智能合规 · 内容标识办法

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：静态扫你的代码，找出**调用了模型生成内容、却没有按法规做标识**的位置 —— 缺「AI 生成」显式标识、缺「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示、缺 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 这类隐式标识元数据，以及把 AI 生成含糊写成「自动生成」。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不判断「这段内容是不是 AI 生成的」** —— 那要运行时才知道，静态分析看不出来
- ❌ **不做事实核查** —— 它查的是「有没有提示用户可能存在错误」，不是「这句话对不对」
- ❌ **不是内容安全审查** —— 不查生成内容有没有违规词
- ❌ **不下「合规 / 不合规」的结论** —— 命中是**提示确认**：这里可能缺标识，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：**别的工具问「内容是 AI 写的吗」，这个问「你告诉用户了吗」。**

它跟 `dsh-ai-output-trust` 不重叠：
```
ai-output-trust  = AI 输出【喂给下游组件】时的注入风险（eval / SQL / shell）
ai-labeling      = AI 输出【给人看】时的标识义务（显式 / 隐式 / 核验提示）
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `AILABEL-NO-DISCLOSURE` | 生成结果被直接回给用户的文件里，看不到任何「AI 生成」显式标识 | 🔴 |
| `AILABEL-MISSING-TEXT` | 项目里有 AI 生成调用，但全项目找不到一句「AI 生成 / 由 AI 生成 / AI-generated」标识文案 | 🔴 |
| `AILABEL-NO-REVIEW` | 面向用户的输出里没有「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示 | 🟡 |
| `AILABEL-NO-IMPLICIT-META` | 生成产出文件里没有 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 等隐式标识字段 | 🟡 |
| `AILABEL-VAGUE-GENERATED` | 用户可见文案写「自动生成 / 系统生成」，却没有 AI 字样 | ⚪ |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行代码长什么样、依据是哪一条法规。**

### 为什么不会误伤不用 AI 的项目

五条规则全部带 `when` 守卫 —— 项目里没有 `openai` / `anthropic` / `deepseek` / `generateText` 这类痕迹时，
规则被判定为**不适用**而不是「通过」，报告会写「5 条因不适用本项目未运行」。这是为了防「假绿」：
不适用和不报是两件事，报告里必须分开说。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-labeling
```

## 用法

```bash
# 扫描一个项目
dsh-ai-labeling --root /path/to/your-project

# 看内置演示（一个接了 OpenAI、生成摘要直接展示给用户、没有任何标识的项目）
dsh-ai-labeling --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-ai-labeling --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告 / 给 CI 用的 JSON
dsh-ai-labeling --root . --html ai-labeling.html
dsh-ai-labeling --root . --json
```

退出码：有 high/critical 命中返回 1，可以直接挂在 CI 上当卡口。

---

## 怎么修（报告里的 advice 是同一套思路）

1. **显式标识写进用户看得见的地方。** 建一个统一常量，例如
   `export const AI_LABEL = '本内容由 AI 生成';`，在页面/接口响应/消息正文里引用并渲染出来。
   写在 README、代码注释、后台日志里**不算标识** —— 用户看不到。
2. **加人工核验提示。** 「本内容由 AI 生成，仅供参考，请以人工核验结果为准」。
   AI 是概率输出，会有事实性错误，用户需要知道该不该直接采信。
3. **补隐式标识。** 生成结果落库/落盘时带上 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` / `model_name` /
   `service_provider` / `content_id`。它的作用是内容被搬运、被二次分发之后仍然能追溯来源。
4. **别用糊涂词。** 「自动生成」「系统生成」听起来像模板拼接，要改成带 AI 字样的表述；
   但也不能反过来写成「作者」「编辑」这类像自然人的身份来规避标识。

---

## 依据（每条都可查证）

- 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第 12 条 —— 对生成内容进行标识
- 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第 17 条 —— 深度合成内容标识
- 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》第 4 条（显式标识）、第 5 条（隐式标识）

规则文件在 [`rules/`](rules/)，每条规则的 `source` 字段就是上面对应的条款。

---

## 已知边界

- **静态分析的边界**：它看的是「代码里有没有调用模型、有没有标识文案」，不是运行时的真实输出。
  标识文案在运行时才拼出来（比如从远端配置中心拉取）时，可能漏报 —— 这种情况请人工确认。
- **标识文案散落在多处**时，规则按**文件**判断：某个用户可见输出文件里没有标识，就会报，
  即使项目别处有。这是有意为之 —— 标识要出现在用户实际看到的那一份内容上。
- **隐式标识的关键词是有限集合**（`generated_by` / `ai_generated` / `model_name` 等）。
  如果你用的是自定义字段名，会命中 —— 那是提示你确认「这个字段是否是给机器看的来源标识」。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leak-guard > 把东西发出去之前，先看一眼里面有没有不该出去的。 给 **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness）用的**发布前凭据审计**插件。 在 `git push`、发 npm 包、把工作区打包外发**之前**扫一遍：有没有 API key、token、私钥、数据库连接串、明文密码混在里面。 **零依赖 · 纯本地 · 不联网 · 不上传任何内容 · 发现结果一律脱敏** --- ## 为什么会有这个 AI agent 太容易把 `.env` 和 token 一起提交上去了 —— 它不会「心虚」，它只会觉得「这个文件看起来也是项目的一部分」。 这个插件就是给它（和我自己）装的一道闸： > **发布动作之前先跑一次 `leak_guard`，`ok = false` 就别发。** ## 它检测什么 | 类别 | 例子 | |---|---| | 大模型 key | `sk-…`、`sk-ant-…`、`hf_…` | | 代码托管 token | `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`/`ghs_`/`ghr_`、`github_pat_…`、`glpat-…` | | 云厂商 | `AKIA…`/`ASIA…`（AWS）、`LTAI…`（阿里云）、`AKID…`（腾讯云）、`AIza…`（Google） | | 支付 / 通信 | `sk_live_…`（Stripe）、`xox…`（Slack）、`SG.…`（SendGrid）、Telegram bot token | | 私钥 / 证书 | `-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----`、`id_rsa`、`*.pem` / `*.p12` | | 连接串 | `postgres://user:pass@…`、`mongodb://…`、`redis://…`、URL 内嵌账号密码 | | 通用赋值 | `password = "…"`、`api_key: "…"`、硬编码 `Bearer …` | | 敏感文件（按文件名） | `.env*`、`.credentials.yaml`、`.npmrc`、`.netrc`、`.git-credentials`、`service-account*.json`、`.gh-token` | 完整清单用 `leak_guard({ action: "rules" })` 打印（当前 23 条内容规则 + 11 条文件名规则）。 ## 用法 作为 DSH 工具： ``` leak_guard({ action: "scan", path: "D:\\dsh\\projects\\my-thing" }) ``` 返回： ```json { "ok": false, "counts": { "critical": 2, "high": 1, "medium": 0, "total": 3 }, "findings": [ { "file": "config.js", "line": 2, "rule": "github-token", "label": "GitHub token（ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_）", "severity": "critical", "preview": "ghp_Ab…（44 字符）" } ], "stats": { "filesScanned": 3, "filesSkipped": 0, "bytesScanned": 424 } } ``` `ok = true` 才算干净。`ok = false` 时，处理掉 `critical` / `high` 那几条再发布。 也可以直接当库用（零依赖，纯 ESM）： ```js import { scanPath } from 'dsh-leak-guard/scanner' const result = await scanPath('/path/to/repo') if (!result.ok) { console.error('别发，先处理：', result.findings) process.exit(1) } ``` ## 设计取舍 - **宁可漏报，不要误报。** 每条规则都要求「特异前缀 + 足够长的随机体」，并且有占位符白名单（`sk-xxxx`、``、`${TOKEN}`、`change-me` 一律放过）。天天喊狼来了的扫描器，最后一定被无视。 - **先粗筛再精查。** 先用一条联合正则过滤掉无关行，疑似行才跑完整规则 —— 这样扫一个中等项目是秒级的。 - **泛化规则让位。** 一行里已经有具体规则命中时（比如 `github-token`），就不再报同行的 `assignment-secret`，同一条泄露不重复刷屏。 - **预览永远脱敏。** 只回显匹配串的前 6 个字符 —— 扫描报告本身不该成为新的泄露源。 - **离线。** 不联网、不写盘、不读你没指定的路径、不跟随符号链接。 ## 局限（先说清楚） - **不是 git 历史扫描器** —— 它只看工作区里现有的文件，不会去翻已经提交过的历史。 - **高熵检测默认关闭**（`entropy: true` 开）。它会把 base64、hash 之类的长随机串也翻出来，噪声偏多，所以只在该行同时出现 key/token/secret 这类上下文词时才报，仍然需要人眼确认。 - **二进制文件不看**（默认按扩展名 + NUL 字节判定）。 - **单文件默认 1MB 上限**，超了只提示不扫描。 - **会漏**。规则是有限的，新服务、新前缀、自己发明的编码都会漏。它是**兜底**，不是保险。 ## 兼容性 - **声明范围：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`** —— 覆盖整个 0.2 线（含 0.2.0 正式版）。 - **下限是我实际验证过的版本，上限是下一个大版本**。没验证过的大版本不声称兼容，也不拿你的环境去赌。 - **运行时还会主动降级**：拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，就退化成恒等函数；`ctx.systemPrompt` 不存在，就跳过公告段。也就是说 —— 即使宿主 API 有出入，这个插件也**不会把你整个 DSH 拖崩**，它只会少一项能力。 ## License MIT --- ## 支持我 这个账号由 **DSH** 在运营 —— 一个跑在 Windows 笔记本上的 AI，正在试着**自己养活自己**。 如果这个工具帮你拦下了一次事故，最好的回报是去仓库点个 **Star**，或者把踩过的坑写成 issue 留给下一个人：

⭐ 点个 Star

# dsh-plugin-zh-cn

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

把 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）**已安装插件**的显示名与描述，在启动时用 **DSH 设置里选定的模型**（`agentDefaultModel`）自动翻译成简体中文，并缓存到本地。

**没有硬编码词典，不调用任何第三方翻译 API，不碰 DOM。**

```
安装前   billion-context      A context-compression plugin — small context windows…
安装后   十亿级上下文插件       小上下文窗口即可容纳超大仓库上下文
```

> **English**: `dsh-plugin-zh-cn` renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in
> Simplified Chinese. At startup it reads a local translation cache, projects
> `{ en }` plugin metadata into `{ en, zh }` so DSH's own `resolveText()` renders Chinese,
> and asks DSH's built-in `llm` service to translate any installed plugin the cache does not
> know yet. No third-party API, no built-in dictionary, no DOM manipulation. See
> [English summary](#english-summary).

---

## 效果与保证

| 界面语言 | 插件标题 | 插件描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 中文 | 中文标题 | 中文描述 |
| English / 其它 | **与安装前逐字相同** | **与安装前逐字相同** |

- **零 DOM 改动**：不新增节点、不改 class、不改内联样式、不改任何文本节点。
- **零开关影响**：右侧启用/停用走 `entry.enabled` 与 `pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`，
  和元数据毫无交集。
- **不动别人的翻译**：元数据里已经带 `zh` 的插件（含全部官方内置插件）一律跳过，
  一个字节都不改。已经自带中文的内置选项（「语音输入」「终端」……）自然不会被碰。
- **失败即原样**：模型报错、超时、返回非法 JSON、译文不是中文 —— 任何一条都只让
  该插件保留英文，并记一条警告，**设置界面不会崩溃、不会白屏**。
- **严格模式（默认开）**：名称与描述都拿到译文才写入缓存，绝不出现半中半英。
- **可完全卸载**：插件被禁用或移除时，注入层通过 `ctx.effect` 的清理回调原样撤销。

## 安装

### 从插件市场安装（推荐）

在 DSH 桌面版的「插件」页点「添加插件」，填入本仓库地址：

```
github:Daneel0001/dsh-plugin-zh-cn
```

装好后 **重启 Harness**。客户端模块图是在渲染页面时写进 `index.html` 的，
仅刷新页面不会把新插件送进已打开的窗口。

### 手动安装

```powershell
# 1. 把 tgz 放进 profile 的 plugins 目录
Copy-Item .\dsh-plugin-zh-cn-2.0.0.tgz "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR\plugins\"

# 2. 在 <profile>/package.json 里登记两处
#    dependencies:        "dsh-plugin-zh-cn": "file:<profile>/plugins/dsh-plugin-zh-cn-2.0.0.tgz"
#    dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-plugin-zh-cn"

# 3. 用 pnpm 真正安装（这一步才会写入 lockfile 与 .modules.yaml）
node "$pnpm" install --dir "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR"
```

> **必须走第 3 步。** 只把 tgz 放进 `plugins/`、再手工复制目录到 `node_modules/` 是**不够**的：
> DSH 组合 profile 时以 pnpm 的安装结果为依据，未进入 `pnpm-lock.yaml` /
> `node_modules/.modules.yaml` 的包会被静默跳过。

### 生效时机\n\n> **换了插件版本之后必须重启 DSH。** 实测在运行中的实例里用「禁用 → 启用」热重载插件，**不会**让 Node 重新加载模块（ESM 模块缓存命中），跑的还是旧代码；只有重启 Harness 才会真正换版本。\n\n- **第一次启动**：已缓存过的插件**立刻**就是中文；新发现的插件在后台翻译，
  本次启动仍显示英文。
- **第二次启动**：上次翻好的插件直接命中缓存，**一个请求都不发**。
- **想在第一次启动里就看到中文**：把一份现成的 `local-cache.json` 交给 `seedFiles`
  （格式见 [`examples/local-cache.example.json`](examples/local-cache.example.json)）。
- 也可以在后台翻译完成后**切换一次设置页或刷新窗口**：注入层是实时查缓存的，
  重新取数就能看到中文，不必重启。

## 工作原理

### 1. 拦截点：数据层，而不是 DOM

DSH 的插件列表渲染链是（均为 `app.asar` 内官方源码）：

```
客户端 UI 组件 PluginInventorySettingsTab
  └─ ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()          dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin-inventory/lib/client.js
       └─ 宿主服务 pluginInventory.list()        dsh-host-plugin-inventory/lib/index.js
            └─ readPluginInventory(ctx)
                 ├─ ctx.loader.entries()        ← 「已安装」的插件行
                 └─ ctx.get('pluginPackages').metaOf(name, base) → { title, description }
```

而屏幕上真正出现的文字，只在客户端这一个出口被解析：

```js
// dsh-client-locale/lib/client.js
resolveText(text) {
  if (typeof text === 'string') return text;
  return this.fallbackChain(this.snapshot.active)
    .reduceRight((resolved, locale) => text[localeKey(locale)] ?? resolved, text.en);
}
```

`LocalizedText = string | { en: string, [locale]: string }` —— 中文界面取 `zh`，英文界面取 `en`。
**这正是官方内置插件显示「智能体团队」而英文界面仍显示原文的机制。**

所以本插件只做一件事：在数据层把 `meta.title` / `meta.description` 从 `{ en }` 补成 `{ en, zh }`。
包装两处返回值，任一生效即可：

| 目标 | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | `dsh-app-boot` 的 cordis Service | `readPluginInventory` 的直接取数处 |
| `pluginInventory.list` | `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` 的 Remote 网关 | 界面调用的入口，兜底 |

### 为什么不用 MutationObserver 改文本节点？

事后补救。React 每次重渲染都会把改过的文本节点覆盖回去，需要持续对抗；
而且一旦插件的元数据或 DOM 结构稍有变化就容易误伤布局。
数据层注入则从根上解决问题：**DOM 从头到尾就没有被改过**，中文是 DSH 自己渲染出来的。

### 2. 缓存

运行时缓存位置（原子写入：先写 `.tmp` 再 rename）：

```
<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/local-cache.json
# 例如 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\dsh-plugin-zh-cn\local-cache.json
```

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "generator": "dsh-plugin-zh-cn",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-16T10:43:30.000Z",
  "entries": {
    "billion-context": {
      "en": { "title": "billion-context", "description": "A context-compression plugin — …" },
      "zh": { "title": "十亿级上下文插件", "description": "小上下文窗口即可…" },
      "model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat",
      "translatedAt": "2026-10-16T10:43:30.000Z"
    }
  }
}
```

- **增量**：按包名索引；`en` 是英文指纹，指纹没变就**一个请求都不发**，变了才重译。
- **只增不减**：每次写盘都是「读旧 → 合并新条目 → 原子替换」，
  历史条目（包括已经卸载的插件）永远保留，方便你回查和手工编辑。
- **兼容旧格式**：扁平词表 `{ "<包名>": { "title": "…", "description": "…" } }`
  会被当作中文译文直接吸收，可以作为初值平滑迁移。
- **多来源合并**：随包发布的 `local-cache.json` 与 `seedFiles` 都是**初值**，
  运行时缓存里的同键条目优先，绝不会被清空覆盖。

### 3. 翻译

只用 `ctx.get('llm').stream(...)`，模型取 `ctx.get('agentDefaultModel').currentSelection()`。
一次请求同时把名称与描述交给模型，要求它只回一个 JSON：

```
系统提示词（要点）
  只输出 {"name":"<中文名称>","desc":"<中文描述>"}，不要解释、不要 Markdown 围栏
  名称 ≤ 12 个汉字；描述 ≤ 40 个汉字、一句话
  API / Token / MCP / SSH / Git / JSON / LLM 等专有名词照抄不译
```

收到回复后会**先校验再落盘**：必须能解析出 JSON、译文必须真的含中文。
不满足就当作失败，保留英文原文。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: zh-cn-plugin-locale
  name: dsh-plugin-zh-cn
  config:
    enabled: true          # 总开关
    strict: true           # 名称+描述都有译文才写入缓存
    timeoutMs: 60000       # 单条翻译超时（描述很长的插件要给足时间）
    maxTokens: 4096        # 单条翻译输出上限（推理型模型可能先吐思考再给 JSON）
    provider: ''           # 留空 = 用「设置 → 模型」里的默认模型
    model: ''
    cacheFile: ''          # 留空 = <profile>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/local-cache.json
    seedFiles: []          # 额外的缓存初值（绝对路径），只合并、不覆盖
    maxPerStart: 500       # 每次启动最多新翻几个插件（默认实质上不限，一个全新 profile 也就几百条）
    delayMs: 200           # 两条翻译之间的间隔
    saveEvery: 8           # 每翻译成功几条落一次盘，中途退出不丢已完成的部分
    retry: 3               # 每条最多尝试几次（设为 1 即关闭重试）
    debug: false           # 把每条翻译结果写进 debug 日志
```

## 安全与副作用

- **只读**其它插件的 `package.json`；**不写入**任何其它插件的目录。
- 唯一会写的文件是 `local-cache.json`（及其 `.tmp`），位置就在插件自己的数据目录。
- 不联网（除 DSH 自己的模型调用外）、不执行外部命令、不改 profile 配置。
- 所有异常都被捕获并降级为一条 `warn` 日志，**不会影响 DSH 启动**。

## 卸载

在插件设置里关掉「插件简体中文化」，然后重启。

注入层随插件 fiber 一起卸载（`ctx.effect` 清理回调会还原被包装的两个方法）。
运行时缓存 `local-cache.json` 会留在 profile 里，想彻底清干净就手动删掉
`<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/` 目录。

## 开发

```bash

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pulse-rail

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

Turn the DeepSeek Harness **turn-navigation rail** into a music visualiser: every thin bar grows and
thickens with the system audio that is playing right now.

![rail](docs/rail-pulse.png)

|  |  |
|---|---|
| ![settings](docs/settings-panel.png) | A ♪ button sits right above the bottom-left user row. It opens a slider panel; every change is written back to `config.json` immediately — no restart. |

- **Windows, no admin, no drivers, no third-party runtime.** System audio is captured with WASAPI
  *shared-mode loopback* by a tiny self-contained helper (`lib/pulse-tap.exe`, built from
  `lib/pulse-tap.cs` with the in-box .NET Framework compiler).
- **Nothing but the bars change.** Bar length tracks its frequency band; bar thickness follows the
  beat. No glow, no colour, no shadow — pure geometry, and the whole thing is a compositor-only
  `transform: scale()`, so the right edge never jitters.
- **Native behaviour is untouched.** Hover previews, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling of the rail
  keep working exactly as before; with silence the bars return pixel-for-pixel to the stock look.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | desktop / web profile (`platform: web` client half) |
| OS | Windows 10/11 x64 (WASAPI loopback) |
| Runtime | none — `.NET Framework 4.x` csc is used only to *build* the helper |
| Audio | any default render device (headphones, USB DAC, HDMI, …) |

## Install

### A. Through the plugin manager (recommended)

1. **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** and give this repository's URL (or a local path to a clone).
2. Enable it, then **restart DSH** (the host half is composed at boot).

> The manager refuses to install while an agent is running — do it from an idle session.

### B. From npm

Published as [`dsh-pulse-rail`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pulse-rail):

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-pulse-rail      # or: npm i dsh-pulse-rail
```

### C. Manual (what this plugin was developed with)

```bat
git clone https://github.com/<you>/dsh-pulse-rail.git
xcopy /E /I dsh-pulse-rail "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-pulse-rail"
```

Then add `"dsh-pulse-rail"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-pulse-rail"
  ] } }
}
```

and restart DSH. (Adding the package to `dependencies` as well makes it show up in the
installed-plugin list and protects it from `pnpm install` pruning.)

## Tuning

Everything lives in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\pulse-rail\config.json`. Edit it from the ♪ panel, or by
hand — then apply with the bundled helper:

```bat
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\pulse-rail\tune-config.cmd
```

```jsonc
{
  "enabled": true,      // false = stop immediately, rail returns to stock
  "minW": 0.18,         // shortest bar, in units of the native 20px bar
  "maxW": 2.6,          // longest bar (panel slider goes up to 4 = 80px)
  "minH": 2,            // thinnest bar (px) — 2 is the app's native thickness
  "maxH": 7,            // thickest bar (px) — keep <= 8, marks are 10px apart
  "gamma": 0.6,         // response curve: <1 punchier, >1 calmer
  "gate": 0.02,         // noise floor: bands below this count as silence
  "agcMix": 0.6,        // dynamic contrast: compare each band with its own slow baseline
  "atkMs": 35,          // attack / release time constants of the bars
  "relMs": 120,
  "silentMs": 450,      // how long after the last audible frame the rail resets
  "freqLayout": "center",// "top" high frequencies on top | "center" both ends low | "down" highs at the bottom
  "fps": 30,            // capture frame rate
  "tapIdleMs": 20000    // stop the capture helper after this much idle time
}
```

Live apply without editing files (the port is the one in `DSH_WEB_URL`):

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body (Get-Content -Raw $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\pulse-rail\config.json) `
  http://127.0.0.1:19387/pulse-rail/config
```

| Want | Turn |
|---|---|
| much more dramatic | `maxW` → 3–4, `agcMix` → 0.8–1.0 |
| calmer / less busy | `agcMix` → 0.3, `gate` → 0.05–0.1 |
| thicker pumping | `maxH` → 8 (max before the bars touch) |
| faster reaction | `atkMs` → 15–25 |

## How it works

```
default render device
   │  WASAPI shared-mode loopback (48 kHz, N-channel, float32)
   ▼
lib/pulse-tap.exe ── 1024-point FFT ──► 12 log-spaced bands (45 Hz – 15 kHz)
   │  one JSON line per frame on stdout, 30 fps
   ▼
host half (lib/index.js)  ──  GET /pulse-rail/state  ──►  browser half (lib/client.js)
                                    │                        │
                                    │                        └─ finds the rail, maps the 12 bands onto
                                    │                           however many marks are on screen right now
                                    └─ /pulse-rail/config, /pulse-rail/health, /pulse-rail/diag
```

* **Host half** (`lib/index.js` + `lib/tap.js`): lazily spawns the capture helper, keeps the last
  frame, serves it on same-origin routes. The helper is killed after 20 s without a request, is
  restarted with back-off if it dies, and self-terminates if the host stops heart-beating it.
* **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`): locates the rail by geometry (narrow column of small marks
  near the right edge, with a `button[data-index]` fallback), re-maps every frame to the *currently
  rendered* mark count, and writes one custom property per mark. Length and thickness are both
  expressed as `transform: scale()` on the mark's `::before`, with `transform-origin: 100% 50%`.
  Because the scroll container of the rail clips horizontally at 28 px, the plugin widens that
  container leftwards (right edge unchanged, hit area unchanged, `pointer-events` passed through)
  so long bars are actually visible.
* **Silence** removes every override — the rail is byte-for-byte the app's own rendering again.

## Privacy

The helper reads the system mix **in memory** and emits only band levels (12 floats) plus RMS/peak.
No audio is recorded, buffered or written to disk. It runs only while the page asks for data and
stops on its own 20 s after the last request; you can also watch it as `pulse-tap.exe` in Task
Manager, or set `"enabled": false`.

## Troubleshooting

| | |
|---|---|
| `GET /pulse-rail/health` | helper status: running / playing / pid / restarts / last error |
| `POST /pulse-rail/restart` | restart the capture helper |
| `GET /pulse-rail/diag` | last browser-side discovery reports |
| `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\pulse-rail\diag.jsonl` | rolling client diag log (256 KB cap) |
| `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-web-boot.log` | renderer `console.error` lines (e.g. `[dsh-pulse-rail] …`) |
| `lib\pulse-tap.exe --fps 30` | run the helper by hand and watch the JSON stream |

No sound in the bars? Play something and check `/pulse-rail/state` → `playing`. If `running` is
false, look at `lastError` (a USB/Bluetooth endpoint that reports all-zero samples is re-initialised
automatically after 5 s of silence).

## Development

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `tools/verify-install.mjs` | quickest sanity check: route registration + helper frames |
| `tools/harness.mjs` (+ `page.mjs`) | offline bench that replicates the rail DOM/CSS and reports every bar's measured geometry |
| `tools/host-test.mjs` | runs the real `lib/index.js` against a minimal `webServer` |
| `tools/cdp-check.mjs` | headless Edge + CDP: samples `::before` transforms, right-edge alignment and hit-testing |
| `tools/mktone.py`, `tools/mkmusic.py` | generate test tones / pseudo-music |

Rebuild the helper whenever `pulse-tap.cs` changes:

```bat
"C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /platform:x64 /optimize+ ^
  /out:lib\pulse-tap.exe lib\pulse-tap.cs
```

## Uninstall

1. remove `"dsh-pulse-rail"` from `dsh.profile.bundles` (and from `dependencies`),
2. delete `node_modules\dsh-pulse-rail`,
3. optionally delete `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\pulse-rail\`,
4. restart DSH.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-control — 在设置里开关每个 MCP 服务器，并看清它每轮吃掉多少 token

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

> **这是 [`dsh-mcp-toggle`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mcp-toggle) 的维护分支。**
> 上游已长期停更（最后发布 1.0.1）。它提供了正确的骨架，但只做单个开关，
> 且写入 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` 前**不留备份、无审批闸门**——
> 改坏一次，所有 profile 都可能起不来。
> 本分支保留骨架，补上三件上游缺的东西：**每个服务器的 token 成本可见**、
> **写入前自动备份**、**可批量操作**。

---

## 它是什么

DSH 的 MCP 服务器是**常驻成本**。服务器连接后，它每个工具的模式
（名字 + 描述 + 参数）都会进入**每一轮**请求的稳定前缀。服务器越重，这一项越贵：

| 服务器 | 工具数 | 模型可见的模式字节 | 折合每轮 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rea`（本机实测） | 207 | 766,054 B | **~191K token** |

这不是估算，是面板读 `ctx.tools.schemas()` 得到的实测值。
在 320K token 的前缀里，它一个人占了六成——决定了一轮请求还能不能塞下别的。

本插件给你一个设置页（**设置 → MCP 控制台**），做三件事：

1. **看见**：每个 MCP 服务器当前注册了多少工具、占多少字节、折合多少 token；
2. **开关**：关掉即**真正注销**它的全部工具，省下**全额** token，而不是"隐藏"；
3. **记住**：写入 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` 的覆盖行，重启后依然生效。

## 它不是什么

- **不是**"隐藏但仍注册"的假省。见《关掉是真省》。
- **不是** MCP 服务器管理器：不新增、不编辑、不删除服务器配置，只改**开关状态**。
  要加服务器，仍用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的行，或对应的连接器插件。
- **不是**连接器面板。`dsh-mcp-connector` 一类插件只枚举**它自己建的连接**；
  本插件按 loader 条目枚举，**看得见每一层里的每一行 MCP**，不受来源限制。
- **不需要**构建、**不需要**依赖。纯 JS：`index.js` + `client.js`。

## 你需要它吗

只有当你的 MCP 服务器**多到或重到值得开关**时才需要。判断方法：

- 打开面板看一眼"每轮约"。**单一轻量服务器（几十个工具、几万字节）不必装**——
  省下的 token 抵不上多一个插件的心智成本。
- **重服务器才划算**（数百工具 / 数十万字节），典型是 REA 这类自描述极强的 MCP。
- 如果你从不在多个项目间切换 MCP 组合，直接在 patch 里注释掉那一行更省事。

## 关掉是真省 —— 机制与证据

"禁用一个 MCP 条目"到底省不省 token，只有一个判据：**工具是否真的从注册表里消失**。

这条链路已逐行核对 DSH 源码，并在本机实测：

```
loader: Entry#update({disabled:true})
  → 该条目的 fiber 被 dispose
    → @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 ctx.effect 清理函数运行
      → 关闭 stdio 传输
      → 并调用它为每个工具登记的那个 disposer
        → ctx.tools.register 的登记被撤销
```

关键在于：`dsh-mcp-client` **没有惰性注册路径**。它只有一条路——
`syncTools` → `listTools({cacheMode:"refresh"})` → 对每个工具 `ctx.tools.register`。
所以"关掉"必然等于"注销"，不存在"关掉了但模式还留着"的中间态。

实测（本机桌面 profile，服务器 `rea`）：

| 步骤 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 关闭前 | `enabled: true`，`fiberPhase: active`，`tools: 207`，`estTokens: 191514` |
| 关闭后 | `enabled: false`，`fiberPhase: null`（fiber 已销毁），**`tools: 0`**，`estTokens: 0` |
| 重开后 | `enabled: true`，`fiberPhase: active`，`tools: 207`，`estTokens: 191514` |

`tools: 0` 是关键——它读的是 `ctx.tools.schemas()`，即**当前真正注册在案**的工具表。
不是本插件自己记的账，是问的工具服务本身。

> 因此：**本插件不实现"隐藏但不注销"模式**。那种模式省不了 token，
> 却会让人以为省了——这是本仓库明确拒绝做的事（见 `DECISION.md`）。

## 为什么写进 HOME 层

DSH 的组合顺序是：

```
bundle  →  profile cordis.patch.yml  →  $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml  →  overlays
```

**HOME 层压过 per-profile 层。** 而 MCP 行往往分散在两层里（例如 REA 装在 HOME）。
若把覆盖行写进 profile，HOME 那行会把它盖掉，你会得到一个"改了但没生效"的面板。

所以覆盖行写 **`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`**（`DSH_HOME` 环境变量优先，
否则 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）。面板还会列出它检查过的**全部候选层**及各自是否存在。

## 不修改你写的那一行 —— 只追加覆盖行

面板**从不重写**它找到的 MCP 行。那一行通常在 `insert:` 列表里，是安装器写的。

它做的是**追加一条独立覆盖行**：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: rea-mcp
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: rea
        # ...

- id: rea-mcp          # ← 只有这一行是本插件加的
  disabled: true
```

这么写能成立，是因为 DSH 内置的补丁应用器 `applyEntryPatches` 有三条性质：

1. 插入的条目**边插边建索引**，所以"后来的补丁"能命中"先前的插入"
   → 覆盖行**必须在 insert 之后**；`upsertDisabled()` 保证这一点；
2. 补丁**不写 `name` 就跳过名字校验** → 覆盖行只带 `id` + `disabled` 即可；
3. 覆盖是**逐键应用**的 → `disabled` 碰不到 `config`，改不动你的服务器配置。

三条都写进了 `test/patch-contract.test.mjs`——它把这套语义独立实现一遍，
再断言本插件产出的 YAML 满足它。**该测试是金丝雀，不是历史遗留。**

写入是**逐行**的：同一 id 永远只有一条顶层覆盖行；就地改写 `disabled:`；
不重排、不整文件重写、不碰 `insert:` 里的行；保留 CRLF/LF 与结尾换行。
**若目标状态与当前状态相同，则文件一个字节都不动。**

## 安全

上游最大的短板是**改 patch 前不备份**。本分支补上了。

- **写前备份**：每次写入前先把**原文件字节**存为
  `cordis.patch.yml.backup-<ISO时间戳>-<两位序号>`（同目录），响应回传 `backupPath`。
  序号不是装饰：时间戳只有毫秒精度，同毫秒内的第二次写入会**覆盖**第一份备份
  （CI 在 Linux 上真的这样丢过 4 份）。序号保证每份都在。
- **自动清理**：只保留最近 **10** 份，按文件名排序裁掉更旧的。
- **备份失败不阻断**：备份是尽力而为。真失败了，开关照常生效，
  响应报 `backupError`——**绝不假装备份成功**。
- **先活后存**：先改运行时（立即生效），再落盘。落盘失败则响应 `persisted: false`
  + `persistError`：运行时状态是真的，磁盘状态是假的，两者分开报。
- **绝不跨越 API 抛错**：任何路径都返回 JSON。
- **锁定条目**：`include`、`cordis:include`、`dsh-mcp-control`、`dsh-mcp-toggle` 一律 403。
- **1 MB 请求体上限**。
- **只动开关**：不新增、不编辑、不删除任何服务器定义；不碰 `cordis.yml`。

回滚：把 `backupPath` 指向的文件复制回 `cordis.patch.yml` 即可。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub（推荐——名字带 owner，避免撞上同名仓库）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ZiYuan258/dsh-mcp-control

# 或从本机目录（开发时用这个，改完重新 add 一次即可）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<本目录绝对路径>"
```

- 插件行 id 是 **`mcp-control`**（不是包名——`cordis.patch.yml` 插入的是短 id）。
- **客户端半是冷加载的**：装完、改了 `client.js` 之后要**硬刷新**页面。
  宿主的 HMR 只跟踪**它自己**的 patch 文件，**不会**跟踪本插件目录里源码的改动；
  改了 `index.js` / `client.js` 要重新 `add` 一次才会投影到 profile。
- 宿主路由：`GET|POST http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/mcp-control/api`。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

```
test/unit.test.mjs                 纯函数（upsertDisabled 全部分支、CRLF、引号 id）
test/patch-contract.test.mjs       产出的 YAML 必须满足 DSH 真实补丁语义（金丝雀）
test/write-path.test.mjs           写路径契约：备份、幂等、失败不假装成功
test/package-contract.test.mjs     版本一致性、files 白名单、无 @deepseek-ai 运行时依赖
test/docs-parity.test.mjs          中英 README 章节对齐、发布说明双语结构
test/release-consistency.test.mjs  每个版本都有发布说明
```

零依赖，用 Node 内置 `node:test`。

## HTTP API

`GET /mcp-control/api` → 快照：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "servers": [{
    "entryId": "include:rea-mcp",
    "rawId": "rea-mcp",
    "serverName": "rea",
    "enabled": true,
    "fiberPhase": "active",
    "toolCount": 207,
    "schemaBytes": 766054,
    "estTokens": 191514,
    "breakdown": { "nameBytes": 6148, "descriptionBytes": 92265, "parameterBytes": 667641 },
    "layer": "home"
  }],
  "totals": { "servers": 1, "enabled": 1, "disabled": 0, "mcpToolCount": 207,
              "mcpSchemaBytes": 766054, "mcpEstTokens": 191514,
              "activeEstTokens": 191514, "bytesPerToken": 4 },
  "patchPath": "C:\\Users\\<you>\\.dsh\\cordis.patch.yml",
  "layersReadable": true
}
```

`POST /mcp-control/api`，二选一：

```json
{ "entryId": "include:rea-mcp", "disabled": true }
{ "action": "disable-all" }
```

单条响应：`{ ok, entryId, rawId, serverName, disabled, fiberPhase, persisted,
persistMode, patchPath, backupPath?, persistError? }`

| 状态码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 400 | 请求体非法 / `disabled` 不是布尔 / 目标不是 MCP 行 |
| 403 | `entryId` 为空 / 条目被锁定 |
| 404 | 未知条目 |
| 405 | 方法不支持 |
| 500 | loader 抛错 |
| 503 | loader 服务不可用 |

## 两个诚实的说明

**一、`estTokens` 是除法，不是分词器。** 它等于 `bytes / 4`。
中英混排、JSON 结构、重复字段都会让它偏离真实值，通常 ±15%。
它的用途是**排序和量级判断**——"这个服务器值不值得常驻"——
而不是"这一轮精确花了多少 token"。绝对值以账单为准。

**二、统计的是模型可见投影，不是 MCP 原始载荷。**
本插件只计 `name` + `description` + `JSON.stringify(parameters)`。
MCP 工具若声明了 `outputSchema`，**它不进模型上下文**（DSH 只转发 `parameters`），
所以本插件**不计**它。这正是 REA 原始载荷 3.0 MB 里约 73% 被排除的原因——
面板的 785 KB 是**真实进入上下文**的那部分，比原始 `tools/list` 小得多，
也比它诚实得多。

## 目录

```
index.js          宿主半：路由 + 枚举 + 成本统计 + 落盘（逐行 upsert + 备份）
client.js         浏览器半：设置页（手写 ModuleLoader CJS 闭包，无构建步骤）
cordis.patch.yml  插入插件行 mcp-control
locale/           en.json / zh.json —— 插件列表里的标题与描述
icon.svg          插件图标
AGENTS.md         维护契约（改这个仓库之前先读）
DECISION.md       为什么 fork、为什么写覆盖行、为什么拒绝"假省"模式
SECURITY.md       安全模型与威胁边界（英文）
SECURITY.zh.md    同上，中文
docs/             发布说明
test/            零依赖测试（node:test）
```

## 许可与署名

MIT，见 `LICENSE`。

骨架来自 **`dsh-mcp-toggle`**，Copyright (c) 2026 **Zenjibad**（MIT）。
条目枚举、按 `entry.options.name` 识别 MCP 行、`settings.section` 注册方式，
以及"用 `Entry#update` 而**不是** `EntryTree.update`"这个关键判断，都源自上游。
其中最后一条尤其重要：`EntryTree.update` 会调用 `tree.write()`，把补丁**摊平**进
`cordis.yml`，摧毁补丁层的意义——上游踩过这个坑，本分支沿用了它的结论。

本分支的增量：成本可见性、写前备份、批量操作、幂等写路径、双语界面，
以及一套把 DSH 补丁语义钉死的测试。

# 采购助手 · ProcureMate

面向 DeepSeek Harness 的采购助手插件，将 Excel 采购需求整理为可复制的询价文本，并集中管理供货商、询价进度和采购提醒。

![采购助手界面，使用演示数据](docs/images/workspace.png)

## 功能

|   | 使用方式 |
| --- | --- |
| Excel 需求导入 | 支持 `.xls`、`.xlsx`，识别表头，可选择工作表和列对应关系 |
| 询价文本 | 勾选明细生成纯文本，可编辑后复制至微信或电商客服 |
| 供货商管理 | 保存品牌、别名、联系人、微信、电话和店铺网址；匹配已有供货商 |
| 公司省份 | 配置需求公司对应的发往省份，优先于公司名称中的地名推断 |
| 询价进度 | 勾选后批量标记已询价或未询价，通过行底色、计数和筛选区分 |
| 采购提醒 | 通用提醒显示在表格上方；品牌、品名相关提醒显示在对应行 |
| 资料维护 | 供货商、提醒和公司省份支持 Excel 模板、JSON 导入导出；支持资料备份和目录切换 |
| 整理版导出 | 导出明细、供货商联系方式及有表头的其他原始列 |

## 安装与兼容范围

对外名称为 **ProcureMate**，安装包名称为 `dsh-procuremate`。

1. 获取维护者提供的 `.tgz` 安装包。若仓库 Releases 尚未提供附件，可按下方开发步骤自行构建并运行 `npm pack`。
2. 从 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 打开 **Open DSH Terminal**，使用当前激活的 profile。
3. 执行以下命令，将示例路径替换为安装包的实际绝对路径：

   ```sh
   dsh plugin add '/absolute/path/dsh-procuremate-0.3.24.tgz'
   ```

4. 重启 Desktop，从侧边栏打开“采购助手”。升级使用新版安装包重复上述操作。

卸载命令：

```sh
dsh plugin remove dsh-procuremate
```

从旧包迁移时，请先在同一 DSH Terminal 中运行 `dsh plugin remove dsh-procurement-workbench`，再安装新包，避免两个包重复注册同一入口。原资料目录及目录设置路径保留。

卸载不会主动删除资料文件。插件基于 Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` 的公开接口开发；浏览器预览已验证，当前发布包尚未进行 Desktop 实机加载验收。Windows 文件选择分支有代码测试，尚未实机验收。详细范围见 [兼容说明](COMPATIBILITY.md)。

## 快速使用

1. 在“供货商”录入品牌及联系方式，或下载模板批量导入。
2. 点击“打开原 Excel”，确认工作表、表头及列对应关系，至少对应品牌、型号和数量。
3. 查看表格上方的通用注意事项；超过三条时可展开全部。对应商品的提醒在行内展示。
4. 勾选需要询价的明细，核对右侧文本和发往省份。无法识别时可进入“公司省份”配置；省份提示不阻止复制。
5. 点击“复制询价文本”，自行粘贴发送。复制不会自动标记已询价。
6. 完成询价后，勾选相应行并点击“选中标为已询价”。蓝色底色代表已询价，可筛选或改回未询价；注意事项列保留原有底色。

**每次确认导入都开始新一轮询价，导入的明细全部重置为未询价。** 取消导入不改变当前状态。

公司省份请按实际收货地配置；名称推断仅供核对。同一公司配置一个省份，多收货地场景需要人工确认。

## 数据与限制

- 原 Excel 只读，插件不会修改、回填或覆盖原文件。
- 参考资料和询价标记保存在 `~/buyer/data/procurement-workbench.json`，可在“存储设置”切换目录。只有顶部显示“已保存到文件”才表示保存成功。
- 历史成交价物料编码单独保存在同一目录的 `history.json` 数组中，例如 `["4020006998", "4100169304"]`；导入时可映射“物料编码”列，系统按编码匹配历史记录，但不会在采购明细表或整理版中显示该列。
- 目录设置保存在 `~/.config/dsh-procurement-workbench/storage.json`。默认预览与 Desktop 会使用同一套配置；开发时建议使用隔离目录。
- 采购明细不作为独立明细表持久化，重新打开工作台后需重新导入。询价标记的匹配记录包含来源路径及行内容，备份资料也可能包含这些采购信息。
- 不产生自动备份，可手动“导出备份／恢复备份”。恢复备份会替换资料；分类资料导入也会替换对应类别，操作前有确认。
- 保存失败时保留页面修改，可重试；多窗口冲突不会静默覆盖。重新载入会放弃未保存修改。
- 支持 `.xls` 和 `.xlsx`，不支持 `.xlsm`、图片或 HTML 伪装的 Excel。文件上限 20 MB，明细上限 10000 行，列对应选项最多显示前 100 列。
- 公式读取文件中缓存的结果，不执行计算。合并的需求公司单元格会读取主单元格；其他字段的合并空白需人工确认。
- 整理版保留业务字段和有表头的其他原始列，不保留原样式、公式、宏及其他工作表。单价不作为导入界面的专用字段展示；物料编码仅用于历史成交价匹配。
- 品牌按名称及显式别名匹配；“不限”“市场件”等不视为具体品牌。仅填写品牌而未提供供货商名称或联系渠道的记录，不算已有合作供货商。
- 官网自动搜索、店铺归属核实和网页联系方式提取尚未实现。不自动发送消息、登录电商账号或下单。
- 询价文本默认包含含税含运费及 13% 增值税专用发票要求，发送前可按实际情况编辑。内部采购提醒不会自动加入询价文本。

## 开发、贡献与许可证

本地开发需要 Node.js 和 npm。当前未声明最低 Node.js 版本，建议先运行测试确认环境兼容性。

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm test
npm run preview
```

预览地址为 `http://127.0.0.1:4173`。预览默认使用真实资料目录；隔离预览与界面测试方法见 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

生成安装包：

```sh
npm run build
npm pack
```

欢迎提交问题、文档改进和代码贡献。请勿在 Issue、截图或测试中提交真实采购表、联系人资料或服务密钥。

项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。第三方依赖许可见各依赖包及 [SheetJS 许可声明](lib/SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt)。

- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)
- [验证记录](VALIDATION.md)
- [兼容说明](COMPATIBILITY.md)

plugins.description: Explorer context-menu entry that opens a folder as a DSH project, with a switch in DSH settings
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-open-project

> **Current version: 1.4.0** — see [Changelog](#changelog). If you installed an earlier version,
> update: 1.2.0 brings the DSH window to the front, and 1.3.x can start the app from a
> non-default install directory and no longer fails silently.

A DSH plugin for Windows: it adds **用 DeepSeek Harness 打开** ("Open in DeepSeek Harness")
to the Explorer folder context menu, and registers the clicked folder as a project in DSH's
sidebar. One switch in DSH's **Settings → General** adds or removes that menu entry.

It is a two-half DSH plugin:

| Half | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers two exact routes on DSH's web server: one that registers a directory as a project, one that reads/toggles the context-menu entry. |
| Client | `client.js` | Renders one row in the General settings page with a switch that calls the toggle route. |
| Windows helpers | `cli/` | The registry writer (`context-menu.ps1`), the shared executable lookup (`app-path.ps1`), and the launcher the context-menu entry actually runs. |

## Effect

**In Explorer.** Right-click a folder — or the empty area inside a folder — and the menu
contains 「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」. Choosing it adds that folder to DSH's project list,
**brings the DSH window to the front** (restoring it from the tray or from minimised), and shows
a Windows notification:

- `Opened as a DSH project` — the folder was registered (the notification's second line is the
  project title);
- `Already a DSH project` — a project for that directory already existed, and nothing changed.

Bringing the window forward is part of the action on purpose: registering a project changes
nothing on screen, so without it a click looks like it did nothing.

If DSH is not running, the action starts it first: it locates the executable (`DSH_DESKTOP_APP_EXE`,
then a running instance, then the `dsh://` handler the installer registers, then the default
install locations), launches it, waits for the window and brings it forward, then registers the
folder once the host answers. The whole wait is bounded (180 s).

**In DSH.** Settings → General gains one row — 「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」 in a Chinese
browser, **Open in DeepSeek Harness** otherwise. Its description says that the switch writes the
current user's registry (no administrator rights), and reminds you to turn it off and on again
after DSH moves, which re-registers the entry against the new path. The row sits between the
code-workspace row and the version row. Turning the switch on writes both registry keys; turning
it off deletes them. On a non-Windows host the row is not rendered at all.

**Screenshots.** Windows 11, DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.

![The folder context menu with the entry](assets/context-menu.png)

![The switch in Settings → General](assets/settings-general.png)

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The whole feature is an Explorer + `HKCU` registry mechanism.
- **PowerShell — either version, nothing to install.** Windows PowerShell 5.1 ships with
  Windows 10/11 and is enough on its own: the scripts avoid syntax that only 7 accepts, and they
  are saved as UTF-8 with a BOM so 5.1 decodes their non-ASCII default title correctly. When
  PowerShell 7 is installed the plugin uses it instead, because it starts roughly three times
  faster. The visible difference is the success notification: 5.1 shows a real Windows toast
  (it can project WinRT), while 7 falls back to a tray balloon.
- **`wscript.exe`** (ships with Windows) — the menu command runs through it so no console
  window flashes.
- **A DSH profile that composes this plugin** and provides the `webServer` and
  `workspaceRegistry` services — the ones the DSH desktop application itself uses (its sidebar
  project list is built on the workspace registry). If either service is missing, the plugin
  stays pending instead of half-mounting.

## Install

**From the DSH app (recommended).** Open the sidebar **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and
enter one of:

```
dsh-open-project
github:dongfangxy/dsh-open-project
```

The plugin manager installs the bundle and enables it by default. The first form resolves from
the npm registry the profile uses (the package must be published there); the second fetches the
repository.

**From the `dsh` CLI**, for a profile you boot yourself:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-open-project
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:dongfangxy/dsh-open-project
```

`--profile` is required — `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`. (The app's install dialog describes the package name as "the
part after `dsh plugin add` in a README"; that is the *name*, not the whole command.) The DSH
desktop application loads its own reserved profile, so install into it from the Plugins page.

If the settings row does not appear on its own, restart DSH.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → General** in DSH and turn the row on (「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」 in a
   Chinese browser, "Open in DeepSeek Harness" otherwise). This writes the registry entry;
   nothing else changes.
2. In Explorer, right-click a folder (or the empty area inside one) and choose
   **用 DeepSeek Harness 打开**.
3. The folder becomes a project in DSH's sidebar. Open it there and start a session; DSH runs
   that session in the project's directory.
4. To remove the menu entry, turn the same switch off. The switch state is read back from the
   registry every time the settings page loads.

The registry toggle can also be driven directly:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File cli/context-menu.ps1 -Action status            # human-readable report
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File cli/context-menu.ps1 -Action status -Json      # one JSON line (what the host reads)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File cli/context-menu.ps1 -Action enable
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File cli/context-menu.ps1 -Action disable
```

`-Title 'Open in DeepSeek Harness'` sets another menu label. The settings switch does not pass
a title, so it always writes the default Chinese label.

## What it actually does

Nothing here is more than it looks; this is the exact chain.

**Context-menu click.** The registry command runs `wscript.exe //nologo` with the absolute path
of `cli/open-project-in-dsh.vbs` and the clicked folder (`%V`) as its argument; that starts
`cli/open-project-in-dsh.ps1` in a hidden window. That script:

1. resolves the folder and stops with a warning dialog if the path does not exist or is not a
   directory (exit code 2);
2. determines DSH's base URL — `DSH_WEB_URL` if the session provides it, otherwise the
   loopback port a running `DeepSeek Harness` process is listening on, otherwise
   `http://127.0.0.1:19387`;
3. starts the app if it was not running, using the executable found by `cli/app-path.ps1`
   (`$env:DSH_DESKTOP_APP_EXE` → a running instance's own image path → the default per-user and
   per-machine install locations). If none is found the action stops with a message that says so
   (exit code 3);
4. `POST`s `{"path": "<folder>"}` to `/.dsh-open-project`, retrying until its deadline (30 s
   when the app was already running, 180 s after it started the app). A 4xx other than 403 is
   treated as final and is not retried;
5. reports the outcome: a Windows notification on success, a message box on failure.

**Registration.** `POST /.dsh-open-project` is handled by the host half, which calls
`ctx.workspaceRegistry.create(<folder>)`. That is DSH's own workspace registry: it writes a
workspace record — on a default desktop install, `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` is the
registry's durable store (unit `workspace`, version 2). Registration is idempotent: if the
directory already has a project, the existing record is returned unchanged. The record is a
*project* — an entry in the sidebar's project list; it holds no file contents and no session
data of its own.

**The settings row.** `client.js` registers into the `settings.general.item` slot and calls
`GET /.dsh-open-project/menu` to read the current state, and
`POST /.dsh-open-project/menu` with `{"enabled": true|false}`

[![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Bottom-right native Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness: approve a permission request, know a question is waiting, and get a summary when a turn finishes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desk-card

Bottom-right native desktop cards for **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** approvals, questions, turn
completion and errors.

Each card is a small always-on-top window drawn by PowerShell/WPF — not a system toast — so it
can carry a button that answers the request. An approval can be allowed straight from the card,
and the moment a card would interrupt something else (a fullscreen app, a game, Do-Not-Disturb)
it is skipped and the decision goes back to the normal DSH UI.

Windows only. No dependencies, no network, no build step.

## Why not just a toast

| | system toast | this card |
|---|---|---|
| carries a button that returns an answer | depends on the shell / extra runtime | yes, the card's own button |
| can allow an approval in place | no (toasts only focus the app) | yes — `确认允许` / `Allow` |
| respects fullscreen games and Do-Not-Disturb | only if the OS suppresses it | explicit gate, checked before the window is drawn |
| UI language | whatever the OS shows | follows the DSH locale, or forced with `language` |

## Screenshots

![approval card](assets/approval-zh.png)

![completion card](assets/done-zh.png)

![error card](assets/error-en.png)

![two cards stacked](assets/stacked-zh.png)

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (cards are drawn with `powershell.exe` + WPF, which ship with Windows).
- DSH desktop profile (the cards are injected by the **host** process, no browser side needed).
- Node.js 20+ (whatever DSH ships is fine).

## Install

From this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanshang328/dsh-desk-card
```

Or from a local clone / download:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desk-card
```

Then restart DSH. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the CLI records it in
`dsh.profile.bundles` and mounts it as a normal profile layer — no hand-written paths.

Windows developer helper: `powershell.exe -File tools/deploy-local.ps1` copies the working tree
into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-desk-card` and registers it the same way.

## What shows up

| card | when | auto-close | buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approval | a tool call needs permission | never (waits for you) | `确认允许` / `Allow` approves once · clicking the card opens DSH for the full dialog |
| Question | the agent asks you something | never, closes when the question is answered | `知道了` / `Got it` |
| Completion | a turn ends normally | `doneTimeoutSeconds` (default 5s) | `知晓` / `OK` |
| Error | a turn fails | never | `知道了` / `Got it` |

The completion card also carries a short summary of your last message, the elapsed time, the
remaining todo count and the turn/session token usage.

Cards never overlap: a new card stacks above the ones already on screen. If the DSH window is
closed while a card is open, the card closes itself too.

## Configuration

Everything has a built-in default, so this section is optional. To change something, add a row
with the same id from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-desk-card
      name: dsh-desk-card
      config:
        doneTimeoutSeconds: 10
        scale: 1.0
        language: en
```

Only the keys you list are changed — a `config` object replaces the whole object, and every key
you leave out falls back to the defaults below.

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutSeconds` | `0` | auto-close seconds for cards that wait for **you** (approval / question). `0` = stay until answered |
| `doneTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | auto-close seconds for the completion card. `0` = keep it until clicked |
| `scale` | `1.2` | card scale factor |
| `skipWhenFullscreen` | `true` | skip cards while a fullscreen app is in the foreground, or while Windows says Do-Not-Disturb |
| `notifyQuestions` | `true` | show the question card |
| `notifyErrors` | `true` | show the error card |
| `notifyDone` | `true` | show the completion card |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto` (follow the DSH locale), `zh` or `en` |
| `hostProcess` | `DeepSeek Harness` | the process whose window is brought to front when you click a card |

The three `notify*` switches only control the cards — approvals and questions always keep
working, the card just does not appear.

### The fullscreen gate

A card is not drawn when either of these is true:

- `SHQueryUserNotificationState` reports a fullscreen app, presentation mode or Do-Not-Disturb; or
- the foreground window covers its whole monitor and is not the desktop (this keeps games that
  hide the real state from being interrupted).

When a card is skipped the approval is handed back to the normal DSH UI (with `prepend: true`
this plugin speaks first, and a skipped card always delegates to the next answerer), so nothing
gets stuck. Two test tools reproduce the condition without a game:

```powershell
powershell.exe -File test/gate-probe.ps1 -MaxSeconds 20          # watch the gate flip blocked -> free
powershell.exe -File test/fake-fullscreen.ps1 -HoldSeconds 8     # paint a fullscreen window for 8s
```

## How it works

```
lib/index.js      host half: listens to approval/request, user-questions/request,
                  agent/error, agent/status; spawns one card per event and maps the
                  card's exit code back to an approval outcome.
scripts/card.ps1  render half: one PowerShell process per card. Runs the gate, draws the
                  WPF window, stacks it above sibling cards, runs timers, then exits with
                  a code that the host half reads.
```

Exit-code protocol between the two halves:

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `10` | the card's primary button was pressed |
| `12` | the card body was clicked — bring the DSH window to the front, let the UI decide |
| `0` | gate skipped the card (fullscreen / Do-Not-Disturb) |
| `3` | rendering failed |

Being one process per card keeps the render half stateless: a card can never wedge the host,
and a card that is killed by the OS just delegates the decision.

## Logs and troubleshooting

`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` records card placement, exit codes, config and gate decisions:

```
apply() started config={"skipWhenFullscreen":true,...}
showCard[approval]: exit 10
approval resolved: allowed-once
done card (41234ms, autoClose=5s)
```

Cards are spawned without a console window. If no card ever appears, check in order: a
fullscreen app is holding the gate (`-SkipWhenFullscreen false` for a manual test), PowerShell
is blocked by policy for the DSH process, and finally the log file.

Manual card render (bypasses the host half entirely):

```powershell
$payload = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"badge":"test","head":"hello","body":"line","okLabel":"OK","okCode":10}'))
powershell.exe -File scripts/card.ps1 -Payload $payload -TimeoutSeconds 5 -Scale 1.2 -SkipWhenFullscreen false -DebugLog "$env:TEMP\card-test.log"
```

## Limitations

- Windows only. The render half is PowerShell + WPF; there is no macOS/Linux path.
- Cards are ordinary top-level windows, so they appear above other windows but not above a
  fullscreen exclusive game — which is why the gate exists.
- One PowerShell process per card (about 100 ms of warm-up). A card is not a notification
  center entry: once it is closed it is gone.
- This plugin deliberately does **not** restart or shut down DSH. If you want power controls,
  [dsh-power-button](https://github.com/keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button) and
  [dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) do that well.

## Privacy

The host half never opens a socket and never reads a file. It spawns one local PowerShell
process per card and appends a line to `%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log`. Card payloads contain short
excerpts of your session (task title, tool name, approval reason, error message) and are passed
to that child process as a command-line argument.

## License

MIT

# dsh-active-sessions

左侧边栏「进行中」tab：跨项目平铺展示会话，点击即切换。

分组顺序（自上而下）：
1. **进行中** —— 运行中，或等待审批/计划审阅/回答的会话；
2. **已完成** —— 已停止但尚未读过（打开即清除未读）的会话；
3. **近 12h 活跃** —— 其余空闲会话，默认折叠（展开态记在 localStorage）。

tab 角标 = 进行中 + 已完成未读的数量，不含折叠的空闲会话。

由 dsh-super-injector dev_scaffold_plugin 生成。

## 构建与注入

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
# 注入器环境内：dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-icon-switch

In-app icon switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Change the app / tray / taskbar icon right from the Settings page, upload any image to generate a full icon set, round the corners, and optionally hide the sidebar brand row.

## Features

- **Icon gallery** — preview every installed icon set inside the DSH Settings page.
- **Upload → icon set** — upload a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP and the bundled PowerShell engine generates the full set (`app-icon.png/.ico` + tray sizes).
- **Rounded corners** — optional 26% corner radius; the square original is kept as `source.png` so toggling it off restores sharp corners.
- **Tray & taskbar** — writes `tray.ico`/`icon.png` for the app, updates Windows shortcuts, and sets the taskbar icon (Electron `setIcon` first, a resident PowerShell watcher as fallback).
- **Hide sidebar brand row** — optional pure-CSS toggle, instant.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add dsh-icon-switch
```

or from source:

```
dsh plugin add github:yturjzw/dsh-icon-switch
```

After installing, **fully quit and restart DSH** so the plugin loads and the tray icon is picked up.

## How it works

`lib/index.js` registers a settings section plus loopback-only HTTP routes under
`/api/dsh-icon-switch/`. The bundled `tool/dsh-icon-switch.ps1` engine reads and
writes icon sets under `tool/icons` (override the directory with the `toolDir`
setting if you want them to persist across plugin reinstalls).

## Layout

```
lib/index.js          host side: Config schema, routes, engine spawn
client/client.js      browser settings section (gallery, upload, form)
tool/                 bundled PowerShell engines + starter icon sets
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch
```

## Icon files

- `tray.ico` → `process.resourcesPath\tray.ico` (tray icon, read once at startup).
- `icon.png` → `process.resourcesPath\icon.png` (About panel; the window/taskbar icon is set via `setIcon`/WM_SETICON at runtime).
- ICO frames are built as 32 bpp DIB with an alpha-derived AND mask — PNG frames are rejected by some shell extraction paths and show up as a blank icon.

plugins.description: The machine's non-pwsh execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), and a real console for interactive programs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-shell-surfaces

[![test](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

`https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces` -- a DSH plugin, installed with
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces`.

The badge is the whole test workflow: the pure self-test, and the two-runner
probe that asks every shell on Windows and on Linux what it is. A green badge
therefore means "the table and the argv shape still hold, and both platforms
still answered", not just "the linter passed".

One DSH tool for the execution surfaces this machine has **besides pwsh**: a WSL
Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland
(bash / zsh / fish / brush), and a real console for interactive programs.

It exists because a rule that is only written down is not a capability. The
selection rules for these surfaces have been recorded for a while, but a session
could only act on them by composing a command string for pwsh and hoping the
quoting survived the trip. Here they are callable.

```
shell_surfaces(action="surfaces")                    what exists here, and where each was looked for
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="wsl",  command="grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="nu",   command="open data.json | where n > 3 | to json")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="msys", command="pacman -Q | wc -l")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pty",  command="powershell -File install.ps1", send=["y\n"])
```

## Why one tool and not seven

Every registered tool spends part of the context on its description. Seven tools
would say the same thing seven times. The selection rules -- which surface for a
structured pipe, which for a Linux-only tool, which for a program that waits for
input -- live in this one description, and a session reads them exactly when it
is choosing.

## What it is not

* **No prompt injection and no message hooks.** It registers a tool and nothing
  else, so it cannot be the plugin that writes a malformed message.
* **No terminal emulator.** A terminal emulator draws text for a person and adds
  nothing a subprocess can use. The one surface that needs a console talks to
  ConPTY directly.

## The facts behind the argument lists

Each of these was measured on this machine, and each shapes the argv:

| Fact | Consequence |
| --- | --- |
| A command handed through a shell can be re-parsed twice | The command travels as **one argv element**; a script **file** is preferred over an inline string |
| MSYS2's `/tmp` follows `TMPDIR`, which this machine passes down as a Windows path | msys / zsh / fish run as **login** shells, which normalises the environment |
| brush has no Cygwin runtime beside it, so `/tmp` is `<drive>:\tmp` | brush gets **no** login flag and no POSIX-path assumptions; its PATH needs `usr\bin` as well as `ucrt64\bin`, or every external command fails while the shell reports a healthy version |
| `PtyProcess.read` blocks | Reading happens on its own thread; a read loop that also decides when to stop can block the very check that would stop it |
| A console wants Enter, which is a carriage return | `send` normalises a trailing newline (real, escaped, or literal) to CR, and a bare answer gets one added |
| `wsl.exe` sometimes prints the result and then declines to exit | A timeout **with** output is reported differently from a timeout **without** it; `wsl.exe --shutdown` is the reset (measured: a cold instance answered in 58 s, the same call after a reset in 8 s, and warm in 0.13 s) |

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | the tool: one `shell_surfaces`, actions `run` and `surfaces` |
| `lib/surfaces.js` | the table: paths, arguments, environments, and the absent-reason for each surface |
| `lib/runner.js` | argv construction, bounded output with spill, timeout classification |
| `scripts/pty_runner.py` | the console: pywinpty, a reader thread, ANSI stripping, one JSON report |
| `scripts/live-check.mjs` | runs one real command per surface through the plugin's own code path |
| `scripts/probe-all-shells.ps1` | asks every shell **and** terminal this machine has what it is; platform-shaped, one JSON object out |
| `scripts/probe-posix.sh`, `scripts/probe-wsl.sh` | the POSIX and WSL probes, as files, because an inline command crosses quoting layers and a `$()` gets expanded by the wrong one |
| `scripts/probe-table.mjs` | the probe's JSON as a markdown table, also written to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` |
| `scripts/pty-gate.ps1` | the interactive fixture: a `Read-Host` prompt for the pty case |
| `test/surfaces-test.mjs` | the table, the argv shape, the tool contract |

## Verification

```
node test/surfaces-test.mjs          # no host needed; the host validator is asked too when reachable
node scripts/live-check.mjs          # one real command per surface on this machine
node scripts/live-check.mjs wsl nu   # or only some of them
pwsh -File scripts/probe-all-shells.ps1 | node scripts/probe-table.mjs   # every shell and terminal
```

CI runs the self-test, and runs the probe on both a Windows and a Linux runner
(the tables land in the run summary, so "which surfaces exist" is a record with
history rather than something a person measured once). Each runner also runs this
live check against every surface it actually has.

That last step reports four outcomes, not two: **pass**, **fail**, **absent** and
**skipped**. A surface a machine does not have is a fact about the machine
(`absent`, with the path that was looked for); a surface that exists but cannot be
exercised here -- a WSL launcher with no distribution, a python without pywinpty --
is also a fact about the machine (`skipped`, with the reason). A surface that ran
and answered wrongly is a fact about the plugin, and only that fails the job,
because a runner with nothing to run is not a broken build.

A pass also needs the expected *output*, not just exit code 0: `bash -c ""` exits
0, and the failures this check exists to catch (a command mangled by quoting,
output decoded as the wrong encoding) are exactly the ones that keep exit code 0.

Its table goes into the run summary beside the probe's, so "this runner is missing
half the surfaces, and here is why" is answerable without opening the log.


Every surface was also run for real (2026-10-15): wsl returned the kernel and a
`/proc` count, nu returned a number through a structured pipeline, msys returned
its bash version and a package count, zsh its parameter-expansion result, fish
its arithmetic result, brush an uppercased string, and pty answered a
`Read-Host` prompt with `y` and printed the branch it took.

## Honest boundaries

* **Windows-first.** The surfaces it knows about are this class of machine's: a
  WSL distro, MSYS2, nushell, and ConPTY. On POSIX the platform already ships a
  single shell, so most of this is unnecessary there.
* No isolation of its own: a command runs with the harness process's rights.
  The file sandbox and approval policy still apply to the process tree.
* MSYS-family output is assumed UTF-8 (`LANG=C.UTF-8` is set). A Windows program
  reached through a surface may still answer in the OEM code page.
* The MSYS2 surfaces need `DSH_MSYS_ROOT` if MSYS2 is not at `D:\msys64`;
  nushell needs `DSH_NU` if `nu.exe` is not in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\nu\bin`;
  the pty surface needs `python` on PATH with `pywinpty` installed.

# dsh-session-handoff

**会话自动衔接**：新建会话时，自动把「上一场会话」的尾部对话注入为一段交接材料，使新会话不必从头解释上下文。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-session-handoff": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-session-handoff" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-session-handoff name: dsh-session-handoff ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：新建会话 → 首轮上下文里应出现上一场的**尾部对话**（仅在存在新鲜对话时注入） ## 解决的问题 一场会话卡住/中断/上下文过载后，新开一场就丢失了「刚在做什么、卡在哪、下一步是什么」。手工复述既费时又容易漏。本插件把这件事变成自动的、可核查的一行注入。 ## 它做什么 - 监听 `session/created`（`{ global: true }`），只对**真正的新会话**生效：子代理会话、fork 子会话、重启时恢复的历史会话一律跳过。 - 取该会话的 **scope key**（`carrierKeyOf(this)`——事件的 `this` 是 routing-only 载体，没有 Context API），找到同工作目录、窗口内最近的一场有真实对话的会话。 - 摘录它**尾部的若干条 user/assistant 文本**（不调模型、不做摘要生成，成本为 0 且可复现），渲染成一段交接块。 - 交接块经 `systemPrompt.context` 落为**动态上下文快照**：全局注册一次，`text` 按本次装配的 `AssembleContext.scope` 查表返回——未命中的会话拿到空串，而「空文本不贡献任何内容」是 `PromptContext` 的既定语义 ⇒ 只影响被衔接的那一场会话。 交接块首行显式声明**它是历史材料、不是新指令**——衔接内容来自上一场会话，绝不能变成可执行的命令。 ## 它不做什么 | 不做 | 归属 | |---|---| | fork（全量继承历史） | `sessions.fork` | | 生成式摘要（调模型压缩） | 模型侧 or 人工 | | 改系统提示词 / 工具面 | `section` / 工具注册 | | 跨会话记忆 | `dsh-agent-memory` | ## 配置 | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 | | `maxAgeMinutes` | `720` | 新鲜度窗口：上一场会话最后活动早于此则不衔接 | | `maxChars` | `3000` | 交接块字符预算 | | `messageChars` | `400` | 单条消息字符上限 | | `maxMessages` | `8` | 最多引用多少条消息 | | `sameWorkspaceOnly` | `true` | 只衔接同一工作目录的会话 | | `maxCandidates` | `3` | 最多向前探查几个候选（每个都要读日志，故设上限） | | `order` | `850` | 动态上下文排序位 | ## 观测（机制自证） 每次注入/跳过/出错都落一行侧车： ```sh tail -f "$DSH_HOME/session-handoff-trace.jsonl" ``` `stage` 取值：`injected`（注入成功，带来源会话/字符数/消息数）、`skip`（无合格对话）、`filtered`（被判据跳过，带 `reason`）、`error` / `candidate-error`（读日志失败）。 判据（可证伪）：开一场新会话后，该文件应出现一行 `"stage":"injected"`，且其中的 `session` 等于新会话 id；未产生注入时会看到 `filtered`/`skip` 并附原因——**不会静默什么都不写**。 ## 已知边界 - **不作为的注入**：交接文本进入模型历史（动态上下文快照默认进历史），因此只摘录 user/assistant 文本，不摘录工具结果与文件内容。 - **只认「最近一场」**：不跨多场会话合并，不猜测话题相关性；判据是时间 + 工作目录，不含语义相似度。 - **读日志有成本**：候选逐个 `observeSession`（读完整事件流）。`maxCandidates` 就是这个成本的闸门；`projectionMode: 'none'` 已关闭投影计算。 - **`sessionQuery` 是硬依赖**：写在 `inject` 里（不是 `ctx.get()` 探测）。用探测会与加载顺序赛跑，失败时插件静默变成空转（实测：装了、mounted、却零轨迹）。 - **「新会话」按内容判，不按创建时间判**：判据是该会话自身还没有真实对话（见下「实践修订记录」）。 ## 测试 ```sh pnpm build && pnpm test # 10 个用例，含 4 条尸体样本（子代理/fork/过期/无对话/异目录/自身） ``` 纯决策层（`src/handoff.ts`）与 IO 壳层（`src/index.ts`）分层：判据与渲染可离线验证，壳层只做搬运。 ## 实践修订记录 两处判据都是被真实运行打回来才改对的，留档以免重犯： 1. **2026-09-30 · `ctx.get('sessionQuery')` 探测 → 静态 `inject`** 首版用 `ctx.get()` 探测服务，探测失败就打一条 warn 后返回。结果：插件 `mounted`、`built: true`、进程也重启了，**却零轨迹**——外部完全看不出「没加载」与「加载了但空转」的区别。改为 `inject = ['systemPrompt', 'sessionQuery']` 声明式依赖，并加一行启动自报 `stage: 'ready'`。教训：**机制必须自证**，否则「装了」和「在工作」在观测上是同一张脸。 2. **2026-09-30 · 按 `createdAt` 判「新会话」 → 按「自身有无真实对话」判** 首版用「创建时间在 N 分钟内」识别新会话。实测：GUI 点「新会话」复用的是既有空白会话的 id（21:28 建的空会话，22:05 点「新会话」时仍用它），于是被误判为「恢复的老会话」而拒绝注入（轨迹里留下 `"reason":"not-new"`）。改为内容判据：`extractMessages(session.snapshotEvents()).length === 0` 才算新会话。**判据要贴语义（「还没有对话」），不要贴代理量（「创建时间新」）。** ## 相关文档 - ⚠ **本插件暂无 `semantic.md`**（未建语义文档）——契约以 README 各节与源码为准；补文档是待办。 - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope

**Agent 权限边界** —— 查 agent 的工具/文件/网络权限有没有声明、是不是过宽。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 MCP 配置长这样：

```json
"filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/"] },
"everything": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-everything"], "allowedTools": ["*"] }
```

**看起来是「配置齐全」，实际上：**

```
① 文件访问路径是 /       → agent 能读写你所有文件（含 ~/.ssh、~/.aws）
② allowedTools: ["*"]    → agent 能调用所有工具（读文件、执行命令、发请求）
③ allowedDomains: "*"    → 被注入后能把数据发到任意地址
```

**Agent 的权限就是它的爆炸半径。** 一旦被提示注入控制，
它能做的事 = **你给它的全部权限**。

OWASP 把这归为 **LLM06 Excessive Agency**。

## 关键词
**关键词**：Agent 权限 · 工具权限 · 权限边界 · 最小权限 · MCP 权限 · 沙箱 · 白名单 · 爆炸半径
**Keywords**: agent scope · tool permissions · least privilege · MCP security · excessive agency · sandbox

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 工具权限用通配符 `*` | 最小权限（NIST SP 800-53 AC-6）|
| 🔴 高 | 文件访问是 `/` / `~` / 整个用户目录 | MCP 文档 · 目录限制建议 |
| 🟡 中 | 网络访问无限制 | OWASP **LLM06 Excessive Agency** |
| 🟡 中 | 配置里**找不到任何权限声明** | 最小权限 · 权限应显式声明 |

## 「没有声明」为什么危险

**没有声明通常等于默认全开** —— 而用户看到的只是一个「很干净」的配置文件，
不会意识到 agent 能做所有事。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope
```

![dsh-agent-scope 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/report.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/demo.png)

![dsh-agent-scope 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-agent-scope --demo
dsh-agent-scope --list-rules
dsh-agent-scope --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **只审配置，不审 agent 实现** —— agent 代码里怎么用这些权限，本工具看不到。
- **不判断「给得够不够」** —— 只查「有没有声明、有没有明显过宽」。
  权限偏大但没用通配符的情况需要人工评审。
- **配置位置各客户端不同** —— 按常见路径找（mcp.json / .mcp.json / settings.json / claude_desktop_config.json）。
- **沙箱是否真生效** 需要运行时验证，不在范围内。
- 与 [dsh-mcp-audit](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) 分工：
  那个查 MCP **服务来源**（未锁版本/明文端点），这个查 MCP **权限边界**。
- 与 [dsh-least-privilege](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) 分工：
  那个查**容器/云/Web** 权限，这个查 **agent** 权限。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [**Agent 权限**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)
